發牌令 謎題詳情中使用，從牌庫中自選一張臨時卡牌添加進手牌中。臨時卡牌會在謎題重置後消失。 再來一張。
积分令 谜题详情中使用，下次解谜成功获得双倍烂柯分。支持跨谜题生效，解谜失败不消耗次数。 “这题简单！”常听剑灵前辈如此评价谜题。

Lanke Point Token Use it in the riddle detail to get double Lanke points for the next successful solve. This effect works across riddles, and the effect remains when you fail to solve the riddle. "This is a simple riddle!" You've often heard Sword Spirit comment on riddles in this way.
積分令 謎題詳情中使用，下次解謎成功獲得雙倍爛柯分。支持跨謎題生效，解謎失敗不消耗次數。 「這題簡單！」常聽劍靈前輩如此評價謎題。
蜡烛令 谜题详情中使用，当前谜题残火+3。 仙府的蜡烛，温暖！明亮！耐用！……可能也没那么耐用。
Candle Token Use it in the riddle details to add 3 Remnant Fire to the current riddle. Candles in the Yixian Palace, warm! Bright! Durable! ...... Probably not that durable though.
蠟燭令 謎題詳情中使用，當前謎題殘火+3。 仙府的蠟燭，溫暖！明亮！耐用！……可能也沒那麼耐用。
道具生效中，无法重复使用
Token in effect, can't be reused.
道具生效中，無法重復使用

mTerms.Term: 使用揭谜卡揭晓谜底提示
Languages: 是否消耗一张揭谜令揭晓谜底？
Consume one Riddle Reveal token to reveal the answer?
是否消耗一張揭謎令揭曉謎底？

mTerms.Term: 使用蜡烛卡二次确认提示
Languages: Remnant Fire +3 to current Riddle after use.

mTerms.Term: 使用加分卡二次确认提示
Languages: 使用后下次解谜成功获得双倍烂柯分
Double Lanke Points for the next successful riddle solving after use.
使用後下次解謎成功獲得雙倍爛柯分
历经千辛万苦，出口近在眼前。秘境中影响道心的一些想法也渐渐消散，剑灵和狻猊望着你，露出欣赏的表情。但此时一个与众不同的念头却在你心里萌发。

After a thousand hardships, the exit is close at hand. Some of the thoughts in the secret realm that were affecting the Dao Mindset also gradually dissipated, and the Sword Spirit and Suanni looked at you with an appreciative expression. But at this moment a distinctive thought sprouted in your heart.
歷經千辛萬苦，出口近在眼前。秘境中影響道心的一些想法也漸漸消散，劍靈和狻猊望著你，露出欣賞的表情。但此時一個與眾不同的念頭卻在你心裏萌發。
乏了，累了，困了，倦了，就这样吧。（通关秘境，烂柯分+20，剩余烛火转化为烂柯分）
Bored, tired, sleepy, weary, and so be it. ( passed the secret realm, Lanke points +20, remaining Candle Flame converted to Lanke points )
乏了，累了，困了，倦了，就這樣吧。（通關秘境，爛柯分+20，剩余燭火轉化為爛柯分）
冲回秘境，继续探索！（进入无尽模式，可能出现非当前主题谜题，每层烛火-1）
Dash back to the secret realm and continue exploring! (Entering Endless Mode, non-currently themed riddles may appear, Candle Flame -1 per level)
沖回秘境，繼續探索！（進入無盡模式，可能出現非當前主題謎題，每層燭火-1）
秘境中弥漫的一类气息让你觉得不安，你开始质疑，所谓的仙府秘境，以及补天之计，如果都只是天元弈贤天尊和剑灵的阴谋，那三洲岂不是要陷入万劫不复之地。每思至此，便有一阵寒意直击天灵，你决定：

The type of aura that permeates the secret realm makes you feel disturbed, and you begin to question, the so-called secret realm of the Immortal Palace, as well as the plan of Heavenly Path Restoration, if all of them are just a conspiracy of the Immortal of TianYuan YiXian and the Sword Spirit, then wouldn't the three continents be plunged into the land of doom and gloom? Every time you think about this, there is a chill that strikes your mind, and you decide:
秘境中彌漫的一類氣息讓你覺得不安，你開始質疑，所謂的仙府秘境，以及補天之計，如果都只是天元弈賢天尊和劍靈的陰謀，那三洲豈不是要陷入萬劫不復之地。每思至此，便有一陣寒意直擊天靈，你決定：
燃烛取暖振奋精神。（烛火-3，积分令+1）
Burning a candle for warmth invigorates the spirit. (Candle Flame -3, Lanke Point Token +1)
燃燭取暖振奮精神。（燭火-3，積分令+1）
多点几支蜡烛，定要驱散这不安气息。（烛火-1，发牌令+1）
Light a few more candles, and make sure to dispel the unsettling aura. (Candle Flame -1, Card Dealing Token +1)
多點幾支蠟燭，定要驅散這不安氣息。（燭火-1，發牌令+1）
万事不决，打坐保全。（烛火+1）
All things are undecided, meditate to preserve. (Candle Flame +1)
萬事不決，打坐保全。（燭火+1）
你看见远处迷雾中，隐约有狻猊的身影。也许能成为一只神兽也不错，每日不是静坐就是睡觉，睡醒了享用修士进贡的香火，感到无趣可以进秘境大闹一番。不像寻常修士每日尽做些劳什子功课。不好，刚想完这些，狻猊便往你方向飞来，难不成祂有读心之术？

You see the figure of Suanni faintly in the mist far away. Maybe it's not bad to become a divine beast, every day either sitting or sleeping, wake up to enjoy the incense paid by the cultivators, and if you feel bored, you can go into the secret realm to make a big fuss. Unlike ordinary cultivators to do some laborious homework every day. oh no, you just finished thinking about these, Suanni is flying in the direction of you, is it possible that it has the ability to read minds?
你看見遠處迷霧中，隱約有狻猊的身影。也許能成為一只神獸也不錯，每日不是靜坐就是睡覺，睡醒了享用修士進貢的香火，感到無趣可以進秘境大鬧一番。不像尋常修士每日盡做些勞什子功課。不好，剛想完這些，狻猊便往你方向飛來，難不成祂有讀心之術？
来都来了，要些补给（蜡烛令+1）
I'm here anyway. How about some supplies ? (Candle Token +1)
來都來了，要些補給（蠟燭令+1）
承诺下次相遇带上神品檀香，这次先委屈一下。（烛火-3，揭谜令+1）
Promise it that you will bring it a sacred sandalwood incense when you meet it next time. (Candle Flame -3, Riddle Revealing Token +1)
承諾下次相遇帶上神品檀香，這次先委屈一下。（燭火-3，揭謎令+1）
万事不决，打坐保全。（烛火+1）
All things are undecided, meditate to preserve. (Candle Flame +1)
萬事不決，打坐保全。（燭火+1）
眼见秘境中其他修士千奇百怪的招式，你觉得有些乏了，学来又如何，三洲修士不入返虚，出了秘境也只空得一身虚招，终究还是斗不过化神长老，更难谈对抗魔修者。但是转念一想，能学到其他宗门的招式，做一个纵横三洲的百变修士，倒也有几分逍遥派的风范了？

Seeing the secret realm of other cultivators in a thousand strange moves, you feel a little bored, all learned and what can be done? Cultivators in the three continents do not enter the Divinity Phase, we get nothing after leaving the secret realm, after all, we can't fight the Incarnation Phase Elders, and it's even harder to talk about fighting against the demonic cultivators. However, on second thought, you can learn the moves of other sects, and become a cultivator of a hundred changes across the three continents, like the cultivators of Xiaoyao sect?
眼見秘境中其他修士千奇百怪的招式，你覺得有些乏了，學來又如何，三洲修士不入返虛，出了秘境也只空得一身虛招，終究還是鬥不過化神長老，更難談對抗魔修者。但是轉念一想，能學到其他宗門的招式，做一個縱橫三洲的百變修士，倒也有幾分逍遙派的風範了？
这便多学几招（烛火-1，发牌令+1）
Let's learn a few more tricks right away (Candle Flame -1, Card Dealing Token +1)
這便多學幾招（燭火-1，發牌令+1）
这秘境乱人道心，怕是有魔气入侵？稳住道心，照亮前方道路。（烛火-3，揭谜令+1）
This secret realm is messing with people's Dao Mindset. You're afraid of a demonic invasion? Stabilize the Dao Mindset and illuminate the path ahead. (Candle Flame -3, Riddle Revealing Token +1)
這秘境亂人道心，怕是有魔氣入侵？穩住道心，照亮前方道路。（燭火-3，揭謎令+1）
万事不决，打坐保全。（烛火+1）
All things are undecided, meditate to preserve. (Candle Flame +1)
萬事不決，打坐保全。（燭火+1）
你瞧见秘境一处角落布满了蜘蛛网，为什么秘境也会脏？等你扒开厚实的蜘蛛网，下边露出一个散发着朽木气味的箱子，开口处锁着颇为古式的铜锁，没有钥匙，不如动粗将其砸了？你开始期待箱子里有什么，会不会有天尊遗留在此处的至宝。

You see a corner of the secret realm covered in cobwebs, why would the secret realm be dirty too? When you peel back the thick cobwebs, a chest smelling of rotten wood is revealed underneath, and the opening is locked with a copper lock in a rather ancient style; there's no key, so why not smash it roughly? You begin to anticipate what's in the chest, will there be a supreme treasure left here by the immoral of Yixian?
你瞧見秘境一處角落布滿了蜘蛛網，為什麼秘境也會臟？等你扒開厚實的蜘蛛網，下邊露出一個散發著朽木氣味的箱子，開口處鎖著頗為古式的銅鎖，沒有鑰匙，不如動粗將其砸了？你開始期待箱子裏有什麼，會不會有天尊遺留在此處的至寶。
蜡烛！更多的蜡烛！（蜡烛令+2）
蠟燭！更多的蠟燭！（蠟燭令+2）
八脉神剑、伏羲奇门、三昧真火、降龙伏虎拳……（发牌令+2）
Eight Veins Divine Sword, Fuxi Chimen, Samadhi True Fire, Dragon Subduing Tiger Fist ...... (Card Dealing Token +2)
八脈神劍、伏羲奇門、三昧真火、降龍伏虎拳……（發牌令+2）
万事不决，打坐保全。（烛火+1）
All things are undecided, meditate to preserve. (Candle Flame +1)
萬事不決，打坐保全。（燭火+1）
你似乎看见了玄巳的身影，这妖人被剑灵通缉后还敢进秘境。真不怕被剑灵知道后把整个暗谷都给端了？

You seem to have seen the figure of Xuan Si, this demon who dares to enter the secret realm after being wanted by the Sword Spirit. Is he really not afraid of being known by the Sword Spirit and put an end to the entire Dark Valley?
你似乎看見了玄巳的身影，這妖人被劍靈通緝後還敢進秘境。真不怕被劍靈知道後把整個暗谷都給端了？
喜欢看热闹，告知狻猊。（烂柯分+3）
You like to watch the fun and inform the Suanni. (Lanke points +3)
喜歡看熱鬧，告知狻猊。（爛柯分+3）
向玄巳要些见面礼。（烛火-3，发牌令+1，积分令+1）
Ask Xuan Si for some meet and greet gifts. (Candle Flame -3, Card Dealing Token +1, Lanke Point Token +1)
向玄巳要些見面禮。（燭火-3，發牌令+1，積分令+1）
偶遇一衣着破烂修士，他说，凡人需要财富，修士也讲究个法财侣地。无财，仙也修不成。
You met a tattered cultivator, he said, mortals need wealth, cultivators also pay attention to wealth, method, mate and place. Without wealth, you can't cultivate immortality.
偶遇一衣著破爛修士，他說，凡人需要財富，修士也講究個法財侶地。無財，仙也修不成。
你突然觉得秘境历练毫无意义，好不容易攒下的修为，一出秘境便化为乌有，只能记下一招半式。然而境界未到，招式使起来也威力大减，倒不如留在宗门静心修炼来得妥当。

Suddenly, you feel that the secret realm training is meaningless, and the cultivation that was saved with great difficulty will vanish as soon as you get out of the secret realm, and you can only memorize one or half moves. However, your level has not yet reached, and the power of your moves has been greatly reduced, so it would be better to just stay in the sect to meditate and cultivate.
你突然覺得秘境歷練毫無意義，好不容易攢下的修為，一出秘境便化為烏有，只能記下一招半式。然而境界未到，招式使起來也威力大減，倒不如留在宗門靜心修煉來得妥當。
深以为然，快速通关。（烛火-3，揭谜令+1）
Deeply concerned, let's quick pass. (Candle Flame -3, Riddle Revealing Token +1)
深以為然，快速通關。（燭火-3，揭謎令+1）
坚守道心，在哪修炼不是修炼。对了，方才那招叫什么来着…（烛火-1，发牌令+1）
Holding on to the Dao Mindset, wherever you cultivate is cultivation. By the way, what was that move called just now... (Candle Flame -1, Card Dealing Token +1)
堅守道心，在哪修煉不是修煉。對了，方才那招叫什麼來著…（燭火-1，發牌令+1）
万事不决，打坐保全。（烛火+1）
All things are undecided, meditate to preserve. (Candle Flame +1)
萬事不決，打坐保全。（燭火+1）
补天之计，乍看之下是奉天道损有余而补不足，实则损己利他，于修行无益。一些道友对此计的热忱劲头，颇为让人费解。如何看待弈仙府的补天之计呢？

The plan of Heavenly Path Restoration, at first glance, it seems to be following the Heavenly Path to make up for the lack of loss, but in fact, it is harmful to oneself and benefit others, and it is not beneficial to the cultivation at all. The enthusiasm of some fellow Daoists for this plan is quite confusing. How do you think about the Yixian palace's plan of Heavenly Path Restoration?
補天之計，乍看之下是奉天道損有余而補不足，實則損己利他，於修行無益。一些道友對此計的熱忱勁頭，頗為讓人費解。如何看待弈仙府的補天之計呢？
披荆斩棘！战斗！爽！（烛火-1，发牌令+1）
Battle! Great! (Candle Flame -1, Card Dealing Token +1)
披荊斬棘！戰鬥！爽！（燭火-1，發牌令+1）
剑灵尽设计些既诡异又无趣的秘境，逼迫修士参加，真怀疑祂和魔物是一伙的，来扰人清修！想到此你后颈一凉，一转头，发现狻猊饶有兴致地打量着你。见鬼！不会又让祂听到了吧！

The sword spirit designs some weird and uninteresting secret realms to force the cultivators to participate, and you really suspect that she and the devils are in this together to disturb people's cultivation! A chill runs down the back of your neck as you think about this, and when you turn your head, you realize that the Suanni is looking at you with interest. Damn it! It won't be possible for it to overhear you again!
劍靈盡設計些既詭異又無趣的秘境，逼迫修士參加，真懷疑祂和魔物是一夥的，來擾人清修！想到此你後頸一涼，一轉頭，發現狻猊饒有興致地打量著你。見鬼！不會又讓祂聽到了吧！
好狻猊，你什么都没听见。（烛火-3，积分令+1）
Good Suanni, you heard nothing. (Candle Flame -3, Lanke Point Token +1)
好狻猊，你什麼都沒聽見。（燭火-3，積分令+1）
你去！去跟剑灵告状好了！我要上报弈贤天尊！我要投诉祂！（烛火-1，发牌令+1）
You go! Go and tell the Sword Spirit! I'm going to report to the immortal Yixian! I'm going to complain to Him! (Candle Flame -1, Card Dealing Token +1)
你去！去跟劍靈告狀好了！我要上報弈賢天尊！我要投訴祂！（燭火-1，發牌令+1）
All things are undecided, meditate to preserve. (Candle Flame +1)
前方有巨石拦路，你在想，如果有一招，积蓄了剑意、星力、锋锐以及气势，那这一招下去，巨石岂不是碎成齑粉？

There was a huge rock blocking the road ahead, and you were thinking that if there was a move that built up Sword Intent, Star Power, Penetrate, as well as Force, wouldn't the rock shatter into pieces when this move went down?
前方有巨石攔路，你在想，如果有一招，積蓄了劍意、星力、鋒銳以及氣勢，那這一招下去，巨石豈不是碎成齏粉？
这便将其碾为齑粉！（烛火-4，发牌令+4）
I will crush it to pieces right away! (Candle Flame -4, Card Dealing Token +4)
這便將其碾為齏粉！（燭火-4，發牌令+4）
停手，乱练招式走火入魔可不妙。（烛火+1）
Stop, practicing moves indiscriminately and I'll easily get Deviation Syndrome. (Candle Flame +1)
停手，亂練招式走火入魔可不妙。（燭火+1）
既然秘境可以影响道心，那么道心是否反过来也可以影响秘境？比如此时你在想能不能跳过过程，直达秘境终点。

Since the secret realm can influence the Dao Mindset, can the Dao Mindset in turn influence the secret realm? For example, at this point you are wondering if you can skip the process and go straight to the end of the secret realm.
既然秘境可以影響道心，那麼道心是否反過來也可以影響秘境？比如此時你在想能不能跳過過程，直達秘境終點。
修士的一小步，秘境探索的一大步。（烛火-3，揭谜令+1）
One small step for a cultivator, one giant leap for secret realm exploration. (Candle Flame -3, Riddle Revealing Token +1)
修士的一小步，秘境探索的一大步。（燭火-3，揭謎令+1）
施展身法，一路向前。（烛火-9，揭谜令+3）
Show your Agility and make your way forward. (Candle Flame -9, Riddle Revealing Token +3)
施展身法，一路向前。（燭火-9，揭謎令+3）
万事不决，打坐保全。（烛火+1）
All things are undecided, meditate to preserve. (Candle Flame +1)
萬事不決，打坐保全。（燭火+1）
在秘境千变万化的环境中，亦有不变之物。那便是一颗坚定不移的道心，不受变幻影响，保护修士安然前行。

In the ever-changing environment of the secret realm, there is something that remains unchanged. That is an unwavering Dao Mindset that is unaffected by change and protects the cultivators as they move forward in peace.
在秘境千變萬化的環境中，亦有不變之物。那便是一顆堅定不移的道心，不受變幻影響，保護修士安然前行。
你突然悟了！秘境变化多端，扰人心神。何不眼睛一闭，做到眼不见心不烦。
You're suddenly enlightened! The secret realm is full of changes, disturbing the mind. Why don't you close your eyes and achieve sightlessness.
你突然悟了！秘境變化多端，擾人心神。何不眼睛一閉，做到眼不見心不煩。
蜡烛也不点了，索性摸黑前进。（蜡烛令+1）
I don't even light candles anymore, so I just move forward in the dark. (Candle Token +1)
蠟燭也不點了，索性摸黑前進。（蠟燭令+1）
运气调息，摆脱奇怪的想法（烛火-1，发牌令+1）
Adjust your Qi to get rid of strange thoughts (Candle Flame -1, Card Dealing Token +1)
運氣調息，擺脫奇怪的想法（燭火-1，發牌令+1）
天色渐黑，眼前出现一座五彩斑斓的湖泊，踏入湖中，神识渐渐涣散。不好！是衔月楼的梦湖！
As the sky grew dark, a colorful lake appeared in front of you, and as you stepped into the lake, your Divine Sense gradually lapsed. Oh no! It was the Dream Lake of the Moon Pavilion!

报名：支付100灵石报名参赛。本届比赛每个账号最多可报名参与5次。

赛程：每次报名后需参加3局初赛，入围决赛后参加1局决赛。两局比赛之间可自由休息，无需连续完成。

初赛：随机匹配8名初赛选手，根据名次获得积分：第一名100分，第二名90分，第三名80分，之后依次递减，同轮淘汰多人时取名次平均分。3局初赛后总积分200分及以上可参加决赛。

决赛：随机匹配8名决赛选手，1局决定排名。（匹配时会优先将初赛总积分不同的选手匹配到一起，同轮淘汰多人时初赛积分高者名次靠前）

奖励：参与并完成决赛即可获得比赛卡背“登天路“（重复获得转化为500灵石）。决赛前3名分别获得冠军道印和2000灵石、亚军道印和1000灵石、季军道印和500灵石。比赛道印均为永久，重复获得相同比赛道印会在描述中累加获得次数。

Registration: The registration fee is 100 spirit stones. Each plyaer can register up to 3 times.

Match: You need to participate in 3 preliminary games after each registration and 1 final game after being shortlisted for the finals. You are free to take a break between two games and do not need to complete them consecutively.

Preliminary Games: 8 players will be randomly matched. Points will be awarded based on rankings: 1st place receives 100 points, 2nd place 90 points, 3rd place 80 points, and so on. If multiple players are eliminated in the same round, they receive average points of ranking. Players who accumulate 200 points or more can participate in the final.

Final Game: 8 finalists will be randomly matched, and the ranking will be determined in a single game. (If multiple players are eliminated in the same round, those with higher preliminary scores will get better ranking)

Rewards: Participants who complete the final round will receive the card back "Ascending to Heaven Road" (repeated rewards will be converted into 500 spirit stones). The top 3 finalists will receive the Champion's Dao Seal and 2000 spirit stones, the Runner-up's Dao Seal and 1000 spirit stones, and the Third Place's Dao Seal and 500 spirit stones, respectively. The Dao Seal are permanent. If the same Dao Seal is obtained repeatedly, the number of acquisitions will be displayed in its description.

Languages:
机制：无（来自第一赛季：风起弈仙，以及之前版本）

不启用赛季机制，只使用弈仙牌基础玩法。

Mechanism: None (from Season 1: Wind Rise, and previous versions)

Do not enable the season mechanic, only use the base gameplay of the Yi Xian.

機制：無（來自第一賽季：風起弈仙，以及之前版本）

不啓用賽季機制，只使用弈仙牌基礎玩法。

机制：气运（来自第二赛季：鸿蒙气运）

获得气运：
初始拥有1气运。
每局游戏随机2轮为气运之战，获胜加2气运，失败加1气运。

使用气运：
选择道韵时，可耗1气运刷新选项（有概率出现秘术牌）。
选择仙命时，可耗1气运刷新选项（秘传仙命出现率增加）。
换牌机会为0时，可耗1气运换牌（当前境界或低一个境界的牌出现率增加）。

Mechanism: Luck (from Season 2: Genesis Fate)

Gain Luck: 
Start with 1 Luck.
Randomly 2 rounds per game will become Battle of Fate. You will gain 2 Luck for winning in the Battle of Fate, and 1 Luck for losing.

Use Luck:
When selecting Rhyme Omen, you can spend 1 Luck to refresh the options (with a chance of getting Secret Enchantment Cards).
When selecting Immortal Fates, you can spend 1 Luck to refresh the options (increasing the chance of getting a Legendary Immortal Fate).
When your Exchange Card Chance is at 0, you can spend 1 Luck to exchange card (increasing the chance of getting cards from your current phase or one phase below).

機制：氣運（來自第二賽季：鴻蒙氣運）

獲得氣運：
初始擁有1氣運。
每局游戲隨機2輪爲氣運之戰，獲勝加2氣運，失敗加1氣運。

使用氣運：
選擇道韵時，可耗1氣運刷新選項（有概率出現秘術牌）。
選擇仙命時，可耗1氣運刷新選項（秘傳仙命出現率增加）。
換牌機會爲0時，可耗1氣運換牌（當前境界或低一個境界的牌出現率增加）。

机制：命坊（来自第三赛季：玄心命坊）

命坊：
第5轮及之后会开启命坊，可花费命元购买商品

商品：
每局游戏每名道友会看到相同的4样商品。其中门派牌和副职业牌会在相同境界下随机。

打折：
每过一轮，命坊中随机1样商品会降价约25%（取整）。每名道友打折的商品相同。

Mechanism: Life Shop (from Season 3: Life Shop)

Life Shop: 
Life Shop will be opened in round 5, where you can spend Destiny to buy commodities.

Commodities: 
Each player will see the same list of 4 commodities in each game (with the Sect Cards and Side Job Cards being randomized within the same Phase).

Discount:
Every round, the price of one random commodity in the Life Shop will be reduced by about 25% (rounded).

機制：命坊（來自第三賽季：玄心命坊）

命坊：
第5輪及之後會開啓命坊，可花費命元購買商品

商品：
每局游戲每名道友會看到相同的4樣商品。其中門派牌和副職業牌會在相同境界下隨機。

打折：
每過一輪，命坊中隨機1樣商品會降價約25%（取整）。每名道友打折的商品相同。

机制：命运分支（来自第四赛季：命运轮回）

命运分支：
每局游戏第一轮时，可从“我命由我”或其他3个随机命运分支中选择1个生效。
其中“我命由我”为固定可选项，效果为：每次突破境界时可以刷新1次仙命选项，若不刷新则加1换牌机会。

不同的命运分支会改变角色未来的仙命选项、道韵选项、牌池组成或其他影响游戏进程的因素，让未来变得更加稳定或者更加不确定。部分命运分支会影响初始命元。

Mechanism: Fate Branches (from Season 4: Cycle of Fate)

Fate Branches:
In the first round of each game, you may choose one from 3 random Fate Branches or "My Fate, My Choice". Some Fate Branches will modify Destiny.

機制：命運分支（來自第四賽季：命運輪回）

命運分支：
每局游戲第一輪時，可從“我命由我”或其他3個隨機命運分支中選擇1個生效。
其中“我命由我”爲固定可選項，效果爲：每次突破境界時可以刷新1次仙命選項，若不刷新則加1換牌機會。

不同的命運分支會改變角色未來的仙命選項、道韵選項、牌池組成或其他影響游戲進程的因素，讓未來變得更加穩定或者更加不確定。部分命運分支會影響初始命元。

本期玩法——鹊桥会

目标：集齐7张不同图案的牌，并按顺序在卡组7格中拼出鹊桥，然后点击右上角的狻猊即可完成。全程用时越短越好。

操作说明：每张牌会有1个数字提示其正确位置，1～7分别对应卡组中第1～7格。卡牌拖动到左侧炼化后会获得1张数字减1的牌（小于1会变为7）。卡牌拖动到右侧置换时会获得1张数字加1的牌（超过7会变回1）。卡牌拖动到中间空格进行摆放。摆放完成后点击右上角的狻猊，如果符合1～7的摆放顺序则算作完成。

模式说明：普通模式下初始手牌完全随机。困难模式下初始手牌有更高的概率出现重复数字。

Playing in this Issue - Magpie Bridge

Create a Magpie Bridge in the 7 slots of the deck, then click on the Suanni in the upper right corner to complete it. The shorter the time taken for the whole process, the better.

Each card will have 1 number to indicate its correct position, 1~7 corresponds to the 1st~7th slot in the deck respectively. Drag a card to the left to Absorb it and you will get a card with the number minus 1 (less than 1 will change to 7). Drag a card to the right to Exchange it and you will get a card with the number plus 1 (more than 7 will change back to 1). Drag the card to the center space slot to place it. When the placement is complete, click on the Suanni in the upper right corner to judge it, and if it matches the placement order from 1 to 7, it will be counted as complete.

The initial hand in normal mode is completely randomized. In Hard Mode, there is a higher probability of duplicate numbers appearing on the initial hand, and more steps are required to complete the game.

mTerms.Term: 仙府遗迹赛季机制说明
Languages:
每局开始会进行投票，根据投票比例权重随机一个法器为本局所有角色使用。
可以根据遗迹法器中显示的融汇公式将指定两张牌在手牌中合成一张全新的融汇牌（等级取两张牌平均，向下取整）。

At the beginning of each game, a vote will be held and a random Relic will be used by all characters in the game according to the voting proportion weight.
You can fuse a new Fusion card from the designated two cards in the hand according to the Fusion Recipe displayed in the Relics (the level of the new card is the average of two old cards, rounded down).

每局開始會進行投票，根據投票比例權重隨機一個法器為本局所有角色使用。
可以根據遺跡法器中顯示的融匯公式將指定兩張牌在手牌中合成一張全新的融匯牌（等級取兩張牌平均，向下取整）。

相传天元弈贤天尊飞升之时，解己之躯，其灵枢五脏各化神通。是肝木书真言，得万卷书阁；心火燃熔炉，成太虚熔炉；脾土连穹宇，合昆仑门扉；肺金铸星镜，为星图画镜；肾水汇玄壶，聚玄冥玉壶。

今剑灵与狻猊于仙府秘境深处掸尘之时，寻至一府库。此府库年久失修，又因三洲修士行走秘境而染上凡尘，乍看之下与寻常府库并无差异。然剑灵使狻猊收去此间久积之尘时，那五件法器重得仙府灵气，神通再现。剑灵大喜，运法器出府库，寻了府库外一处空地摆了，对外名此地为仙府遗迹，望各路修士可借天尊法器之神通，得修为更进一步。

却说那弈贤天尊得道后，使那五件法器作为何用：

万卷书阁，为肝木所书，言尽人间学，阅尽登仙。却说天尊早年与道友博戏之时，输赢皆有，而输时常肝生燥气，不利修行。天尊口吐燥气为真言，又真言化书页收于一书阁之上。日久，书阁竟自合书页为书，成一本《博戏仙经》，此经天尊读罢博力大涨，遂大喜，搜罗天下法门藏于书阁。书阁藏书渐丰，后生有幸阅之仙道畅通矣。后天尊因输博戏而返书阁寻仙经。因书有万卷之多，又常有他者翻阅，颇为凌乱，遂天尊寻经而不得，博戏又输，愠，封书阁不允他人再进。

太虚熔炉，为心火所燃，可熔炼万物，合而为一。此炉置仙草而炼可得灵丹，食之与天地同寿。而弈贤天尊却燃熔炉而造牌具，是棋子、骰子、叶子骨牌，天下博戏之物，此炉皆可炼出。炉中常聚天尊之炁，所出之物颇具灵威。

昆仑门扉，为脾土所通，混沌生寰宇，一门至之。初，天尊常以此门扉越行于天地之间。天穹破碎后，天尊欲以其强行连通三洲大陆与外界八荒，重塑九洲大陆。然因大道破碎，门扉土灵已尽而三洲如初。天尊方悟以大道碎片补天乃为正道，故而门扉遭弃，世间再无越行之法的传说。

星图画镜，为肺金所铸，照镜不显身，而显万象。此镜以太白为中心，画二十八星宿入镜，四方幻化世间万物，呼吸之间作天下观。天尊照此镜，可使星图轮转，摘星换斗间，可移万物。而天尊以此镜作博戏，又可生博戏变化。是以天尊棋友以天尊玩赖为由，不允天尊使此镜。遂此镜为天尊弃用多时，先前不知所踪。

玄冥玉壶，为肾水所汇，真水归于堂，一壶承之。此壶只方寸，却可聚江河湖泽之水，百川尽而壶不满。又可倾倒而出，引百川奔流，漫三洲而水不竭。壶中之水不可饮，倾倒而出不可浴，需以真火炼之方得炁。其炁散于四周稠若琼浆，修者引其入丹田如入幽冥，常感清净。是故天尊每输棋时，引壶中真水以消愠，常此，天尊棋力大涨，此玉壶亦无需再使也。

近六甲子已过，昆仑门扉已随弈仙府感天地灵气多时，终重启越行之能。一日，忽感另一时空有“虚空之阵”，以上古五神器为引，并以昆仑镜为核心，便可返回西方魔界降临前，修补天之痕。昆仑门扉遂大开，欲效仿其法，平妖魔之乱，弥天道之狭。各宗弟子前去探查，竟不经意间来到一片叫“大隋”的国土......

Legend has it that when The Immortal of TianYuan YiXian ascended, he unraveled his body, and each of his spiritual five organs was transformed into a divine power. Among the five divine relics, the wood of the liver writes, into the Shelf of Wisdom. The fire of the heart burns, into the Furnace of Void. The gold of the Lungs forged, into the Mirror of Stars. The water of the Kidney gathered, into the Pot of Xuanming.

Today, when the Sword Spirit and the Suanni were dusting in the depths of the secret realm of the Yixian Palace, they found a storehouse. The storehouse had been in disrepair for a long time, and had been stained with mortal dust by the cultivators from the three continents who had traveled through the secret realm, so at first glance, it looked no different from an ordinary storehouse. However, when the Sword Spirit made the Suanni collect the dust, the five relics regained the qi of the Immortal Palace, and their magical powers reappeared. Sword Spirit was very pleased, transported the relics out of the storehouse, looking for an open space outside the storehouse, named this place as the relic of the Yixian Palace, and hoped that all cultivators could borrow the magical powers of the Immortal of TianYuan YiXian's relics to further their cultivation.

The master TianYuan YiXian, after becoming immortal, made his relics for what use: 

The Shelf of Wisdom, for the liver wood book, words all the earthly learning, read all the ascension to immortality. The Immortal of YiXian said that in his early years, when he was playing with his friends, he won and lost, and when he lost, his liver was often dry, which was not conducive to cultivation. The Immortal of YiXian spit out dry Qi for the true words, and the true words into a book page collected on top of a shelf. Long days, the book pages turned into a book ‘Bo play immortal scripture’, the Immortal of YiXian read the Bo force greatly increased, and then rejoice, searching for the world of the method of hiding in the book shelf. The book shelf collection of books is gradually abundant, the latter is fortunate to read the immortal way unimpeded carry on. The Immortal of YiXian lost the game and returned to the book shelf to find the ‘Bo play immortal scripture’, because the book has more than 10,000 volumes, and often have other people read, quite messy, The Immortal of YiXian can not find the scripture, and his Bo play lost again, then he was angry, sealed the book shelf does not allow others to access again.

The Furnace of Void is the fire of the heart, which can melt all things and make them one. This furnace is capable of producing elixir by placing immortal grasses in it, and one can live the same life as heaven and earth by consuming it. The Immortal of TianYuan YiXian, however, burns the furnace to create cards, chess, dice, dominoes, the world's games, all can be refined in this furnace. The furnace is often gathered in the air of the immortal of Yixian, so that the things it produces are quite spiritual and powerful.

The Door of Kunlun is the earth of the spleen, a door to the chaos of the cosmos. At the beginning, the immortal of Yixian often use this doorway to cross between heaven and earth. After the dome of heaven was broken, the immortal of Yixian wanted to use it to forcibly connect the three continents with the outside world and remake the olden nine continents. However, due to the shattering of the Great Rule, the earth spirit of the doorway was exhausted while the three continents remained intact. The immortal of Yixian came to realise that it was the only way to mend the sky with the Rule Fragment, so the doorway was abandoned, and there was no more legend of the method of transgressing the boundaries of the world.

The Mirror of Stars is the gold of the lungs, which does not show the person who looking at it, but show all the images of the world. This mirror set the white star as the center, painting twenty-eight stars into the mirror, it shows the illusion of all things in the world around, allow the own to watch the world between breaths. When immortal of Yixian look at this mirror, the star chart will rotate, picking the stars to change the sky, which gather the power to move all things in the world. And the immortal of Yixian use this mirror to play games, as it can generate changes in the game. The immortal of Yixian's game friends refused to allow him to use this mirror on the grounds that he was cheating on the game. So this mirror for immortal of Yixian abandoned for a long time, and was lost for years.

The Pot of Xuanming , for the kidney water convergence, true water to the hall, a pot to bear. This pot is only a square inch, but can gather the water of rivers and lakes till the end of the hundred rivers and the pot is not full. And the water of Xuanming pot can be poured out, drawing a hundred rivers running, diffuse three continents and water is not exhausted. The water in the pot can not drink, pouring out can not be bath, need to refine the real fire to turn the water into Qi. The Qi dispersed in the surrounding thick like agar, when cultivators lead it into they dantian, they will enter the netherworld, and always feel peaceful. Therefore, every time the immortal of Yixian lose a game, He will draw the real water in the pot to eliminate his anger, often so, the immortal of Yixian's game power rises greatly, and this jade pot does not need to be used again.

Nearly six years of JiaZi have passed, the Door of Kunlun has been experienced the spiritual Qi of heaven and earth with Yi Xian Palace, and finally restarted the ability to traverse. One day, it suddenly feel another time and space called“Void Formation”, returning people to the time before the advent of the Western Demonic World and mending the sky with the five ancient artifacts as guide  and Kunlun Mirror as the core. The door of Kunlun was then opened wide, wanting to emulate its method to calm the chaos of demons and make up for the cracks of the heavenly path. Disciples of various sects went to investigate, but inadvertently came to territory called “Great Sui” ......

相傳天元弈賢天尊飛升之時，解己之軀，其靈樞五臟各化神通。是肝木書真言，得萬卷書閣；心火燃熔爐，成太虛熔爐；脾土連穹宇，合昆侖門扉；肺金鑄星鏡，為星圖畫鏡；腎水匯玄壺，聚玄冥玉壺。

今劍靈與狻猊於仙府秘境深處撣塵之時，尋至一府庫。此府庫年久失修，又因三洲修士行走秘境而染上凡塵，乍看之下與尋常府庫並無差異。然劍靈使狻猊收去此間久積之塵時，那五件法器重得仙府靈氣，神通再現。劍靈大喜，運法器出府庫，尋了府庫外一處空地擺了，對外名此地為仙府遺跡，望各路修士可借天尊法器之神通，得修為更進一步。

卻說那弈賢天尊得道後，使那五件法器作為何用：

萬卷書閣，為肝木所書，言盡人間學，閱盡登仙。卻說天尊早年與道友博戲之時，輸贏皆有，而輸時常肝生燥氣，不利修行。天尊口吐燥氣為真言，又真言化書頁收於一書閣之上。日久，書閣竟自合書頁為書，成一本《博戲仙經》，此經天尊讀罷博力大漲，遂大喜，搜羅天下法門藏於書閣。書閣藏書漸豐，後生有幸閱之仙道暢通矣。後天尊因輸博戲而返書閣尋仙經。因書有萬卷之多，又常有他者翻閱，頗為淩亂，遂天尊尋經而不得，博戲又輸，慍，封書閣不允他人再進。

太虛熔爐，為心火所燃，可熔煉萬物，合而為一。此爐置仙草而煉可得靈丹，食之與天地同壽。而弈賢天尊卻燃熔爐而造牌具，是棋子、骰子、葉子骨牌，天下博戲之物，此爐皆可煉出。爐中常聚天尊之炁，所出之物頗具靈威。

昆侖門扉，為脾土所通，混沌生寰宇，一門至之。初，天尊常以此門扉越行於天地之間。天穹破碎後，天尊欲以其強行連通三洲大陸與外界八荒，重塑九洲大陸。然因大道破碎，門扉土靈已盡而三洲如初。天尊方悟以大道碎片補天乃為正道，故而門扉遭棄，世間再無越行之法的傳說。

星圖畫鏡，為肺金所鑄，照鏡不顯身，而顯萬象。此鏡以太白為中心，畫二十八星宿入鏡，四方幻化世間萬物，呼吸之間作天下觀。天尊照此鏡，可使星圖輪轉，摘星換鬥間，可移萬物。而天尊以此鏡作博戲，又可生博戲變化。是以天尊棋友以天尊玩賴為由，不允天尊使此鏡。遂此鏡為天尊棄用多時，先前不知所蹤。

玄冥玉壺，為腎水所匯，真水歸於堂，一壺承之。此壺只方寸，卻可聚江河湖澤之水，百川盡而壺不滿。又可傾倒而出，引百川奔流，漫三洲而水不竭。壺中之水不可飲，傾倒而出不可浴，需以真火煉之方得炁。其炁散於四周稠若瓊漿，修者引其入丹田如入幽冥，常感清凈。是故天尊每輸棋時，引壺中真水以消慍，常此，天尊棋力大漲，此玉壺亦無需再使也。

近六甲子已過，昆侖門扉已隨弈仙府感天地靈氣多時，終重啟越行之能。一日，忽感另一時空有「虛空之陣」，以上古五神器為引，並以昆侖鏡為核心，便可返回西方魔界降臨前，修補天之痕。昆侖門扉遂大開，欲效仿其法，平妖魔之亂，彌天道之狹。各宗弟子前去探查，竟不經意間來到一片叫「大隋」的國土......

点击右侧按钮开启太虚熔炉，有以下功能：
卡牌存取：可以储存2张牌。放入牌时会加1修为，取出牌时会减1修为。
精华熔炼（每轮限1次）：常规门派牌A+同境界的常规门派牌B（等级高于A）=升级门派牌A

Click the button in the right to open the Furnace of Void, which has the following functions:
Card storage: Can store 2 cards. When a card is placed, gain 1 Cultivation. When the card is removed, lose 1 Cultivation.
Essence Smelt: Regular sect card A + regular sect card B of the same Phase with a higher level than A = upgrade card A. Each round can only be used once.

點擊右側按鈕開啟太虛熔爐，有以下功能：
卡牌存取：可以儲存2張牌。 放入牌時會加1修為，取出牌時會减1修為。
精華熔煉（每輪限1次）：常規門派牌A+同境界的常規門派牌B（等級高於A）=升級門派牌A

点击右侧按钮开启星图画镜，有以下功能：
星图轮转：每轮随机刷新3张门派牌（不受牌池影响），可以锁住防止刷新。
摘星换斗（每轮限1次）：用1张手牌和星图中的1张牌交换。

Click the button on the right to open the Mirror of Stars, which has the following functions:
Stars Refresh: Each round randomly refreshes 3 sect cards, which can be locked to prevent refreshing.
Swap Star: Swap 1 hand card with 1 card from the Mirror of Stars. Each round can only be used once.

點擊右側按鈕開啟星圖畫鏡，有以下功能：
星圖輪轉：每輪隨機刷新3張門派牌（不受牌池影響），可以鎖住防止刷新。
摘星換鬥（每輪限1次）：用1張手牌和星圖中的1張牌交換。

点击右侧按钮开启昆仑门扉，有以下功能：
地点探索：每轮刷新3个地点，可借助昆仑门扉前往探索。每次探索后需要休整数轮昆仑门扉才会再次开启。
轩辕神器：第15轮开始会刷新地点“赤贯星”，探索获取赤贯星后可融汇出轩辕神器。
（从轩辕时空穿越而来的力量较不稳定，相关卡牌均无法升级）

Click the button in the right to open the Door of Kunlun, which has the following functions:
Location Exploration: Three locations are refreshed each round, and you can use the Door of Kunlun to explore them. After each exploration, you need to wait for several rounds of rest before the Door of Kunlun opens again.
Xuan-Yuan Artifact: Starting from the 15th round, the location "Crimson Star" will be refreshed. After exploring and obtaining the Crimson Star, you can fuse the Xuan-Yuan Artifact.
(The power from the Xuan-Yuan is unstable, and related cards cannot be upgraded)

點擊右側按鈕開啓昆侖門扉，有以下功能：
地點探索：每輪刷新3個地點，可借助昆侖門扉前往探索。每次探索後需要休整數輪昆侖門扉才會再次開啓。
軒轅神器：第15輪開始會刷新地點“赤貫星”，探索獲取赤貫星後可融匯出軒轅神器。
（從軒轅時空穿越而來的力量較不穩定，相關卡牌均無法升級）

时间：11月8日至10日，每日18:00至23:59期间开放比赛匹配。其中周五（11月8日）比赛时固定使用太虚熔炉法器，周六（11月9日）固定使用星图画镜法器，周日（11月10日）固定使用玄冥玉壶法器，各位道友可自行决定参赛日期，或每天参赛一次体验不同比赛环境。

报名：本届比赛由弈仙府举办，报名费为100灵石。每名道友最多可报名3次。（最后1小时停止报名，超时未完成比赛自动退还报名费）

赛程：每次报名后需参加3局初赛，入围决赛后参加1局决赛。两局比赛之间可自由休息，无需连续完成。

初赛：随机匹配8名初赛选手，根据名次获得积分：第一名100分，第二名90分，第三名80分，之后依次递减，同轮淘汰多人时取名次平均分。3局初赛后总积分200分及以上可参加决赛。

决赛：随机匹配8名决赛选手，1局决定排名。（匹配时会优先将初赛总积分不同的选手匹配到一起，同轮淘汰多人时初赛积分高者名次靠前）

奖励：参与并完成决赛即可获得卡背“登天路”（重复获得转化为500灵石）。决赛前3名分别获得仙府杯冠军道印和2000灵石、仙府杯亚军道印和1000灵石、仙府杯季军道印和500灵石。道印有效期为永久。重复获得相同名次的道印会在描述中显示获得次数。（例：仙府杯冠军×3）

Time: Matches will be available from 18:00 to 23:59 every day from November 8th to 10th (UTC+8). On Friday, November 8th, the Furnace of Void will be used for the matches. On Saturday, November 9th, the Mirror of Stars will be used. On Sunday, November 10th, the Pot of Xuanming will be used. You can decide your own date for the competition or participate in each day to experience different competition environments.

Registration: The registration fee is 100 spirit stones. Each plyaer can register up to 3 times.

Match: You need to participate in 3 preliminary games after each registration and 1 final game after being shortlisted for the finals. You are free to take a break between two games and do not need to complete them consecutively.

Preliminary Games: 8 players will be randomly matched. Points will be awarded based on rankings: 1st place receives 100 points, 2nd place 90 points, 3rd place 80 points, and so on. If multiple players are eliminated in the same round, they receive average points of ranking. Players who accumulate 200 points or more can participate in the final.

Final Game: 8 finalists will be randomly matched, and the ranking will be determined in a single game. (If multiple players are eliminated in the same round, those with higher preliminary scores will get better ranking)

Rewards: Participants who complete the final round will receive the card back "Ascending to Heaven Road" (repeated rewards will be converted into 500 spirit stones). The top 3 finalists will receive the Champion's Dao Seal and 2000 spirit stones, the Runner-up's Dao Seal and 1000 spirit stones, and the Third Place's Dao Seal and 500 spirit stones, respectively. The Dao Seal are permanent. If the same Dao Seal is obtained repeatedly, the number of acquisitions will be displayed in its description.

時間：11月8日至10日，每日18:00至23:59期間開放比賽匹配。其中周五（11月8日）比賽時固定使用太虛熔爐法器，周六（11月9日）固定使用星圖畫鏡法器，周日（11月10日）固定使用玄冥玉壺法器，各位道友可自行决定參賽日期，或每天參賽一次體驗不同比賽環境。

 報名：本届比賽由弈仙府舉辦，報名費爲100靈石。每名道友最多可報名3次。（最後1小時停止報名，超時未完成比賽自動退還報名費）

 賽程：每次報名後需參加3局初賽，入圍决賽後參加1局决賽。兩局比賽之間可自由休息，無需連續完成。

 初賽：隨機匹配8名初賽選手，根據名次獲得積分：第一名100分，第二名90分，第三名80分，之後依次遞减，同輪淘汰多人時取名次平均分。3局初賽後總積分200分及以上可參加决賽。

 决賽：隨機匹配8名决賽選手，1局决定排名。（匹配時會優先將初賽總積分不同的選手匹配到一起，同輪淘汰多人時初賽積分高者名次靠前）

Xuan-Yuan Sword: The Scar of Sky

当年意气取三州，陈亡顷刻荒丘。卧吟闲看大江流，年少不知仇。
天际赤星将陨，奋起挥剑方遒。故人送罢远回眸，犹忆海边秋。

陈朝皇室遗孤。隋文帝杨坚大肆屠杀陈氏遗族之时，尚在襁褓中的陈靖仇被忠臣陈辅救出，并以“靖北虏，复国仇”命名。可长大后的陈靖仇喜欢诗词与音乐，对复国不感兴趣，只能硬着头皮学些武功和道术。
后结识温柔的于小雪、直爽的拓跋玉儿和豪侠张烈，并逐步发现了隋朝太师宇文拓阴谋的真相。最终，众人前往赤贯星内部组成“失却之阵”，封印“天之痕”，重建了神州九天结界。

Orphan of the Chen Dynasty royal family. When Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, massacred the surviving members of the Chen family, Chen Jingchou, who was still in his infancy, was rescued by loyal minister Chen Fu and named "pacify the north and revive the country". But Chen Jingchou, who grew up, likes poetry and music, and is not interested in restoring his homeland. He can only force himself and learn some martial and magic arts.
Later, he met the gentle Yu Xiaoxue, the straightforward Tuoba Yu‘er, and the heroic Zhang Lie, and gradually discovered the truth behind the conspiracy of the Sui Dynasty's Grand Tutor Yuwen Tuo. In the end, everyone went to the interior of the Crimson Star to form the "Lost Formation" and sealed "The Scar of Sky", and rebuilt the Barrier of the Divine Land.

當年意氣取三州，陳亡頃刻荒丘。臥吟閑看大江流，年少不知仇。
天際赤星將隕，奮起揮劍方遒。故人送罷遠回眸，猶憶海邊秋。

陳朝皇室遺孤。隋文帝楊堅大肆屠殺陳氏遺族之時，尚在繈褓中的陳靖仇被忠臣陳輔救出，並以「靖北虜，復國仇」命名。可長大後的陳靖仇喜歡詩詞與音樂，對復國不感興趣，只能硬著頭皮學些武功和道術。
後結識溫柔的於小雪、直爽的拓跋玉兒和豪俠張烈，並逐步發現了隋朝太師宇文拓陰謀的真相。最終，眾人前往赤貫星內部組成「失卻之陣」，封印「天之痕」，重建了神州九天結界。

神石藏晖坠天阶，寥落此身孑。清霜漫野，孤梅映月，忍羡蝴蝶。
芳心既动融冰雪，誓愿解千结。天合人去，怎堪失却，海上夕斜。

温柔的白发姑娘，出身于偏僻的小村落——月河村。自幼便是孤儿，被客栈老板贺老伯收养。后被村人当成祭品献给河神鲛精，幸得陈靖仇相救，却被当成祸患永久逐出了故乡。在无依无靠之下，与陈靖仇一起旅行。
后在仙山岛仙人的帮助下得知自身乃十大上古神器之一女娲石的转世，并作为失却之阵的核心封印“天之痕”，阻止了西方魔界降临。

A gentle white haired girl comes from a remote small village - Moon River Village. She was an orphan since childhood and was adopted by the innkeeper, Mr. He. Later, she was offered as a sacrifice by the villagers to the river god (Fish demon). Fortunately, she was saved by Chen Jingchou, but was permanently expelled from her hometown as a disaster. In a state of helplessness, she travelled with Chen Jingchou.
Later, with the help of the immortals from Xianshan Island, she learned that she was the reincarnation of Nü wa Stone, one of the ten ancient artifacts, and used it as the core seal of the Lost Formation to prevent the Western demon world from descending.

伏羲曾用一种奇石加上天丝弦制造出一种乐器，谓之——琴；此琴所发出的声音能使人心感到宁静祥和，由于乃神人所制，所以人们相信它还有其他的神力未被发觉。

Fuxi once used a kind of strange stone and heavenly strings to make a kind of musical instrument called Qin; the sound emitted by this qin can make the human heart feel calm and peaceful. Because it was made by a god, people believe that it also has other godly powers that have not yet been discovered.
伏羲曾用一種奇石加上天絲弦製造出一種樂器，謂之——琴；此琴所發出的聲音能使人心感到寧靜祥和，由於乃神人所製，所以人們相信它還有其他的神力未被發覺。
女娲——人类的母亲，她捏土造人、炼石补天，并帮人类收伏了许多妖魔；在炼化五色石中遗留的一块奇石，此石并没有被拿去补天；在人界吸收日月精华后，至今尚存人界之中。

Nüwa - the mother of mankind, she pinched the earth to create people, refining stone to mend the sky, and help mankind to subdue a lot of demons; in the refining of the five-color stone in the legacy of a stone, this stone has not been taken to make up for the sky; absorbing the essence of the sun and the moon, it still exists in the world of human.
女媧——人類的母親，她捏土造人、煉石補天，並幫人類收伏了許多妖魔；在煉化五色石中遺留的一塊奇石，此石並沒有被拿去補天；在人界吸收日月精華後，至今尚存人界之中。
昆仑山是上达天梯的其中一条，其中的路程充满许多艰险，昆仑天宫中有一面神镜；传言此镜拥有自由穿梭时空的能力，但在一次寿旦盛会中被偷至人间至今下落不明。

The Kunlun Mountain is one of the staircases to heaven, which is full of many difficulties and dangers. In the Kunlun Heavenly Palace, there is a divine mirror; it is rumored that this mirror has the ability to freely travel through space and time, but it was stolen to the earth during a birthday banquet and its whereabouts are unknown to this day.
昆侖山是上達天梯的其中一條，其中的路程充滿許多艱險，昆侖天宮中有一面神鏡；傳言此鏡擁有自由穿梭時空的能力，但在一次壽旦盛會中被偷至人間至今下落不明。
天地混沌之初，盘古从睡梦中醒来，见天地如此灰暗，一气之下随手拿出一巨大板斧劈开了天与地；自此便有了我们的世界。后世传言得此斧便能有分天地的力量。

At the beginning of the chaos of heaven and earth, Pangu woke up from his sleep and saw that heaven and earth were so gray, and in a fit of anger, he took out a huge axe and split the heaven and earth; since then, there has been our world. It is rumored that if you have this axe, you will have the power to split heaven and earth.
天地混沌之初，盤古從睡夢中醒來，見天地如此灰暗，一氣之下隨手拿出一巨大板斧劈開了天與地；自此便有了我們的世界。後世傳言得此斧便能有分天地的力量。
下落不明，力量不明。一般传闻它是天界之门，但据天山石窟中诸神时代残留之古老壁文记载：东皇钟乃十大神器力量之首，足以毁天灭地、吞噬诸天。

Its whereabouts and power are unknown. It is generally rumored to be the door to the heavenly realm, but according to the ancient wall writings left over from the era of the gods in the Tianshan Grottoes, the Donghuang Zhong is the head of the Ten Great Artifacts, powerful enough to destroy the world and devour all the heavens.
下落不明，力量不明。一般傳聞它是天界之門，但據天山石窟中諸神時代殘留之古老壁文記載：東皇鐘乃十大神器力量之首，足以毀天滅地、吞噬諸天。
原是女娲神的宝物之一，后辗转成为陈国的皇家之宝。据说拥有不可思议的力量；能造就一切万物，其内部有着奇异的空间，其空间之大似能将天地收纳于内。

It was originally one of the treasures of the god Nüwa, and later became the royal treasure of the Kingdom of Chen. It is said to possess incredible power; it can create all things, and has a strange space inside, which is so big that it seems to be able to contain heaven and earth within it.
原是女媧神的寶物之一，後輾轉成為陳國的皇家之寶。據說擁有不可思議的力量；能造就一切萬物，其內部有著奇異的空間，其空間之大似能將天地收納於內。
原为元始天尊的法宝之一，拥有浩大无边的力量，能降伏一切妖魔邪道，必要时连仙神都可降服；但后因不明的原因流落至人间界。

It was originally one of the treasures of Yuan Shi Tian Zun, possessing immense and boundless power, capable of subduing all demons and evils, and even the immortals and gods could be subdued when necessary; but it was later strayed to the earthly realm due to unknown reasons.
原為元始天尊的法寶之一，擁有浩大無邊的力量，能降伏一切妖魔邪道，必要時連仙神都可降服；但後因不明的原因流落至人間界。
传言早在上古时期便已存在的古印，其印上刻塑有五方天帝的形貌，并有金龙盘绕其上；分别为太皞、炎帝、少昊、颛顼掌东、南、西、北，以及中央的黄帝。

Rumor has it that as early as in the ancient times there has been this ancient seal. The seal is engraved with the shape of the five heavenly emperors, and there is a golden dragon coiled around it; respectively, for Taihao, Emperor Yan, Shao Hao, Zhuan Xu in charge of the East, South, West, North, and the center of the Emperor Huang.
傳言早在上古時期便已存在的古印，其印上刻塑有五方天帝的形貌，並有金龍盤繞其上；分別為太皞、炎帝、少昊、顓頊掌東、南、西、北，以及中央的黃帝。
神农为百姓尝百草、鞭奇药，并用其神鼎炼化出无数仙丹奇药；为后世奠定了医学的基础，传言只要得到鼎想要有什么药就有什么药，要长生不老、百毒不侵也非难事。

Shennong tasted and whipped all kinds of herbs for the people, and refined countless pills with its sacred pot; laid the foundation of medicine for later generations, rumor has it that as long as you get the pot, you will have whatever medicine you want. It's not difficult to live forever and be immune to all kinds of toxins.
神農為百姓嘗百草、鞭奇藥，並用其神鼎煉化出無數仙丹奇藥；為後世奠定了醫學的基礎，傳言只要得到鼎想要有什麽藥就有什麽藥，要長生不老、百毒不侵也非難事。
千年的古剑，传说是黄帝击败蚩尤所用的剑；内蕴藏着用不完的力量，经过日月的交替已经幻化成斩妖除魔的神剑。

An ancient sword of thousands of years, legend says it is the sword used by the Emperor Huang to defeat ChiYou; it contains inexhaustible power and after years, it has already been transformed into a magic sword to cut down the demons and eliminate the devils.
千年的古劍，傳說是黃帝擊敗蚩尤所用的劍；內蘊藏著用不完的力量，經過日月的交替已經幻化成斬妖除魔的神劍。

錕铻山下的小村落，以販賣金石為生。受南方的白虎舵保護，且與東邊的陸氏山莊往來頻繁。

Rumor has it that the four offspring of the head of the family have been dispersed throughout the three continents, and nobody knows if they are not in harmony.
陸氏世代以鑄造為業，常以盤龍嶺礦石為材，遂定居於此，人丁興旺。傳聞家主四子已分散於三洲各地，不知是否不和。

After the master's demise, a group of elders and the eldest disciple, Fa Wuqing, and the second disciple, Dao Buping, were left in charge. Due to the uneven distribution of minerals, there was constant friction with the Lu Clan.
太山中段附近山脈產朱砂礦，萬符宗於近處設宗門，以朱砂研習符箓，為三洲仙凡提供符咒。掌門羽化後，剩下一眾長老和大弟子法無情，二弟子道不平管事。因分礦產不均，和陸家摩擦不斷。
生死崖位于陵光国西部边陲，擅长魔修，行事诡秘。传闻崖主出自北洲锻玄宗，详情却不为外人所知。

The Life Death Cliff is located in the western border of the LingGuang country, and is secretive, specializing in demonic cultivation. It is rumored that the owner of the cliff is from the Duan Xuan Sect in the Northern Continent, but the details are not known to outsiders.
生死崖位於陵光國西部邊陲，擅長魔修，行事詭秘。傳聞崖主出自北洲鍛玄宗，詳情卻不為外人所知。
暗谷隐没于西洲角落，不属于任何一国管辖。谷中并无法纪约束，容纳各路精怪在此居住。谷主为三头蛇妖，此前曾在北方谭国遗址现身，现去向已经成谜。

The Dark Valley is hidden in the corner of the Western Continent and is not under the jurisdiction of any country. The valley is not governed by any law, allowing all sorts of monsters and spirits to live in the valley. The master of the valley is a three-headed snake demon, who once appeared at the ruins of the northern Tan Country, but now his whereabouts are a mystery.
暗谷隱沒於西洲角落，不屬於任何一國管轄。谷中並無法紀約束，容納各路精怪在此居住。谷主為三頭蛇妖，此前曾在北方譚國遺址現身，現去向已經成謎。
三洲西部太山山脉之延伸，由朱雀气息保护，因此火灵灵气充盈。有修士依山而修，遂于山下设朱雀舵。

Extension of the Tai Mountains in the western part of the three continents, protected by the Vermilion Bird's breath, so the fire spirit is abundant. Some cultivators rely on the mountains to cultivate, and then set up the Vermilion Bird Rudder under the mountains.
三洲西部太山山脈之延伸，由朱雀氣息保護，因此火靈靈氣充盈。有修士依山而修，遂於山下設朱雀舵。
西洲多山，路途艰险。自从得朱雀庇佑后，凡人在此开疆拓土，沿山筑城，跨数州而成陵光国。㶦州为陵光都城，因朱雀之力而成为全三洲最安稳的城池。

The western continent is mountainous and the road is treacherous. Since being blessed by the Vermilion Bird, mortals have expanded territories here, building cities along the mountains, spanning several states and becoming the LingGuang Country. The Jinzhou is the capital city of LingGuang, which has become the most stable city in the three continents due to the power of the Vermilion Bird.
西洲多山，路途艱險。自從得朱雀庇佑後，凡人在此開疆拓土，沿山築城，跨數州而成陵光國。㶦州為陵光都城，因朱雀之力而成為全三洲最安穩的城池。
西洲的神秘宗门，以修巫术和蛊术为主。周围有瘴气保护，若无向导绝不可进入。由于地处弈仙府和暗谷中央，因此受两方拉拢。传闻掌门蓝彩荷在其中左右逢源，已换得不少利益。

A mysterious sect in the Western Continent practicing sorcery and Gu. The surrounding area is protected by miasma and should never be entered without a guide. Since it is located in the center of Yi Xian Palace and Dark Valley, it is attracted by both sides. Rumor has it that the Sect Master, Lan Caihe, has gained a lot of benefits in exchange for being in the middle of them.
西洲的神秘宗門，以修巫術和蠱術為主。周圍有瘴氣保護，若無向導絕不可進入。由於地處弈仙府和暗谷中央，因此受兩方拉攏。傳聞掌門藍彩荷在其中左右逢源，已換得不少利益。
东洲最南侧的郡治，紧邻南部沧海，土地富饶，常受水中精怪侵扰。自从当年郡兵覆灭后，此地已受云灵剑宗保护。

The southernmost county in the Eastern Continent is adjacent to the south Sea, with rich land that is often infested by water spirits and monsters. Since the destruction of the county army, this place has been under the protection of the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect.
東洲最南側的郡治，緊鄰南部滄海，土地富饒，常受水中精怪侵擾。自從當年郡兵覆滅後，此地已受雲靈劍宗保護。
约三千年前，姜氏祖先得图于河，得书于洛，衍为八卦，遂一路东驱，至东洲腹地寻得风水宝地而建良州城。后百姓闻之聚集而来，遂立国为大衍。

About three thousand years ago, Jiang's ancestors got the map in the river and the book in Luo, formed the eight trigrams, and then went all the way to the east, to the hinterland of the East Continent to find the nice place to build Liangzhou City. Then the people came here and gathered, and then set up the country named Dayan.
約三千年前，姜氏祖先得圖於河，得書於洛，衍為八卦，遂一路東驅，至東洲腹地尋得風水寶地而建良州城。後百姓聞之聚集而來，遂立國為大衍。
大衍国炎氏，乃上古名门望族，世代居于此地。自当年讨伐朱厌之战后，炎氏早已没落，不过仍在三洲境内保有一定的人脉。

The Yan clan of the Dayan country is a famous clan in the ancient times and has been living here for generations. The Yan Clan has long been in decline since the battle against ZhuYan, but it still maintains a certain number of contacts in the three continents.
大衍國炎氏，乃上古名門望族，世代居於此地。自當年討伐朱厭之戰後，炎氏早已沒落，不過仍在三洲境內保有一定的人脈。
俞氏后人俞经，善造船，于东洲灵河分流之处开设造船坞。现已是全三洲除天机谷外最大的工坊。

Yu Jing, a descendant of the Yu Clan, is a good shipbuilder and has opened a shipyard in the East Continent where the Spirit River diverges. It is now the largest workshop in the Three Continents except for Tianji Valley.
俞氏後人俞經，善造船，於東洲靈河分流之處開設造船塢。現已是全三洲除天機谷外最大的工坊。
五行山位于全三洲正中央，上有神树，五行齐聚。修士尊其为圣，待树结果时，设坛相聚而庆，后成五行道盟。

The Five Elements Mountain is located in the center of the three continents, with a sacred tree on it, where the five elements are gathered. Cultivators respect it as a saint, and when the tree bears fruit, they will set up an altar to celebrate and later established the Five Elements Alliance.
五行山位於全三洲正中央，上有神樹，五行齊聚。修士尊其為聖，待樹結果時，設壇相聚而慶，後成五行道盟。
俞鹤乃数百年前陵光之国医，感苍生之苦，辞官而游历三洲，治病救人，遍尝百草。后隐居北国雪山，望集毕生所学，炼救苦救难之灵丹。到如今，世人已不知其年岁几何，只知其所居之峰为丹鼎峰，可寻药医天下之疾。

Hundreds of years ago, Yu He was LingGuang's national doctor, feeling the suffering of the people, resigned and traveled to the three continents, treating the sick to save people, tasting all kinds of herbs. Afterwards, he lived in the snowy mountains in the north, hoping to gather his life's learning and make the elixir to save the suffering. Nowadays, the people does not know how old he is, but only knows that the peak where he lives is called Danding Peak, where they can find medicine to cure every disease.
俞鶴乃數百年前陵光之國醫，感蒼生之苦，辭官而遊歷三洲，治病救人，遍嘗百草。後隱居北國雪山，望集畢生所學，煉救苦救難之靈丹。到如今，世人已不知其年歲幾何，只知其所居之峰為丹鼎峰，可尋藥醫天下之疾。
北风军于东海岸设填海营，驱逐邪祟，庇佑周遭千万渔民。现任统帅为右将军吴恒，战功赫赫，且与七星阁私交甚好，北洲百姓皆爱戴。

The North Wind Army has set up a reclamation camp on the east coast to expel evil spirits and bless the thousands of fishermen around. The current commander-in-chief is the right general Wu Heng, who is highly successful in battle and has a good personal relationship with the Heptastar Pavilion, and is loved by the people of the north continent.
北風軍於東海岸設填海營，驅逐邪祟，庇佑周遭千萬漁民。現任統帥為右將軍吳恒，戰功赫赫，且與七星閣私交甚好，北洲百姓皆愛戴。
海外仙山，常隐于东海迷雾之中，因此知之者甚少。曾有五行道盟弟子冒险来此修炼，后去向不明，今已人迹罕至。

An overseas immortal mountain, often hidden in the mist of the East Sea, so few people know about it. Once there were disciples of the Five Elements Alliance adventured to come here to cultivate, and then their whereabouts were unknown, so no one visited here today.
海外仙山，常隱於東海迷霧之中，因此知之者甚少。曾有五行道盟弟子冒險來此修煉，後去向不明，今已人跡罕至。

活动介绍 · 周年庆期间，道友可邀请【回归道友】重返三洲大陆，获得角色信物、灵石、焕翎等奖励。 · 玩家在本页面中会自动获得专属邀请码。将其分享给【回归道友】并邀其填入，对方可立即领取一份奖励（自选角色，都拥有则替换为3600灵石）并算作完成1次邀请。累计邀请次数，邀请方可获得更多奖励。 · 1份邀请码不限制使用次数，可以供多名回归道友使用。但1名【回归道友】只能使用1次邀请码。 · 【回归道友】登录游戏后也将获得邀请码，仍可邀请其他道友回归。 回归道友 需满足以下条件的道友才能算作【回归道友】接受邀约： · 历练等级不小于5 · 连续未登录游戏天数不小于21天 若被系统判定为【回归道友】，页面下方会显示填写邀请码的输入框。若未显示则为非回归状态。

Event Introduction ·During the Anniversary Celebration, you can invite [Returning Player] to return to the game and receive rewards such as Character Tokens, Spirit Sones, and Radiant Feathers. ·Players will automatically receive an exclusive Invitation Code on this page. Share it with the [Returning Player] and invite them to fill it in. They can immediately receive a reward (Free Character, or replaced by 3,600 Spirit Stones when you already have all of them) and count it as completing one invitation. Accumulate the number of invitations, and you can receive more rewards. ·One Invitation Code has no limit on the number of times it can be used and can be used by multiple Returning Players. But one [Returning Player] can only use an invitation code once. ·[Returning Player] will also receive an Invitation Code and can still invite other players to return. Returning Player To be considered as a [Returning Player] and accept an invitation, the following conditions must be met: ·Explore level not less than 5 ·The number of consecutive days without logging in to the game shall not be less than 21 days If the system determines you as a [Returning Player], an input box for filling in the Invitation Code will be displayed at the bottom of the page. If not displayed, you are not in returning state.

活動介紹 · 周年慶期間，道友可邀請【回歸道友】重返三洲大陸，獲得角色信物、靈石、煥翎等獎勵。 · 玩家在本頁面中會自動獲得專屬邀請碼。將其分享給【回歸道友】並邀其填入，對方可立即領取一份獎勵（自選角色，都擁有則替換為3600靈石）並算作完成1次邀請。累計邀請次數，邀請方可獲得更多獎勵。 · 1份邀請碼不限製使用次數，可以供多名回歸道友使用。但1名【回歸道友】只能使用1次邀請碼。 · 【回歸道友】登錄遊戲後也將獲得邀請碼，仍可邀請其他道友回歸。 回歸道友 需滿足以下條件的道友才能算作【回歸道友】接受邀約： · 歷練等級不小於5 · 連續未登錄遊戲天數不小於21天 若被系統判定為【回歸道友】，頁面下方會顯示填寫邀請碼的輸入框。若未顯示則為非回歸狀態。

天魔之战后，有大道碎片落于北境。初北境魔物横行，魔气瘴目，三洲修士难至。今仙府众修士协北风军破阵，所向披靡，大展疆土万里。众修士御灵北洲，得大道碎片数枚。碎片内蕴灵魔二炁，聚散翻腾，形态各异。有修士能感碎片之变幻者，道心可与其共鸣，可取其炁而修。遂仙府众修士一时修为大进者多。

是故大同者，不同也。三洲修士因不同而修，不同而和。不同而共举补天大计，存不同而取大同。合三洲大道，还灵蕴于万物。是谓大道之行也，天下大同。

After the Battle of the Heavenly Devils, a fragment of the Great Rule fell in the North Continent. At the beginning of the North Realm, the devils were rampant, and the demonic Qi was chaotic, so it was difficult for the cultivators of the three continents to reach. Now, the Immortal Palace cultivators assisted the North Wind Army to crack the battlefield, and they were invincible, expanding their territory for thousands of miles. Now, many cultivators of the Immortal Palace have found several fragments of the Great Rule in the North Continent. The fragments contain spirit Qi and demonic Qi, which are in Different shapes and forms. If a cultivator can feel the fragments' shifting, his Dao heart can resonate with them, and he can take its Qi and cultivate. So the Immortal Palace cultivators have a lot of instant cultivation progress.

Therefore, the Great Same, comes from Different. Cultivators in the three continents are different from each other. They cultivate because they are different from each other, and they are united because they are different from each other. 近六甲子前仙人投下的法器，三洲宗门皆在此地修行切磋，以期突破瓶颈、修复天道。

Nearly six cycles of sixty years ago the Immortal cast this palace, and all the sects of the three continents practiced and sparred here in order to break through bottlenecks and repair the Heavenly Path.
近六甲子前仙人投下的法器，三洲宗門皆在此地修行切磋，以期突破瓶頸、修復天道。
东西二洲交界处，覆盖连云山脉数百里，修士皆以剑入道。主峰有瑞应神剑，相传为牧氏开宗立派时所留，至今仍庇佑此地。

Located in the junction of the East and West continents, which covers hundreds of miles of the Lianyun Mountain Range, where all cultivators use swords to enter the Dao. The main peak has the Ruiying Divine Sword, which is rumored to have been left by the Mu Clan when they started their sect, and still blesses this place.
東西二洲交界處，覆蓋連雲山脈數百裏，修士皆以劍入道。主峰有瑞應神劍，相傳為牧氏開宗立派時所留，至今仍庇佑此地。
姜氏祖先得八卦之术所创门派，后引星辰之力使群阁浮于空中，位置并不固定。

The ancestors of the Jiang Clan created the sect by obtaining the art of Eight Trigrams, and later attracted the power of the stars to make the pavilion float in the air, and the location is not fixed.
姜氏祖先得八卦之術所創門派，後引星辰之力使群閣浮於空中，位置並不固定。
五行修士择地而修，取东洲大衍国苍州之木而成青龙舵。
Cultivators of the five elements chose a place to cultivate, and took the wood of the Cangzhou of the Dayan country in the East Continent to build the Azure Dragon Rudder.
五行修士擇地而修，取東洲大衍國蒼州之木而成青龍舵。
五行修士择地而修，取北洲芦雪国锐州之金而成白虎舵。
Cultivators of the five elements chose a place to cultivate, and took the metal of the Ruizhou of the North country in the North Continent to build the White Tiger Rudder.
五行修士擇地而修，取北洲蘆雪國銳州之金而成白虎舵。
五行修士择地而修，取西洲陵光国㶦州之火而成朱雀舵。
Cultivators of the five elements chose a place to cultivate, and took the Fire of the Jinzhou of the Lingguang country in the West Continent to build the Vermilion Bird Rudder.
五行修士擇地而修，取西洲陵光國㶦州之火而成朱雀舵。
五行修士择地而修，取东洲溟洲之水而成玄武舵。
Cultivators of the five elements chose a place to cultivate, and took the water of the Mingzhou to build the Black Tortoise Rudder .
五行修士擇地而修，取東洲溟洲之水而成玄武舵。
五行修士择地而修，取三洲腹地五行山山麓之土而成麒麟舵。
Cultivators of the five elements chose a place to cultivate, and took the earth at the foot of Five Elements Mountain in the hinterland of the three continents to build the Qilin Rudder.
五行修士擇地而修，取三洲腹地五行山山麓之土而成麒麟舵。
锻玄宗门人于玄铁山徒手打出三十六个大洞，遂成门中三十六洞府。门人主张性命双修，常闭门不出。

The disciples of the Duan Xuan Sect made thirty-six large holes in the XuanTie Mountain with their bare hands, which became the thirty-six caves in the sect. The disciples of the sect advocate dual cultivation of soul and life and are often closed to the public.
鍛玄宗門人於玄鐵山徒手打出三十六個大洞，遂成門中三十六洞府。門人主張性命雙修，常閉門不出。
北洲北风军沿山脉所设营地，负责屏卫北方关卡。关外为极苦极寒之地，人迹罕至，常有魔物南下入侵。

The North Wind Army camps along the mountains in the North Continent are responsible for guarding the northern passes. Outside of the pass is a very bitter and cold place, rarely visited by people, and devils often invaded to the south.
北洲北風軍沿山脈所設營地，負責屏衛北方關卡。關外為極苦極寒之地，人跡罕至，常有魔物南下入侵。
锟铻山下的小村落，以贩卖金石为生。受南方的白虎舵保护，且与东边的陆氏山庄往来频繁。
A small village under the KunWu Mountain, which sells metal and stones for a living. It is protected by the White Tiger Rudder in the south and has frequent dealings with the Lu Clan in the east.
錕铻山下的小村落，以販賣金石為生。受南方的白虎舵保護，且與東邊的陸氏山莊往來頻繁。
陆氏世代以铸造为业，常以盘龙岭矿石为材，遂定居于此，人丁兴旺。传闻家主四子已分散于三洲各地，不知是否不和。

The Lu Clan has been in the foundry business for generations, often using Pan Long Ridge ores as materials, so they settled here and prospered. Rumor has it that the four offspring of the head of the family have been dispersed throughout the three continents, and nobody knows if they are not in harmony.
陸氏世代以鑄造為業，常以盤龍嶺礦石為材，遂定居於此，人丁興旺。傳聞家主四子已分散於三洲各地，不知是否不和。
北洲苦寒，魔物肆虐，居民定居常需军备镇守。长此以往，芦雪城大将自封为北风将军，率兵一统北洲各部，建立北国，定都芦雪城。

The northern continent is bitterly cold and infested with demons, so the residents often need armaments to guard the settlement. Before long, the general of Lu Xue City has become the General of North Wind, leading the troops to unify all the departments in the North Continent, and establishing the North Country, with Lu Xue City as the capital.
北洲苦寒，魔物肆虐，居民定居常需軍備鎮守。長此以往，蘆雪城大將自封為北風將軍，率兵一統北洲各部，建立北國，定都蘆雪城。
谭国原为西洲边陲一小国，与世无争。十余年前，穷奇率部进攻谭国，而近邻吕国拒绝相援。后谭国灭，此地只留下一地残垣断壁。

Tan Country was originally a small country in the Western Continent, without any competition from the rest of the world. More than ten years ago, QiongQi led his troops to attack Tan, but the neighboring Lv refused to help. After the destruction of the Tan, only the ruins of this place were left.
譚國原為西洲邊陲一小國，與世無爭。十余年前，窮奇率部進攻譚國，而近鄰呂國拒絕相援。後譚國滅，此地只留下一地殘垣斷壁。
太山中段附近山脉产朱砂矿，万符宗于近处设宗门，以朱砂研习符箓，为三洲仙凡提供符咒。掌门羽化后，剩下一众长老和大弟子法无情，二弟子道不平管事。因分矿产不均，和陆家摩擦不断。

Cinnabar was found in the mountains near the middle of the Tai, so the Ten Thousand Runes Sect set up a sect near there, using the cinnabar to study talismans and provide spells for the immortals and mortals in the three continents. After the master's demise, a group of elders and the eldest disciple, Fa Wuqing, and the second disciple, Dao Buping, were left in charge. Due to the uneven distribution of minerals, there was constant friction with the Lu Clan.
太山中段附近山脈產朱砂礦，萬符宗於近處設宗門，以朱砂研習符箓，為三洲仙凡提供符咒。掌門羽化後，剩下一眾長老和大弟子法無情，二弟子道不平管事。因分礦產不均，和陸家摩擦不斷。
生死崖位于陵光国西部边陲，擅长魔修，行事诡秘。传闻崖主出自北洲锻玄宗，详情却不为外人所知。

The Life Death Cliff is located in the western border of the LingGuang country, and is secretive, specializing in demonic cultivation. It is rumored that the owner of the cliff is from the Duan Xuan Sect in the Northern Continent, but the details are not known to outsiders.
生死崖位於陵光國西部邊陲，擅長魔修，行事詭秘。傳聞崖主出自北洲鍛玄宗，詳情卻不為外人所知。
暗谷隐没于西洲角落，不属于任何一国管辖。谷中并无法纪约束，容纳各路精怪在此居住。谷主为三头蛇妖，此前曾在北方谭国遗址现身，现去向已经成谜。

The Dark Valley is hidden in the corner of the Western Continent and is not under the jurisdiction of any country. The valley is not governed by any law, allowing all sorts of monsters and spirits to live in the valley. The master of the valley is a three-headed snake demon, who once appeared at the ruins of the northern Tan Country, but now his whereabouts are a mystery.
暗谷隱沒於西洲角落，不屬於任何一國管轄。谷中並無法紀約束，容納各路精怪在此居住。谷主為三頭蛇妖，此前曾在北方譚國遺址現身，現去向已經成謎。
三洲西部太山山脉之延伸，由朱雀气息保护，因此火灵灵气充盈。有修士依山而修，遂于山下设朱雀舵。

Extension of the Tai Mountains in the western part of the three continents, protected by the Vermilion Bird's breath, so the fire spirit is abundant. Some cultivators rely on the mountains to cultivate, and then set up the Vermilion Bird Rudder under the mountains.
三洲西部太山山脈之延伸，由朱雀氣息保護，因此火靈靈氣充盈。有修士依山而修，遂於山下設朱雀舵。
西洲多山，路途艰险。自从得朱雀庇佑后，凡人在此开疆拓土，沿山筑城，跨数州而成陵光国。㶦州为陵光都城，因朱雀之力而成为全三洲最安稳的城池。

The western continent is mountainous and the road is treacherous. Since being blessed by the Vermilion Bird, mortals have expanded territories here, building cities along the mountains, spanning several states and becoming the LingGuang Country. The Jinzhou is the capital city of LingGuang, which has become the most stable city in the three continents due to the power of the Vermilion Bird.
西洲多山，路途艱險。自從得朱雀庇佑後，凡人在此開疆拓土，沿山築城，跨數州而成陵光國。㶦州為陵光都城，因朱雀之力而成為全三洲最安穩的城池。
西洲的神秘宗门，以修巫术和蛊术为主。周围有瘴气保护，若无向导绝不可进入。由于地处弈仙府和暗谷中央，因此受两方拉拢。传闻掌门蓝彩荷在其中左右逢源，已换得不少利益。

A mysterious sect in the Western Continent practicing sorcery and Gu. The surrounding area is protected by miasma and should never be entered without a guide. Since it is located in the center of Yi Xian Palace and Dark Valley, it is attracted by both sides. Rumor has it that the Sect Master, Lan Caihe, has gained a lot of benefits in exchange for being in the middle of them.
西洲的神秘宗門，以修巫術和蠱術為主。周圍有瘴氣保護，若無向導絕不可進入。由於地處弈仙府和暗谷中央，因此受兩方拉攏。傳聞掌門藍彩荷在其中左右逢源，已換得不少利益。
东洲最南侧的郡治，紧邻南部沧海，土地富饶，常受水中精怪侵扰。自从当年郡兵覆灭后，此地已受云灵剑宗保护。

The southernmost county in the Eastern Continent is adjacent to the south Sea, with rich land that is often infested by water spirits and monsters. Since the destruction of the county army, this place has been under the protection of the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect.
東洲最南側的郡治，緊鄰南部滄海，土地富饒，常受水中精怪侵擾。自從當年郡兵覆滅後，此地已受雲靈劍宗保護。
约三千年前，姜氏祖先得图于河，得书于洛，衍为八卦，遂一路东驱，至东洲腹地寻得风水宝地而建良州城。后百姓闻之聚集而来，遂立国为大衍。

About three thousand years ago, Jiang's ancestors got the map in the river and the book in Luo, formed the eight trigrams, and then went all the way to the east, to the hinterland of the East Continent to find the nice place to build Liangzhou City. Then the people came here and gathered, and then set up the country named Dayan.
約三千年前，姜氏祖先得圖於河，得書於洛，衍為八卦，遂一路東驅，至東洲腹地尋得風水寶地而建良州城。後百姓聞之聚集而來，遂立國為大衍。
大衍国炎氏，乃上古名门望族，世代居于此地。自当年讨伐朱厌之战后，炎氏早已没落，不过仍在三洲境内保有一定的人脉。

The Yan clan of the Dayan country is a famous clan in the ancient times and has been living here for generations. The Yan Clan has long been in decline since the battle against ZhuYan, but it still maintains a certain number of contacts in the three continents.
大衍國炎氏，乃上古名門望族，世代居於此地。自當年討伐朱厭之戰後，炎氏早已沒落，不過仍在三洲境內保有一定的人脈。
俞氏后人俞经，善造船，于东洲灵河分流之处开设造船坞。现已是全三洲除天机谷外最大的工坊。

Yu Jing, a descendant of the Yu Clan, is a good shipbuilder and has opened a shipyard in the East Continent where the Spirit River diverges. It is now the largest workshop in the Three Continents except for Tianji Valley.
俞氏後人俞經，善造船，於東洲靈河分流之處開設造船塢。現已是全三洲除天機谷外最大的工坊。
五行山位于全三洲正中央，上有神树，五行齐聚。修士尊其为圣，待树结果时，设坛相聚而庆，后成五行道盟。

The Five Elements Mountain is located in the center of the three continents, with a sacred tree on it, where the five elements are gathered. Cultivators respect it as a saint, and when the tree bears fruit, they will set up an altar to celebrate and later established the Five Elements Alliance.
五行山位於全三洲正中央，上有神樹，五行齊聚。修士尊其為聖，待樹結果時，設壇相聚而慶，後成五行道盟。
俞鹤乃数百年前陵光之国医，感苍生之苦，辞官而游历三洲，治病救人，遍尝百草。后隐居北国雪山，望集毕生所学，炼救苦救难之灵丹。到如今，世人已不知其年岁几何，只知其所居之峰为丹鼎峰，可寻药医天下之疾。

Hundreds of years ago, Yu He was LingGuang's national doctor, feeling the suffering of the people, resigned and traveled to the three continents, treating the sick to save people, tasting all kinds of herbs. Afterwards, he lived in the snowy mountains in the north, hoping to gather his life's learning and make the elixir to save the suffering. Nowadays, the people does not know how old he is, but only knows that the peak where he lives is called Danding Peak, where they can find medicine to cure every disease.
俞鶴乃數百年前陵光之國醫，感蒼生之苦，辭官而遊歷三洲，治病救人，遍嘗百草。後隱居北國雪山，望集畢生所學，煉救苦救難之靈丹。到如今，世人已不知其年歲幾何，只知其所居之峰為丹鼎峰，可尋藥醫天下之疾。
北风军于东海岸设填海营，驱逐邪祟，庇佑周遭千万渔民。现任统帅为右将军吴恒，战功赫赫，且与七星阁私交甚好，北洲百姓皆爱戴。

The North Wind Army has set up a reclamation camp on the east coast to expel evil spirits and bless the thousands of fishermen around. The current commander-in-chief is the right general Wu Heng, who is highly successful in battle and has a good personal relationship with the Heptastar Pavilion, and is loved by the people of the north continent.
北風軍於東海岸設填海營，驅逐邪祟，庇佑周遭千萬漁民。現任統帥為右將軍吳恒，戰功赫赫，且與七星閣私交甚好，北洲百姓皆愛戴。
海外仙山，常隐于东海迷雾之中，因此知之者甚少。曾有五行道盟弟子冒险来此修炼，后去向不明，今已人迹罕至。

An overseas immortal mountain, often hidden in the mist of the East Sea, so few people know about it. Once there were disciples of the Five Elements Alliance adventured to come here to cultivate, and then their whereabouts were unknown, so no one visited here today.
海外仙山，常隱於東海迷霧之中，因此知之者甚少。曾有五行道盟弟子冒險來此修煉，後去向不明，今已人跡罕至。

春节临近，正是三洲百姓与修士休憩整顿、添置年货之时。是岁，恰逢玄巳被捉，暗谷百废待兴。曜灵趁机从中收购了一大批仙材法宝，并向弈仙府兜售。不过货物太多，曜灵有些忙不过来了，你能帮助她开店经营，收获最多的三洲通宝吗？

As the New Year approaches, it is the time for the people and cultivators of the three continents to rest and purchase New Year's goods. At this time, Xuan Si was captured, and the Dark Valley was ready to be rebuilt. Yao Ling took the opportunity to purchase a large number of immortal materials and treasures, and sold them to the Yixian Palace. However, there are too many goods, and Yaoling is a bit too busy. Can you help her open a store and manage it, and collect the most Three Continents Coins?
春節臨近，正是三洲百姓與修士休憩整頓、添置年貨之時。是歲，恰逢玄巳被捉，暗谷百廢待興。曜靈趁機從中收購了一大批仙材法寶，並向弈仙府兜售。不過貨物太多，曜靈有些忙不過來了，你能幫助她開店經營，收獲最多的三洲通寶嗎？

游戏规则： 1、在进货商店中购买卡牌，并将卡牌放置于卡组中，再点击右上角开始，即可进行本轮经营，获得通宝； 2、通宝为此模式下的专属货币。不断交付通宝完成任务，最终成功经营20轮即可进入排行榜； 3、在第3/5/8/12轮结束时，曜灵会要求交付通宝提升店铺等级，从而增加卡组格子、解锁开店策略和更多高境界卡牌； 4、部分卡牌具有如下特殊功能： 使用：在卡组中使用此牌时，正常结算后续效果（如同常规模式中的非消耗和持续牌） 出售：在卡组中使用此牌时，结算后续效果后，将此牌自动移除 耐久X：动态变量，在卡组中使用此牌后耐久-1，归零后自动移除。 5、部分卡牌还需要消耗体力，体力不足时，对应效果不会生效。体力和体力上限初始都为10，不会自动回复。卡组中空出的格子视作“休息”，结算时自动回复2体力（加体力时超出上限的部分不会保留。）； 6、本模式下角色仅作为形象使用，专属仙命均无效。

Game rules: 1. Purchase cards in the “Purchase Goods” store, place them in the deck and click on the top right corner to start the operation of this round, then you will automatically obtain Coin; 2. Coin is the Exclusive Currency in this game. Continuously submit Coins to finish tasks and successfully operate for 20 rounds to enter the ranking list; 3. At the end of the 3rd/5th/8th/12nd round, Yao Ling will request you to summit Coins to upgrade the store level, thereby adding card slots, cellsunlocking the store opening strategy and more high-level cards; 4. Some cards have the following special functions: Use: When using this card in the deck, the subsequent effects of normal settlement (similar to non consumption and continuous cards in regular mode) Sell: When using this card in the deck, it will be automatically removed after settling the subsequent effects DurabilityX: Dynamic variable, durability -1 after using this card in the deck, automatically removed after zeroing; 5. Some cards require Energy, and when Energy is insufficient, the cards that require Energy will not take effect. The initial Energy and max Energy are both 10, and will not automatically restore. The empty slot in the deck is considered as "Rest" and will automatically add 2 Energy (any excess beyond the max Energy will not be retained when adding Energy); 6. In this mode, the character is only used as an image and exclusive Immortal Fate is invalid.

遊戲規則： 1、在進貨商店中購買卡牌，並將卡牌放置於卡組中，再點擊右上角開始，即可進行本輪經營，獲得通寶； 2、通寶為此模式下的專屬貨幣。不斷交付通寶完成任務，最終成功經營20輪即可進入排行榜； 3、在第3/5/8/12輪結束時，曜靈會要求交付通寶提升店鋪等級，從而增加卡組格子、解鎖開店策略和更多高境界卡牌； 4、部分卡牌具有如下特殊功能： 使用：在卡組中使用此牌時，正常結算後續效果（如同常規模式中的非消耗和持續牌） 出售：在卡組中使用此牌時，結算後續效果後，將此牌自動移除 耐久X：動態變量，在卡組中使用此牌後耐久-1，歸零後自動移除。 5、部分卡牌還需要消耗體力，體力不足時，對應效果不會生效。體力和體力上限初始都為10，不會自動回復。卡組中空出的格子視作「休息」，結算時自動回復2體力（加體力時超出上限的部分不會保留。）； 6、本模式下角色僅作為形象使用，專屬仙命均無效。
体力：部分卡牌需要消耗体力，体力不足以消耗时，耗体力的卡牌不会生效。
Energy: Some cards require Energy, and when Energy is insufficient, the cards that require Energy will not take effect.
體力：部分卡牌需要消耗體力，體力不足以消耗時，耗體力的卡牌不會生效。
通宝：“招财进宝”模式的专属货币。部分卡牌可以获取通宝，通宝可用于购买商品。每次炼化卡牌会获得1通宝。
Exclusive currency for the "Wish You Fortune" game. Some cards can be used to obtain Coins, and Coins can be used to purchase goods. Each time a card is absorbed, you will obtain 1 Coin.
通寶：「招財進寶」模式的專屬貨幣。部分卡牌可以獲取通寶，通寶可用於購買商品。每次煉化卡牌會獲得1通寶。

在画境寻仙-鸿雁临江活动中，每购买1次鸿雁羽，可获赠1个画境秘匣。鸿雁羽可在兑换商店中兑换【谭舒雁逸品衣着-临江仙】。开启画境秘匣可获得更多鸿雁羽以及其他奖励。 画境秘匣 在画境寻仙-鸿雁临江活动中每次开启画境秘匣可获得物品及概率如下： 逸品卡牌样式-飞鸿踏雪（临江仙主题）：0.5% 挂饰-鸿雁：1.5% 谭舒雁衣着-春花秋月：1.5% 战斗场景-七星阁-小演武场：1.5% 神品卡牌样式-飞鸿踏雪（绘卷主题）：2.5% 信物自选礼盒x10：2.5% 灵石x3600：2.5% 彩墨绘卷×3：2.5% 表情-愠怒：5% 表情-酣眠：5% 焕翎×100：5% 鸿雁羽：70%（具体数量和概率见后文） 其中，装饰类物品不会重复获得，已拥有后，将对应概率转入鸿雁羽中。 除以上常规奖励外，每次开启都有0.3%的概率在常规奖励的基础上额外获得【谭舒雁逸品衣着-临江仙】（重复返260鸿雁羽）。 鸿雁羽 鸿雁羽为画境寻仙-鸿雁临江活动限定道具，积攒1000个后可在商店兑换【谭舒雁逸品衣着-临江仙】，还有其他多种奖励可供兑换。开启画境秘匣获得鸿雁羽时，数量及概率如下： 100：0.1% 20：4.9% 12：15% 10：30% 8：50% 十连优惠 每次十连开启画境秘匣都可额外获得随机数量的画境抵价券，数量及掉落概率如下： 6：5% 4：15% 3：20% 2：30% 1：30% 每购买1个画境寻仙专属道具时，可消耗1张画境抵价券抵扣30仙玉。 累计开启 在鸿雁临江活动界面累计开启画境秘匣一定次数，可领取额外奖励： 5次：画境抵价券x5 10次：鸿雁羽x20 20次：焕翎x120 40次：鸿雁羽x50 60次：逸品卡牌样式-飞鸿踏雪（临江仙主题） 80次：鸿雁羽x100 若已拥有【逸品卡牌样式-飞鸿踏雪（临江仙主题）】，领取时自动替换为鸿雁羽x120。

In Painting Realm Seeking Immortal - Swan Goose at the River, you can purchase a Geese Feather and receive a Painting Realm Secret Box. Geese Feathers can be redeemed in the Redemption Store for [Tan Shuyan Legend Outfit - Riverside Immortal]. Open the Painting Realm Secret Box to obtain more Geese Feathers as well as other rewards. Painting Realm Secret Box In Painting Realm Seeking Immortal - Swan Goose at the River, each time you open the box, you can obtain the following items with the probabilities: Legend Card Style Only Traces (Riverside Immortal Theme): 0.5% Ornament - Swan Goose: 1.5% Tan Shuyan outfit - Flowers and Moon: 1.5% Battle Scene - Heptastar Pavilion - Martial Arts Arena: 1.5% Rare Card Style Only Traces (Riverside Immortal Theme): 2.5% Self selected tokens box: 2.5% Spirit Stones x3600: 2.5% Colorful Scroll x3: 2.5% Emoticon-Inwardly Angry: 5% Emoticon-Sleep Soundly: 5% Radiant Feather x100: 5% Geese Feather: 70% Among them, decorative items will not be obtained repeatedly. Once they are already owned, the corresponding probability will be transferred to the Geese Feather. In addition to the above items, there is a 0.3% chance to directly win the ultimate reward "Tan Shuyan Legend Outfit - Riverside Immortal" every time a box is opened (does not occupy summoning times, and returns 260 Geese Feathers if owned). Geese Feather Geese Feather is a limited item for the event, and accumulating a certain amount of it can be exchanged for " Tan Shuyan Legend Outfit - Riverside Immortal" and other rewards in the store. The quantity and probability of obtaining Geese Feather each time are as follows: 100：0.1% 20：4.9% 12：15% 10：30% 8：50% Open 10 times discounts Each "Open 10 times" will earn an additional random number of Painting Realm Coupons. The quantity and drop probability are as follows: 6：5% 4：15% 3：20% 2：30% 1：30% When purchasing each Painting Realm Seeking Immortal exclusive item, you can use one Painting Realm Coupon to offset 30 Divine Jade. Cumulative Open Accumulate a certain number of times to open the [Painted Realm Secret Box] in this event, and you can receive additional rewards: 5 time: Painting Realm Coupon x5 10 times: Geese Feather x20 20 times: Radiant Feather x120 40 times: Geese Feather x50 60 times: Legend Card Style Only Traces (Riverside Immortal Theme) 80 times: Geese Feather x100 If you already have the "Legend Card Style Only Traces (Riverside Immortal Theme)", it will be automatically replaced with Geese Feather x120 when obtained.

在畫境尋仙-鴻雁臨江活動中，每購買1次鴻雁羽，可獲贈1個畫境秘匣。鴻雁羽可在兌換商店中兌換【譚舒雁逸品衣著-臨江仙】。開啟畫境秘匣可獲得更多鴻雁羽以及其他獎勵。 畫境秘匣 在畫境尋仙-鴻雁臨江活動中每次開啟畫境秘匣可獲得物品及概率如下： 逸品卡牌樣式-飛鴻踏雪（臨江仙主題）：0.5% 掛飾-鴻雁：1.5% 譚舒雁衣著-春花秋月：1.5% 戰鬥場景-七星閣-小演武場：1.5% 神品卡牌樣式-飛鴻踏雪（繪卷主題）：2.5% 信物自選禮盒x10：2.5% 靈石x3600：2.5% 彩墨繪卷×3：2.5% 表情-慍怒：5% 表情-酣眠：5% 煥翎×100：5% 鴻雁羽：70%（具體數量和概率見後文） 其中，裝飾類物品不會重復獲得，已擁有後，將對應概率轉入鴻雁羽中。 除以上常規獎勵外，每次開啟都有0.3%的概率在常規獎勵的基礎上額外獲得【譚舒雁逸品衣著-臨江仙】（重復返260鴻雁羽）。 鴻雁羽 鴻雁羽為畫境尋仙-鴻雁臨江活動限定道具，積攢1000個後可在商店兌換【譚舒雁逸品衣著-臨江仙】，還有其他多種獎勵可供兌換。開啟畫境秘匣獲得鴻雁羽時，數量及概率如下： 100：0.1% 20：4.9% 12：15% 10：30% 8：50% 十連優惠 每次十連開啟畫境秘匣都可額外獲得隨機數量的畫境抵價券，數量及掉落概率如下： 6：5% 4：15% 3：20% 2：30% 1：30% 每購買1個畫境尋仙專屬道具時，可消耗1張畫境抵價券抵扣30仙玉。 累計開啟 在鴻雁臨江活動界面累計開啟畫境秘匣一定次數，可領取額外獎勵： 5次：畫境抵價券x5 10次：鴻雁羽x20 20次：煥翎×120 40次：鴻雁羽x50 60次：逸品卡牌樣式-飛鴻踏雪（臨江仙主題） 80次：鴻雁羽x100 若已擁有【逸品卡牌樣式-飛鴻踏雪（臨江仙主題）】，領取時自動替換為鴻雁羽x120。

◆上元灯会
•上元佳节对于三洲百姓来说是十分重要的节日，在大衍国境内的百姓每年此时都会身着华服、观赏花灯。
•值此佳节，曜灵借来仙府灵气，将其注入无数花灯之中，愿忙于北伐的修士们，也能有一息闲暇，赏一赏良州小桥流水间的灯火阑珊，“修行赏灯两不误！”曜灵如是说。
•活动期间完成花灯解谜的相关任务可领取大量奖励！

◆Lantern Festival
-The Lantern Festival of Shangyuan is a very important festival for the people of the three continents. Every year, the people in the territory of Dayan Kingdom will dress up in fancy clothes and watch the lanterns at this time.
-On the occasion of this festival, Yao Ling borrowed the Qi of the Immortal Palace and filled it into countless lanterns, wishing that the cultivators who are busy with the Northern Expedition can also have a breath of leisure to enjoy the lanterns among the bridges and rivers of Liangzhou, and ‘cultivation and watching lanterns can be enjoyed at the same time’!’ Yao Ling said.
-Completing the tasks related to the lantern riddle solving during the activity period can receive a large number of rewards!

◆上元燈會
•上元佳節對於三洲百姓來說是十分重要的節日，在大衍國境內的百姓每年此時都會身著華服、觀賞花燈。
•值此佳節，曜靈借來仙府靈氣，將其註入無數花燈之中，願忙於北伐的修士們，也能有一息閑暇，賞一賞良州小橋流水間的燈火闌珊，「修行賞燈兩不誤！」曜靈如是說。
•活動期間完成花燈解謎的相關任務可領取大量獎勵！

mTerms.Term: 新手阶段模式选择说明
Languages:

入门模式：比较初级的模式，对局将不包含赛季机制，并且您匹配到的对手都将和您一样处于该模式。适合刚接触游戏的道友

另外：当您进行组队游戏时，模式将由队长决定。如果您的队友超过了地仙段位，则入门模式会自动禁用，您将于队友一起体验完整的天梯游玩内容。

You are currently at the novice level and can play in one of two modes.
Beginner Mode: A beginner mode, games will not include season mechanics and you will be matched against opponents who are in the same mode as you. Suitable for those who are new to the game 
Season Mode: A more challenging mode, games will include season mechanics. Suitable for those who know enough about the game 
Getting out of the novice stage: when you reach the level of Earth Immortal (2000 points on the ladder), you will automatically get out of the novice stage, and no longer have the option to choose the introductory mode. If you still want to experience the version without season mechanism, please choose practice.
Additionally: when you play in a team, the mode will be determined by the captain. If your teammates are above the Earth Immortal level, the Starter Mode will be automatically disabled and you will experience the full ladder game with your teammates.

您當前處於新手階段，可以在兩種模式中選擇一種進行遊戲。

賽季模式：更具挑戰的模式，對局將會包含賽季機制。 適合對遊戲有足够瞭解的道友
脫離新手階段：當您達到地仙段位（天梯2000分），會立即自動脫離新手階段，不再可以選擇入門模式。 如還想體驗沒有賽季機制的版本，請選擇練習。
另外：當您進行組隊遊戲時，模式將由隊長决定。 如果您的隊友超過了地仙段位，則入門模式會自動禁用，您將於隊友一起體驗完整的天梯遊玩內容。

时间：5月1日至3日，每日18:00至23:59期间开放比赛匹配。

报名：报名费为100灵石。每名道友最多可报名3次。（最后1小时停止报名，超时未完成比赛自动退还报名费）

赛程：每次报名后需参加3局初赛，入围决赛后参加1局决赛。两局比赛之间可自由休息，无需连续完成。

初赛：随机匹配8名初赛选手，根据名次获得积分：第一名100分，第二名90分，第三名80分，之后依次递减，同轮淘汰多人时取名次平均分。3局初赛后总积分200分及以上可参加决赛。

决赛：随机匹配8名决赛选手，1局决定排名。（匹配时会优先将初赛总积分不同的选手匹配到一起，同轮淘汰多人时初赛积分高者名次靠前）

奖励：参与并完成决赛即可获得卡背“登天路”（重复获得转化为500灵石）。决赛前3名分别获得共鸣杯冠军道印和2000灵石、共鸣杯亚军道印和1000灵石、共鸣杯季军道印和500灵石。道印有效期为永久。重复获得相同名次的道印会在描述中显示获得次数。（例：共鸣杯冠军×2）

Time: Matches will be available from 18:00 to 23:59 every day from May 1st to 3rd (UTC+8). 

Registration: The registration fee is 100 spirit stones. Each plyaer can register up to 3 times.

Match: You need to participate in 3 preliminary games after each registration and 1 final game after being shortlisted for the finals. You are free to take a break between two games and do not need to complete them consecutively.

Preliminary Games: 8 players will be randomly matched. Points will be awarded based on rankings: 1st place receives 100 points, 2nd place 90 points, 3rd place 80 points, and so on. If multiple players are eliminated in the same round, they receive average points of ranking. Players who accumulate 200 points or more can participate in the final.

Final Game: 8 finalists will be randomly matched, and the ranking will be determined in a single game. (If multiple players are eliminated in the same round, those with higher preliminary scores will get better ranking)

Rewards: Participants who complete the final round will receive the card back "Ascending to Heaven Road" (repeated rewards will be converted into 500 spirit stones). The top 3 finalists will receive the Champion's Dao Seal and 2000 spirit stones, the Runner-up's Dao Seal and 1000 spirit stones, and the Third Place's Dao Seal and 500 spirit stones, respectively. The Dao Seal are permanent. If the same Dao Seal is obtained repeatedly, the number of acquisitions will be displayed in its description.

牧逸风，云灵剑宗大师兄，少年即入宗门，云剑大成，达到无招胜有招之境。常在宗门后山练剑，有玄鸟与山间云雾相伴，有传其自创剑法便出自此二者，施展开来身手飘逸，剑法灵动。平日里喜采云雾泡茶，不甚言谈，常以茶会友，待他人和善，于己却颇为严厉，为宗门行事每每全力以赴。手执一把却尘剑，为宗主亲赠，却从不见其出鞘，此真意知者甚少。

Mu Yifeng, the senior of the Cloud Spirit sword sect, enter the sect when he was young, the master of the cloud sword, and reached the natural realm. Usually, he practices the sword in the sect with the black birds and mist between the mountains. There is a hearsay that the sword way he created was inspired by this. His sword is elegant and agile. Normally he likes to collect the mist to make tea and is not talkative. He usually uses tea to entertain friends and treats others friendly but strictly to himself. He always goes all out for the sect. There's nearly no one who knows the true meaning of the Quechen-sword given by their suzerain and never sees it out of its sheath.
牧逸風，雲靈劍宗大師兄，少年即入宗門，雲劍大成，達到無招勝有招之境。常在宗門後山練劍，有玄鳥與山間雲霧相伴，有傳其自創劍法便出自此二者，施展開來身手飄逸，劍法靈動。平日裡喜采雲霧泡茶，不甚言談，常以茶會友，待他人和善，於己卻頗為嚴厲，為宗門行事每每全力以赴。手執一把卻塵劍，為宗主親贈，卻從不見其出鞘，此真意知者甚少。

上古魔物繇入侵连云山脉被诛之后多年，虽经天降瑞雨洗涤污秽，却时有蛊虿肆虐，啃食灵田，危害乡里。后有鸟自北方寒苦之地飞来，尾似剪，衔泥入山间，只数年，山间村落皆有此鸟斜飞觅食身影，蛊虿之害渐轻，百姓皆称其为玄鸟。
    牧逸风少年时于山间习剑，观玄鸟起落，见其身影灵动，从中悟出一套百般变化身法，同辈与牧逸风切磋时，皆称其身影灵动，比试间，剑锋尚未沾其衣袖，师兄身影已闪至身后。
    闲暇时，牧逸风常坐树梢歇息。有玄鸟见其儒雅恬静，动也不动，遂常在牧逸风身侧嬉戏。牧逸风见玄鸟天真烂漫，于乡邻亦多有益处，甚欢喜，遂不时捉蛊虿采云雾喂之，久之，常有玄鸟相伴。

Many years after the ancient demon Yao invasion into the Lianyun mountain and was killed, although the rain came to wash and pollute the dirt, there were times that raged with venomous insects, gnawed on the fields and harming the country. There were birds flying from the cold land in the north, tails like scissors, bit mud into the mountains. Only a few years later, there were birds like these flying sideways in the countries to look for food, villages have venomous insects of less harm, and people called them Black Birds.

When MU Yifeng was young, he was practicing swordsmanship in the mountains. When he watched the Black Birds rise and gall, saw they were nimble and comprehended a set of various bodily movement skills. When his peers competed with Yifeng, they all called him nimble. During the competition, before the edge of the sword touched his sleeve, the figure of Yifeng had already flashed behind him.

In his spare time, Yifeng often sat at the top of a tree for rest. The Black Birds saw him as elegant and quiet, never moving, so they often played beside Yifeng. Seeing that the Black Birds were so naive and helpful to the villagers, Yifeng was very happy, so he would occasionally catch venomous insects and clouds to feed them. As time went by, the Black Birds would often accompany him.

上古魔物繇入侵連雲山脈被誅之後多年，雖經天降瑞雨洗滌污穢，卻時有蠱蠆肆虐，啃食靈田，危害鄉里。後有鳥自北方寒苦之地飛來，尾似剪，銜泥入山間，只數年，山間村落皆有此鳥斜飛覓食身影，蠱蠆之害漸輕，百姓皆稱其為玄鳥。
    牧逸風少年時于山間習劍，觀玄鳥起落，見其身影靈動，從中悟出一套百般變化身法，同輩與牧逸風切磋時，皆稱其身影靈動，比試間，劍鋒尚未沾其衣袖，師兄身影已閃至身後。
    閒暇時，牧逸風常坐樹梢歇息。有玄鳥見其儒雅恬靜，動也不動，遂常在牧逸風身側嬉戲。牧逸風見玄鳥天真爛漫，於鄉鄰亦多有益處，甚歡喜，遂不時捉蠱蠆采雲霧喂之，久之，常有玄鳥相伴。

云灵剑宗主峰千余丈高，常有云海相伴。云海时降瑞雨，于山间成溪，溪水自陡崖冲刷下来而起云雾，此云雾元初自天神来，又聚三洲天地之灵气，饮之，灵台清静，丹田充盈，道心坚固。
    牧逸风于山间苦修剑道之时，常感云雾于山间变幻不可捉摸，似宗门剑法一般精妙，后经宗主指点，引此云雾变幻入剑招，遂牧逸风年纪尚轻却云剑大成。牧逸风数年有云雾相伴修习心法，得引云雾入体，吐纳间已可见云雾幻化为其身形。
    云雾为泉，所化灵水。每当宗主有令外出行事时，牧逸风常备一壶平日所采云泉水，途经市集收些上好茶叶，以此云泉水煎之，饮罢心情舒畅，可几日不食而不饥，除魔卫道如有神助。后有诗曰：凌峰燕起行千里，剑闪风吟雾海翻。大道不闻江湖事，灵茶一盏却尘来。

The main peak of Cloud Spirit Clan is more than a thousand zhangs high, often accompanied by a sea of clouds. When the sea of clouds rain, in the mountains into a stream. Streams from the cliff washed down and the cloud, cloud was originally from immortals, and gather the Qi of three continents. After drinking it, the inner spirit was quiet, its Dantian field was full of energy and the Dao Mindset is solid.

When Mu Yifeng practiced swords in the mountains, he often felt that the clouds were unpredictable in the mountains, just like the sect's sword technique. After the suzerain's guidance, lead this cloud changes into the sword move, then Mu Yifeng is still young but the cloud sword had acquired great achievement. Yifeng has practiced dharma for several years and led the clouds and mists into the body. Between his rhythmic breathing, the cloud and mist will phantom into his figures.

The mist is the spring, and forms spiritual water. Whenever the master has to go out, Mu Yifeng often prepared a pot of cloud spring water, collected some good tea on the way to the market,  and cook it with the cloud spring water. Drink it, he could not eat for a few days and was not hungry, in addition to the power way. A poem said: Birds set off thousands of miles high, sword flashing, wind singing, and the sea of cloud turning. The great truth only concerns itself, but the Quechen-sword will settle a grudge in the world.

雲靈劍宗主峰千余丈高，常有雲海相伴。雲海時降瑞雨，于山間成溪，溪水自陡崖沖刷下來而起雲霧，此雲霧元初自天神來，又聚三洲天地之靈氣，飲之，靈台清靜，丹田充盈，道心堅固。
    牧逸風於山間苦修劍道之時，常感雲霧於山間變幻不可捉摸，似宗門劍法一般精妙，後經宗主指點，引此雲霧變幻入劍招，遂牧逸風年紀尚輕卻雲劍大成。牧逸風數年有雲霧相伴修習心法，得引雲霧入體，吐納間已可見雲霧幻化為其身形。
    雲霧為泉，所化靈水。每當宗主有令外出行事時，牧逸風常備一壺平日所采雲泉水，途經市集收些上好茶葉，以此雲泉水煎之，飲罷心情舒暢，可幾日不食而不饑，除魔衛道如有神助。後有詩曰：淩峰燕起行千里，劍閃風吟霧海翻。大道不聞江湖事，靈茶一盞卻塵來。

此剑乃北国陆氏取千年寒精铁所锻，长四尺二寸有余，剑身剑柄一体，皆雪白通透不染杂物，剑柄镶驱邪祟仙石，剑首云纹雕系一道青玉红丝穗，剑鞘取南海滨黑檀木精树心，内刻万符宗护灵法咒加固，剑格鞘护皆出自五行山玄黄土，入陆氏乾坤锻炉炼七七四十九天化为精石，嵌于剑身，所成玄者化云附身，黄者化土载物，云者随风动，金者固根基，剑出于土而不染尘，唤作却尘剑，赠予云灵剑宗。
    牧逸风父亲牧云仁乃青烟郡守，为人正义，不畏邪魔，守得青烟郡常年平安。弈仙六丙申年，南海鲛人为蜚所驱，入青烟郡，鲛中生性残暴者伤人而夺灵田，牧云仁率部抵抗数日，兵寡力竭而逝。待数日，洲兵至，只见伤者无数，灵田尽毁，鲛人已无踪迹。时云灵剑宗宗主闻讯而至，感牧云仁之举壮义，又观牧逸风灵根极好，收为亲传，赐予却尘剑，望其了却尘世之纷扰，一心向道。
    成为云灵剑宗大师兄之后，牧逸风不忘宗主所训，韵养剑意，不轻易出鞘，不染俗尘。然每遇不平之事，虽不拔剑，却也手持却尘，使一套入鞘剑招，惩恶扬善只在须臾之间。平日里看似冷言寡语，不好亲近，然与牧逸风相处过的道友皆赞其为人和善，心怀天下苍生。

This sword was forged by Lu who lives in the north, the material is millennium-cold iron. It was more than four feet and two inches long. Its body and hilt were in one, and all of them were snow-white and free from dust. The hilt of the sword was inlaid with the evil dispelling stone, and the head of the sword was carved with a red ear of blue jade. The scabbard was taken from the heart of the black sandalwood tree on the south side of the sea and was engraved with ten thousand runes sect's spirit protecting spell to strengthen it. The scabbard was made from the five elements mountain's black soil. After entering the Lu clan's heaven and earth refining furnace, it took forty-nine days to refine the essences, which were embedded in the sword, The black one was possessed by the cloud; the yellow one turned into the earth and carried things; the cloud moved with the wind; the gold one has reinforced the base; the sword was free from dust out of the earth. It was called the dust sword and was given to the cloud spirit sword sect.

Mu Yifeng's father Mu Yunren, is the sheriff of QingYan county, full of justice and not afraid of evils, making QingYan county safe and peaceful for a long time. YiXian calendar, six BingShen Year, the merfolks from the south sea driven by Fei, invaded the QingYan country. The merfolk are brutal and bloodthirsty, YunRen and his follower fight with them for several days and are defeated to die. After several days, the army from the continent arrived, only seeing the countless injured and ruins. In the meantime, the suzerain of the Cloud Spirit sword sect heard this, was moved by Yunren's charity, and found Mu Yifeng's spiritual root is unusual. Hence made the Mu Yifeng his personal disciple, rewarding him with an Quechen-sword. The suzerain hopes he can forget the disturbance in mortal life and concentrate on the Dao.

When he became the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect senior, Mu Yifeng followed the suzerain's will, cultivated his sword intent, and did not use his sword commonly. Although sometimes he faces unfairness, he holds Quechen-sword without unsheathed and uses a sheathed sword moves to bring the fair. He usually seems reticent and not easy to get close to, but everyone who has been with Mu Yifeng praises him as a kind person, with a heart for the ordinary people in the world.

此劍乃北國陸氏取千年寒精鐵所鍛，長四尺二寸有餘，劍身劍柄一體，皆雪白通透不染雜物，劍柄鑲驅邪祟仙石，劍首雲紋雕系一道青玉紅絲穗，劍鞘取南海濱黑檀木精樹心，內刻萬符宗護靈法咒加固，劍格鞘護皆出自五行山玄黃土，入陸氏乾坤鍛爐煉七七四十九天化為精石，嵌於劍身，所成玄者化雲附身，黃者化土載物，雲者隨風動，金者固根基，劍出於土而不染塵，喚作卻塵劍，贈予雲靈劍宗。
    牧逸風父親牧雲仁乃青煙郡守，為人正義，不畏邪魔，守得青煙郡常年平安。弈仙六丙申年，南海鮫人為蜚所驅，入青煙郡，鮫中生性殘暴者傷人而奪靈田，牧雲仁率部抵抗數日，兵寡力竭而逝。待數日，洲兵至，只見傷者無數，靈田盡毀，鮫人已無蹤跡。時雲靈劍宗宗主聞訊而至，感牧雲仁之舉壯義，又觀牧逸風靈根極好，收為親傳，賜予卻塵劍，望其了卻塵世之紛擾，一心向道。
    成為雲靈劍宗大師兄之後，牧逸風不忘宗主所訓，韻養劍意，不輕易出鞘，不染俗塵。然每遇不平之事，雖不拔劍，卻也手持卻塵，使一套入鞘劍招，懲惡揚善只在須臾之間。平日裡看似冷言寡語，不好親近，然與牧逸風相處過的道友皆贊其為人和善，心懷天下蒼生。

关于炎雪：炎师妹剑招犀利，与她过招需打起十分精神，使些变幻手段同她周璇。否则稍有不慎，单饮我这云泉道茶还不管用，需去向鹤老求些外伤丹药方可。

关于龙瑶：沧海一族有入魔变凶残的鲛人，也有庄重和善的龙族，不知龙瑶师妹家族为三洲承担了多少魔物的侵害，令人尊敬。要是修行时能再积极一些就好了。

关于林小月：林师妹常来后山闲逛，行踪飘忽都快赶上师父了，下次还是跟上去看看罢，可别出什么岔子。她剑上灵猫常来我修行之地扑玄鸟……虽不曾伤其性命，但长久下去却如何是好，我需要泡壶茶冷静一下。
