龙瑶，沧海龙族之后，传闻其受阿姊排挤，一气之下离家出走，遇炎雪，后拜入云灵剑宗。又传尾部有伤，化为人形后不便走动，遂常坐九霄玲珑镯。得龙族传承，有呼风唤雨之能，使一把碧海珊瑚剑能伤敌神识。平日里厌恶争斗，喜游历玩耍，有时见其情绪低落，似乎为离家之事耿耿于怀。

Long Yao, the descendant of the Sea Dragon Clan, it was rumored that she was always blamed by her elder sister, so she ran away from home angrily, encountered Yan Xue, and then joined the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect. It is also said that a wound on her tail is inconvenient to walk after turning into a human form. So she often sits on the Sky Delicate Bracelet. Obtain inherited from the Dragon, it has the ability to call wind and rain, so that a blue sea coral sword can injure the enemy's spiritual consciousness. She usually hates fighting and likes to travel and play. Sometimes she is seen in a low mood as if she is worried about leaving home.
龍瑤，滄海龍族之後，傳聞其受阿姊排擠，一氣之下離家出走，遇炎雪，後拜入雲靈劍宗。又傳尾部有傷，化為人形後不便走動，遂常坐九霄玲瓏鐲。得龍族傳承，有呼風喚雨之能，使一把碧海珊瑚劍能傷敵神識。平日裡厭惡爭鬥，喜遊歷玩耍，有時見其情緒低落，似乎為離家之事耿耿於懷。

早于三洲生灵心智未明，寻先天一炁时，龙族便已得炁多年，于沧海深渊处兴得宫殿，雕栏玉砌，贝阙珠宫，珊瑚环绕，海萝从生，隐于巨岩之隙，避外族之扰。经上古之战，苍穹洞破，厚土崩裂，潮汐肆虐，大道破碎，灵气散失，仅剩孤零零一块三洲大陆立于地星尽头，龙宫近三洲而得以幸存。然魔气自大道缺口涌入，近三洲而稀，龙宫立于两炁之间，四周生灵有魔气灵气兼修者，或因道心不正而入魔，转而为害龙宫，龙族则世代守龙宫于三洲南海，所灭魔物不可计数。
    经数千年，应龙之后生瑛、瑶，瑛得千年灵气传承，骁勇无比，为龙宫当世将军也，常以真龙之形游南海驱魔物，瑶为次女，所得灵气较稀，幼时随姊寻海，为魔物伤其尾，后遂居龙宫而少出，常化为人形。
    久之，瑛以瑶终日嬉戏不求正道而数责之，瑶不堪其责而离龙宫，遇炎雪，慕其潇洒果决，遂与之同行三洲，后拜入云灵剑宗。

Long before the minds of the creature in the three continents were not appear, when they were looking for an innate Qi, the dragon clan had obtained Qi for many years. They built palaces in the abyss of the sea, with carved railings and jade, shells, and pearl palaces, surrounded by corals and seaweed. Gap to avoid disturbance from foreigners. After the battle of the ancients, the sky was broken, the thick soil was creaked, the tides were raging, the Great Rule was broken, and the Qi was lost. Only the three continents stood at the end of the world. And the Dragon Palace survived near the three continents. However, the demonic energy pours from the gap in the Great Rules and is rare near the three continents. The Dragon Palace stands between the two kinds of power and the surrounding creatures have both demonic Qi and normal Qi. In the south sea of the three continents, countless monsters have been destroyed by the Sea Dragon Palace which guards the safety of the world.

After thousands of years, Ying and Yao were born after Yinglong. Ying inherited the Qi thousands of years and is extremely brave. She is also the current general of the Dragon Palace and often swims in the south sea in the shape of a real dragon to drive out the evils. And Yao is the second daughter and the Qi she received is relatively rare. When she was young, she went to the sea with her sister and injured her tail by evil. After that, she lived in the Dragon Palace and rarely came out and often transformed into human form.

For a long time, Ying blamed Yao for playing all day long and not seeking the right way. Yao couldn't bear the responsibility and left the Dragon Palace. When encountering Yan Xue, she admired her unrestrained determination, so she traveled with her to three continents and later worshiped in the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect.

早於三洲生靈心智未明，尋先天一炁時，龍族便已得炁多年，於滄海深淵處興得宮殿，雕欄玉砌，貝闕珠宮，珊瑚環繞，海蘿從生，隱於巨岩之隙，避外族之擾。經上古之戰，蒼穹洞破，厚土崩裂，潮汐肆虐，大道破碎，靈氣散失，僅剩孤零零一塊三洲大陸立於地星盡頭，龍宮近三洲而得以倖存。然魔氣自大道缺口湧入，近三洲而稀，龍宮立於兩炁之間，四周生靈有魔氣靈氣兼修者，或因道心不正而入魔，轉而為害龍宮，龍族則世代守龍宮於三洲南海，所滅魔物不可計數。
    經數千年，應龍之後生瑛、瑤，瑛得千年靈氣傳承，驍勇無比，為龍宮當世將軍也，常以真龍之形遊南海驅魔物，瑤為次女，所得靈氣較稀，幼時隨姊尋海，為魔物傷其尾，後遂居龍宮而少出，常化為人形。
    久之，瑛以瑤終日嬉戲不求正道而數責之，瑤不堪其責而離龍宮，遇炎雪，慕其瀟灑果決，遂與之同行三洲，後拜入雲靈劍宗。

沧海有仙石，唤作织梦珊瑚，此珊瑚非凡物，存于龙族梦中，梦醒则消，不可触及，因仅见于梦中，世人皆视为传说。一日龙瑶梦魇，惊慌中抱珊瑚而醒，梦醒而珊瑚未消，悬于闺房，有七色光辉，近者顿觉神清，珊瑚坚硬无比，火烧不化，龙族尝锻而为兵未果。
    后龙瑶入云灵剑宗，陆剑心以玄土附于织梦珊瑚，烧九天方化，锻而为剑。此剑唤作碧海珊瑚剑，为龙瑶意念所化，剑意起而剑身现，剑意灭则剑身消。平日里难见龙瑶携带此剑，旁人与龙瑶练剑时，珊瑚剑常凭空而现，且以物相格时，能感神识亦为其击，遇神识薄弱者，往仅需几回合，神识崩溃，无意再战，此时再看龙瑶，哪里还有珊瑚剑身影，仅剩笑盈盈一龙族少女。

There is an immortal stone in the sea, which is called dream-weaving coral. This coral is an extraordinary thing that only exists in the dream of the dragon and disappears when the dream wakes up. One day, Long Yao had a nightmare and woke up in a panic holding the coral. When she woke up, the coral was not disappeared. It hung in the boudoir, with seven colors of light. Those who came close suddenly felt refreshed. The coral was extremely hard and could not be melted by fire and all attempts to make weapons are all failed.

After Long Yao entered the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect, Lu Jianxin attached black mud to the dream-weaving coral, burned it for nine days, and forged it into a sword. This sword is called the blue sea coral sword which was transformed by Long Yao's thoughts. When the sword intention rises, the sword will appear and when the sword intention disappears, the sword also disappears. It is rare to see Long Yao carrying the sword with her. When others are practicing swords with Long Yao, the coral sword often appears out of thin air, and when it is matched with objects, it can sense the spiritual sense and attack it. After a few rounds, its consciousness collapsed, and had no intention of fighting again. Looking at Long Yao at this time, there was no coral sword, only a smiling dragon girl remained.

滄海有仙石，喚作織夢珊瑚，此珊瑚非凡物，存于龍族夢中，夢醒則消，不可觸及，因僅見於夢中，世人皆視為傳說。一日龍瑤夢魘，驚慌中抱珊瑚而醒，夢醒而珊瑚未消，懸於閨房，有七色光輝，近者頓覺神清，珊瑚堅硬無比，火燒不化，龍族嘗鍛而為兵未果。
    後龍瑤入雲靈劍宗，陸劍心以玄土附於織夢珊瑚，燒九天方化，鍛而為劍。此劍喚作碧海珊瑚劍，為龍瑤意念所化，劍意起而劍身現，劍意滅則劍身消。平日裡難見龍瑤攜帶此劍，旁人與龍瑤練劍時，珊瑚劍常憑空而現，且以物相格時，能感神識亦為其擊，遇神識薄弱者，往僅需幾回合，神識崩潰，無意再戰，此時再看龍瑤，哪裡還有珊瑚劍身影，僅剩笑盈盈一龍族少女。

龙族较凡人更为长寿，历时久而多藏有法器。龙瑶之祖母其生年已不可考，受大道破碎之祸，修为至化神而不得突破，郁郁而终。生前独爱龙瑶，赠之以九霄玲珑镯，望其一生平安无事。
    九霄玲珑者，随主意而变幻，或大或小，大则环绕琼宇有余，小则套于指间尚紧，注灵力而起，须臾间可至九霄。镯上装饰亦随主道心而起千般变化，道心清则通体如玉或有莲花绽放或有金光乍现，道心浊则环身乌黑或有枯藤缠绕或有赤血渗出，无论清浊，皆坚硬无比，绕身而护主，利器不得近身。
    龙瑶平日里因伤较少走动，常将镯化为人身大小而乘之，比剑时，虽不如同辈修士身法出众者般灵敏，辗转腾挪之间却也不落下风，更有镯身相护，寻常修士不能伤其分毫。

Dragons live longer than mortals, and they have had more artifacts for a long time. The year of birth of Long Yao's grandmother is unknown. She suffered from the disaster of the broken Great Rules. She cultivated to the phase of Incarnation and could not break through and died in depression. During her lifetime, she only loved Long Yao. So she presented her with a Sky Delicate Bracelet, hoping that her life will be safe and sound.

Sky Delicate Bracelets change according to the owner's idea, whether they are big or small, the big ones are more than building and the small ones are still tight between the fingers. The decorations on the bracelet also change in thousands of ways according to the Dao Mindset. If the owner's mind is clear, the whole body will be like jade or there will be lotus flowers blooming, or there will be a flash of golden light; Otherwise, there will be black or entangled with withered vines or red blood will ooze. Regardless of whether it is clear or turbid, it is extremely hard, wrapping around the body to protect the owner and sharp weapons cannot come close.

Long Yao seldom walks around due to tail injuries, so she often reduces the bracelet to the size of a human and rides it. When fighting swords with fellow cultivators, although Long Yao is not as agile as those with outstanding physical skills, she is not inferior to them in controlling the movement of the bracelet, and even with the protection of the bracelet, ordinary cultivators cannot hurt her in the slightest.

龍族較凡人更為長壽，歷時久而多藏有法器。龍瑤之祖母其生年已不可考，受大道破碎之禍，修為至化神而不得突破，鬱鬱而終。生前獨愛龍瑤，贈之以九霄玲瓏鐲，望其一生平安無事。

    龍瑤平日裡因傷較少走動，常將鐲化為人身大小而乘之，比劍時，雖不如同輩修士身法出眾者般靈敏，輾轉騰挪之間卻也不落下風，更有鐲身相護，尋常修士不能傷其分毫。

连云山山麓若水村林小月，平日里行事诡谲，令人摸不着头脑。入宗门时，便似邪祟附体，行为古怪。后经为宗主所救，似驱了邪祟，身旁却多了只灵猫。看似未曾修行，却灵力远超同辈弟子。白日不见其人，夜里却听得其身上铃铛响彻山间。有好事者跟上去查看，只见一人一猫，夜里于后山采草而食，好生奇怪。
    林小月虽平日里行为奇了些，但修行却未有怠慢迹象，其剑招使出却似得了正统，尤其是灵剑招式，使将出来颇有仙者遗风。

Lin Xiaoyue in the Ruoshui Village at the foot of Lianyun Mountain is bewildered by her daily activities. When she entered the sect, she seemed to be possessed by evil spirits and behaved strangely. After being rescued by the suzerain, it seemed that the evil spirits had been driven away, but there was an extra spirit cat beside her. It seems that she has never practiced, but her Qi is far superior to that of her peers. Usually, you can't see her during the day, but at night you can hear the bells on her body resounding through the mountains. Interested people follow up to check, only to see one person and one cat, picking grass and eating in the back mountain at night, which is very strange.

Although Lin Xiaoyue usually behaved strangely, she showed no signs of neglect in her practice, and her sword moves seemed to be orthodox, especially the spirit sword moves which were quite reminiscent of the immortals.

連雲山山麓若水村林小月，平日裡行事詭譎，令人摸不著頭腦。入宗門時，便似邪祟附體，行為古怪。後經為宗主所救，似驅了邪祟，身旁卻多了只靈貓。看似未曾修行，卻靈力遠超同輩弟子。白日不見其人，夜裡卻聽得其身上鈴鐺響徹山間。有好事者跟上去查看，只見一人一貓，夜裡於後山采草而食，好生奇怪。
    林小月雖平日裡行為奇了些，但修行卻未有怠慢跡象，其劍招使出卻似得了正統，尤其是靈劍招式，使將出來頗有仙者遺風。

连云山脉东侧，云雾所化溪水沿山涧而下，于山麓汇集成河，灵气充盈，鱼美鸭肥，两岸多生植被，可入药，百姓沿河而居，捕鱼养鸭采草为生，渐成村，曰若水村。
    林小月生于若水，幼年多在近村林间玩耍，与林间生灵相处甚密，每饥时采草而食，有夜津日草，青津碧获，八天赤薤，沧浪青钱，三十六芝，火枣交梨，凤林鸣醅，玄都绮葱……所采众多不胜举也，不似寻常人家需煎草药而成汤，隔数日慢服方能消受，林小月食草，采下即食，且食多而不饱，父母大惊请医者诊之，无忧，遂也不管，久之，林小月年少却灵气充盈，颇有脱凡之姿。
    因若水村灵草众多，四周修士亦常至，寻灵草入丹，然修士皆过客，村内所剩百姓多为肉体凡胎，每待月黑风高浩气散时，常有邪祟扰，或啃噬灵草或吸人精魄。民众因恐为邪祟所伤，遂求万符宗护宅法咒，宅内平安却不敢夜出，然林小月却也不怕，常夜里遁走，与林间生灵夜游，白日里便长睡不起，父母问起答曰“与好友同游仙境”，父母皆称其痴儿，整日担忧。

On the east side of the Lianyun Mountains, the streams transformed by the clouds flow down the mountain streams and converge into rivers at the foot of the mountains. The Qi is full and the fish and ducks are fat with vegetation on both sides of the river which can be used as medicine. The people live along the river, fishing, raising ducks and fish, or picking herbs for a living. Gradually became a village, called Ruoshui village.

Lin Xiaoyue was born in Ruoshui Village. When she was young, she often played in the forest near the village. She got along very closely with the creatures in the forest. Whenever she was hungry, she picked herbs and ate them. Include noctherb, bluesarc rush, eight-day red allium, coldundae coin, trigintisix ganoderma lucidum, fire pear palm, phoenix fermented grains, and blue beautyonion... There are too many to pick, unlike ordinary people who need to decoct herbs to make soup which can be digested after a few days of slow consumption. Xianyou eats it immediately and eats too much and is never full. Her parents were shocked and asked the doctor for a diagnosis. But there is no problem. So, they gradually didn't care about this. After a long time, Xiaoyue is young but full of Qi, quite extraordinary.

Because there are many spiritual herbs in Ruoshui Village, many cultivators from all around often come here and find the spiritual herbs to add to their elixir. But those cultivators are all passersby and most of the people left in the village are mortals. On every dark night, there are evils to eating those herbs or absorbing human spirits. The people were afraid of being hurt by the evil spirits, so they prayed for the ten thousand runes sect to protect their house. The house is safe inside but they dare not go out at night, but Xiaoyue is not afraid. Unable to sleep and played with spirits in the wood at night and sleeping in the morning, her parents asked her and answered "Traveling in the fairyland with friends". Her parents called her an idiot and worried all day long.

連雲山脈東側，雲霧所化溪水沿山澗而下，于山麓彙集成河，靈氣充盈，魚美鴨肥，兩岸多生植被，可入藥，百姓沿河而居，捕魚養鴨采草為生，漸成村，曰若水村。
    林小月生於若水，幼年多在近村林間玩耍，與林間生靈相處甚密，每饑時采草而食，有夜津日草，青津碧獲，八天赤薤，滄浪青錢，三十六芝，火棗交梨，鳳林鳴醅，玄都綺蔥……所采眾多不勝舉也，不似尋常人家需煎草藥而成湯，隔數日慢服方能消受，林小月食草，采下即食，且食多而不飽，父母大驚請醫者診之，無憂，遂也不管，久之，林小月年少卻靈氣充盈，頗有脫凡之姿。
    因若水村靈草眾多，四周修士亦常至，尋靈草入丹，然修士皆過客，村內所剩百姓多為肉體凡胎，每待月黑風高浩氣散時，常有邪祟擾，或啃噬靈草或吸人精魄。民眾因恐為邪祟所傷，遂求萬符宗護宅法咒，宅內平安卻不敢夜出，然林小月卻也不怕，常夜裡遁走，與林間生靈夜遊，白日裡便長睡不起，父母問起答曰“與好友同游仙境”，父母皆稱其癡兒，整日擔憂。

林小月年幼时，林间偶遇一拖枪挂印白狸奴，梅树下成团而卧，细一瞧掌间有伤，不能捕食，身形消瘦。林小月怜之，以草药敷于伤口，又捉鱼喂之，数日便愈，狸奴报恩久不愿走，遂起名雪团，后常与林小月夜游林间，有样学样起来，亦食林间灵草。
    一夜，林小月夜游时遇邪祟，雪团护主而死，死后魂魄不散，附于林小月，林小月忽黑发转白，面露凶光，掌间青筋暴起，三两下竟将邪祟诛灭。待回村后，百姓瞧见无不骇然，以为邪祟入体，忙请云灵剑宗帮诛。适逢牧逸风领命前来，见林小月不似妖邪，遂带回云灵剑宗医治。至云灵剑宗，宗主见状，施展法阵唤出雪团，又取剑池一把踏雪剑，将其附于剑之上，林小月遂醒，后赠剑与林小月，又观其灵力极强，收为弟子。

When Lin Xiaoyue was young, she came across a white cat with a black tail and black brindle on its head lying in a ball under a plum tree. When she looked closely, it had wounds on its palms. It couldn't prey and its body was emaciated. Lin Xiaoyue took pity on it, applied herbal medicine to the wound, caught fish, and fed it. And the cat healed in a few days. The cat repaid her kindness and refused to leave for a long time, so she named it Snowball. Later on, the cat often went to the forest with Lin Xiaoyue at night, learning from her and also eating spiritual herbs in the forest like Xiaoyue.

One night, Lin Xiaoyue encountered an evil spirit while traveling at night and Snowball died protecting her master. After death, its soul lingered and attached to Lin Xiaoyue.  And Lin Xiaoyue's black hair suddenly turned white and her face looked fierce and the veins in his hands burst out.  In two or three strokes, the evil spirits were exterminated. After returning to the village, the people were horrified when they saw her, thinking that evil spirits had entered her body, so they hurriedly asked Cloud Spirit Sword Sect to kill it. It happened that Mu Yifeng was ordered to come here and seeing that Lin Xiaoyue didn't look evil and he brought her back to the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect for treatment. At the Could Spirit Sword Sect, the suzerain saw this, cast formation to call out the Snowball, took a snow-treading sword from the sword pool, and attached it to the sword. Lin Xiaoyue woke up and then gave the sword to her. It is also seen that her Qi is extremely strong so the suzerain was accepted as a disciple.

林小月年幼時，林間偶遇一拖槍掛印白狸奴，梅樹下成團而臥，細一瞧掌間有傷，不能捕食，身形消瘦。林小月憐之，以草藥敷於傷口，又捉魚喂之，數日便愈，狸奴報恩久不願走，遂起名雪團，後常與林小月夜遊林間，有樣學樣起來，亦食林間靈草。
    一夜，林小月夜遊時遇邪祟，雪團護主而死，死後魂魄不散，附于林小月，林小月忽黑髮轉白，面露凶光，掌間青筋暴起，三兩下竟將邪祟誅滅。待回村後，百姓瞧見無不駭然，以為邪祟入體，忙請雲靈劍宗幫誅。適逢牧逸風領命前來，見林小月不似妖邪，遂帶回雲靈劍宗醫治。至雲靈劍宗，宗主見狀，施展法陣喚出雪團，又取劍池一把踏雪劍，將其附於劍之上，林小月遂醒，後贈劍與林小月，又觀其靈力極強，收為弟子。

虽入仙门，却也不见林小月心性有变，昼间常于弟子房酣睡。每入夜，且听后山铃铛作响，便知林小月巡山而去。有弟子甚奇之，随其后，然林小月步伐轻快，弟子不及，于山间小道转折几次，铃声渐轻，却再也寻不着了。
    后有巡山弟子传言，林小月于后山挖坑拔草，行为甚异，恐其行邪魔外道之举，有损宗门名声。后师长查之，原是于后山种植药草，上前问询，答曰雪团喜荆芥，寻遍后山也没有，便自己种来，且夜晚山间多有灵，与其沟通于修行大为有益，师长听罢甚奇之，又观夜间群山却哪有可沟通之灵者，但见林小月只是种植灵草，便不再追究。
    林小月于后山夜寻多年，灵力愈发充盈，身旁雪团更甚，若非灵体，定早已化妖。宗门皆道此等修行法门闻所未闻，于林小月之说辞实在难以相信，如此看来，其中奥秘仅有林小月与雪团及这山间之灵知晓。

Even though she entered the immortal sect, Lin Xiaoyue's temperament did not see any change and she often slept in the disciple's room during the day. Every night, when you hear the bells ringing in the back mountain, you will know that Lin Xiaoyue is going to patrol the mountain. Some disciples were very surprised, followed by Lin Xiaoyue whose steps were very light and brisk and the disciples could not catch up. She turned several times on the mountain path, and the ringing of the bell gradually fade, and could not find her again.

Later, there were rumors among disciples patrolling the mountain that Lin Xiaoyue was digging pits and pulling weeds in the back mountain and her behavior was very strange, fearing that her actions is because of evil spirits and heretics would damage the reputation of the sect. Later, the teacher found out that she originally planted medicinal herbs in the back mountain. He went up to inquire and replied that Snowball likes nepeta, but Lin Xiaoyue couldn't find it all over the back mountain, so she planted it by herself. Besides, there are many spirits in the mountain at night and she can communicate with them, It was very beneficial for practice. The teacher was very surprised after hearing it and saw that there was no spirit to communicate within the mountains at night. But seeing that Lin Xiaoyue was only planting spiritual grass, the teacher stopped pursuing it.

Lin Xiaoyue has searched at night in the back mountain for many years and her Qi has become more and more abundant and the Snowball beside her is even better. If it is not for the spirit body, it must have already turned into a monster. Everyone in the sect said that this kind of practice method was unheard of before and Lin Xiaoyue 's words were hard to believe. From this point of view, only Lin Xiaoyue, Snowball, and the mountain spirit knew the secrets.

陆剑心，陆氏山庄庄主次子，传与氏族不合而远走西洲入云灵剑宗，平日与师兄弟沟通甚少。善锻，所居金庐有大锻炉，可造百兵。百兵皆通，较寻常剑宗弟子而力大炁长。
    曾游历三洲集铸剑良材，铸一柄澄心剑，悬于身侧。初见不过剑胚尔，然同陆剑心动起手来，澄心剑时化利剑，时变重兵，千变万化之间往往难以招架。

Lu Jianxin, the second son of the master of Lu's Villa, said to be at odds with the clan, away from the Villa to the Western Continent, joined the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect, usually little communication with masters and disciples. He is good at forging, and has a large forging furnace in the gold cottage where he lives, and can make a hundred kinds of weapons. Lu Jianxin's hundred weapons skills are proficient, compared to the ordinary cloud spirit sword sect disciples, he is strong and has profound Qi.

Lu Jianxin once traveled across three continents to collect the best materials for sword forging, and forged a Clear Heart Sword. Clear Heart Sword at first glance is just a sword embryo, but if someone started a fight with Lu Jianxin, the Clear Heart Sword will sometimes turn into sharp sword, sometimes into heavy weapon. Between a thousand changes, the opponents will often feel difficult to fight with Lu Jianxin.

陸劍心，陸氏山莊莊主次子，傳與氏族不合而遠走西洲入雲靈劍宗，平日與師兄弟溝通甚少。 善鍛，所居金廬有大鍛爐，可造百兵。 百兵皆通，較尋常劍宗弟子而力大炁長。
    曾遊歷三洲集鑄劍良材，鑄一柄澄心劍，懸於身側。 初見不過劍胚爾，然同陸劍心動起手來，澄心劍時化利劍，時變重兵，千變萬化之間往往難以招架。

北洲西北有一盘龙岭，龙脊为山，山巅有穴，脊间多隘口，所盘之处有平地数倾。时有地龙动，龙游则流岩飞灰自山巅之穴出，积年累月，岩流而气暖，灰飞而土肥。千年前有陆氏流民至此，依山而居多年，得良田百亩，家畜无数，人丁兴旺，渐成庄。
    初始，有民投石于半山间流岩中，石入流岩而通体赤红，烨烨流光，似为火龙所吞，少顷，火龙运石游至山麓，吐石成金。陆氏以金石铸器，后又依山起丈高锻炉，得铁犁、铁铲、铁镰、铁锤之众，先三洲氏族百年矣。
百年间，陆氏锻造之术闻名三洲。历代庄主率氏族修路造车，至陆子焱位庄主，山庄东通芦雪城，西接锟铻山，商道通矣。陆氏运锟铻之金石，锻为铁器、兵器、甲胄，经芦雪城而贩三洲。
    北洲多邪祟，陆氏行商常受其扰。初，陆氏雇铁骨门门人相助，扰有所缓，货却仍有损。后，庄主以灵石为筹，遣族人于三洲各仙门，习得些粗浅行炁法门。然山庄多硫磺气，行寻常法门事倍而功半，终难自成仙门，遂陆氏弟子多外出修炼。常此，陆氏得仙门相助，行商无忧矣，锻造之术亦有所进，能锻仙门法器。仅数年，三洲上品兵器甲胄多出自陆氏之手。
    弈仙六甲午年，陆子焱传庄主之位于陆修础。陆修础生剑字辈魂、心、鸣、霜四子，长子陆剑魂司外事，幺子陆剑鸣司生产，次子陆剑心求剑于云灵剑宗，独女陆剑霜问道于衔月楼。

In the northwest of North Continent there is a Pan Long Ridge, the ridge is like a dragon, the top of the mountain has a mouth, surrounded by some defiles, in the center of the Pan Long Ridge there is flat land, covering an area of several hectares. From time to time, earthquakes drive magma and dust to spurt out from the top of the mountain, and over the years, the climate of Pan Long Ridge is warm and the land is fertile. Thousands of years ago, there were Lu's exiles who came here and lived on the mountain for many years, and got a hundred acres of good land and countless livestock, gradually, the people flourished and Lu's Villa was built.

At the beginning, there are people throwing stones in the magma in the middle of the mountain. After the stone was put into the magma, it turned red and glowed, and seemed to be swallowed by the fire dragon, which swam to the foot of the mountain and spit out the stone into metal. The Lu clan cast the metal into tools, and later built a forging furnace several feet high against the mountain, producing many iron plows, shovels, scythes and hammers. Their forging technology is hundreds of years ahead of other clans in three continents.

During the past hundred years, Lu's forging skills have become famous in three continents. Successive owners of the village led their clan to build roads and vehicles, and by the time Lu Ziyan became the owner of the village, the village was connected to Luxue City in the east and KunWu Mountain in the west, so the commercial road was open. The Lu clan transported the metals of KunWu, forged them into tools, weapons and armors, and sold them to the three continents through Luxue City.

The number of devils in the North Island is more than other areas, the Lu clan merchants are often disturbed by them. At first, the clan hired the Iron Bone Sect to help, the disturbance has slowed down, but the goods are still damaged. Later, the lord of the Lu's Villa used the spirit stones as the fund, and sent the clan members to various immortal sects in the three continents to learn some rudimentary Qi methods. However, the Villa is full of sulfur gas, the use of ordinary cultivation methods here is very inefficient, therefore, the Villa is difficult to develop into an immortal door, so the Lu's disciples are mostly go to other immortal doors to cultivate. After a number of years, with the help of the immortal sects, the Lu clan gradually grew stable business, and forging skills have also improved, they are able to forge immortal weapons. Only a few years, the three continents top-quality weapons and armors mostly from the hands of the Lu clan.

YiXian calendar, six JiaWu year, , Lu Ziyan passed on the title of the head of the Villa to Lu Xiucu. Lu Xiucu had four children of the Jian generation, named Hun, Xin, Ming and Shuang. The eldest son, Lu Jianhun, was in charge of foreign affairs, the youngest son, Lu Jianming, was in charge of production, the second son, Lu Jianxin, trained in the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect, and the only daughter, Lu Jianshuang, practiced in the Moon Pavilion.

北洲西北有一盤龍嶺，龍脊為山，山巔有穴，脊間多隘口，所盤之處有平地數傾。 時有地龍動，龍遊則流岩飛灰自山巔之穴出，積年累月，岩流而氣暖，灰飛而土肥。 千年前有陸氏流民至此，依山而居多年，得良田百畝，家畜無數，人丁興旺，漸成莊。
    初始，有民投石於半山間流岩中，石入流岩而通體赤紅，燁燁流光，似為火龍所吞，少頃，火龍運石遊至山麓，吐石成金。 陸氏以金石鑄器，後又依山起丈高鍛爐，得鐵犁、鐵鏟、鐵鐮、鐵錘之眾，先三洲氏族百年矣。
百年間，陸氏鍛造之術聞名三洲。 歷代莊主率氏族修路造車，至陸子焱比特莊主，山莊東通蘆雪城，西接錕鋙山，商道通矣。 陸氏運錕鋙之金石，鍛為鐵器、兵器、甲胄，經蘆雪城而販三洲。
    北洲多邪祟，陸氏行商常受其擾。 初，陸氏雇鐵骨門門人相助，擾有所緩，貨卻仍有損。 後，莊主以靈石為籌，遣族人於三洲各仙門，習得些粗淺行炁法門。 然山莊多硫磺氣，行尋常法門事倍而功半，終難自成仙門，遂陸氏弟子多外出修煉。 常此，陸氏得仙門相助，行商無憂矣，鍛造之術亦有所進，能鍛仙門法器。 僅數年，三洲上品兵器甲胄多出自陸氏之手。
    弈仙六甲午年，陸子焱傳莊主之位於陸修礎。 陸修礎生劍字輩魂、心、鳴、霜四子，長子陸劍魂司外事，么子陸劍鳴司生產，次子陸劍心求劍於雲靈劍宗，獨女陸劍霜問道於銜月樓。

陆剑心初到云灵剑宗时，多行走于演武场，与同辈比剑，常心不在焉，眼观剑而固守不攻，同辈瞧见皆觉其傲。仅数月，又多待于剑池，每欲下池捞剑，尽被长老制止。见宗门内已无新奇之物，陆剑心始外出云游，每归时径直回居。
    有巡山弟子过陆剑心居所，只见其竹居走水，四周草木皆已燃尽。弟子助陆剑心浇灭山火，后告知长老。长老劝陆剑心摒弃杂念，一心修剑。今所居之峰先天炁有损，须另择良峰。陆剑心不以为意，长老不悦。过数月，又有弟子巡山，见陆剑心竹居换石庐，又走水，石庐尽毁，陆剑心立于废墟前，若有所思。弟子均上前欲相助，陆剑心只摆手而拒。弟子见此峰已毁无所毁，遂悻悻然而走。
    翌日，陆剑心重至演武场，却也不带剑，身负大袋别门兵器，一件件使将开来。众弟子愠，责陆剑心屡破门规不知悔改。陆剑心漫不经心拱手，引同辈修士上前比试。有同辈修士引剑相击，只觉虎口大震，相斗数回合竟败下阵来。其余弟子皆惊然，纷纷上前相斗。比至三个时辰，陆剑心未显疲态，甚有愈战愈勇之势。众弟子渐力竭，只得结剑阵合力击之，须臾间，陆剑心所带兵器尽数折毁。见手中已无兵器，陆剑心颔首称妙，说罢转身离去，剩众弟子面面相觑。
    又数月，有弟子见陆剑心石庐换金庐，山峰时有火光印天，惊呼众修士观之。原是那金庐为一大锻炉，承陆氏技艺，起炉时夜明如白昼，能熔万金，击铁时金声震山林，百鸟飞尽。庐内锻造之器一应俱全，陆剑心以铸剑之技助修行，又以修行之悟精技艺，二者相辅相成皆大进。后宗门宝剑多出于陆剑心之手。

When Lu Jianxin first arrived at the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect, he often went to the martial arts arena to compete with his peers, but he was often distracted, with his eyes fixed on his opponent's sword, just not attacking, and his peers all found him arrogant. After a few months, Lu Jianxin no longer went to the martial arts arena, instead, he often stayed in the sword pool, and every time he wanted to go into the pool to fish for the sword at the bottom of the pool, he was stopped by the seniors. Seeing that the sect has no novelty, Lu Jianxin began to go out to travel, each time he returned, he returned straight to his hut, without any communication with other disciples.

A disciple on his rounds passed by Lu Jianxin's residence and saw that his bamboo hut was on fire and the grass and trees around it were all burnt out. The disciple helped Lu Jianxin douse the fire and then informed the seniors. The seniors advised Lu Jianxin to give up his distracting thoughts and concentrate on sword training. The peak he was living in now had lost its natural qi, so he had to choose another suitable peak. Lu Jianxin was not moved, and the seniors were not pleased. After a few months, and a disciple patrol the mountain, see Lu Jianxin bamboo hut replaced by stone hut, but also catch fire, and the stone hut was destroyed also, Lu Jianxin stood in front of the ruins, as if he was pondering. The disciple went forward to help, Lu Jianxin only waved his hand and refused. The disciple saw this peak already has nothing to destroy, so leave with resentment.

The next day, Lu Jianxin went back to the martial arts field, but did not bring his sword. He was carrying a large bag of other weapons and practicing them one by one. The disciples were angry and accused Lu Jianxin of repeatedly breaking the rules of the sect without repentance. Lu Jianxin carelessly arched his hand and invited fellow cultivators to come forward to contest. A fellow cultivator led his sword to strike at Lu Jianxin. When their weapons met, the cultivator felt a great shock in his hand, and lost the battle in a few rounds. The rest of the disciples were shocked and went forward to fight with Lu Jianxin. By the end of three hours, Lu Jianxin did not show any fatigue and even had the tendency to fight more and more courageously. The disciples were exhausted and had to form a sword formation to cooperate in the fight, and in a short time, all the weapons Lu Jianxin had brought were broken. Seeing that there were no weapons in his hands, Lu Jianxin nodded his head and said it was brilliant, and then turned around and left, leaving the disciples to look at each other with confusion.

After a few months, a disciple saw Lu Jianxin stone hut turned into a golden hut, the mountain peak where he lived has fire light from time to time, so the disciple called others to view it. It turns out that the golden hut is a big forging furnace, the golden hut inherited Lu's skill, when the furnace started fire, it could melt thousands of metal, and the night will become as bright as the day. When Lu Jianxin began to forge the sword, the sound of beating iron shakes the mountains and forests, all the birds were frightened and flew away. The forging apparatus in the gold lodge is all set, Lu Jianxin helps his cultivation with his skill of forging swords, and refines the skill of forging swords with the enlightenment of cultivation, both of them complement each other and make great progress. Thereafter, the sect swords are mostly by the hand of Lu Jianxin.

陸劍心初到雲靈劍宗時，多行走於演武場，與同輩比劍，常心不在焉，眼觀劍而固守不攻，同輩瞧見皆覺其傲。 僅數月，又多待於劍池，每欲下池撈劍，盡被長老制止。 見宗門內已無新奇之物，陸劍心始外出雲遊，每歸時徑直回居。
    有巡山弟子過陸劍心居所，只見其竹居走水，四周草木皆已燃盡。 弟子助陸劍心澆滅山火，後告知長老。 長老勸陸劍心摒弃雜念，一心修劍。 今所居之峰先天炁有損，須另擇良峰。 陸劍心不以為意，長老不悅。 過數月，又有弟子巡山，見陸劍心竹居換石廬，又走水，石廬盡毀，陸劍心立於廢墟前，若有所思。 弟子均上前欲相助，陸劍心只擺手而拒。 弟子見此峰已毀無所毀，遂悻悻然而走。
    翌日，陸劍心重至演武場，卻也不帶劍，身負大袋別門兵器，一件件使將開來。 眾弟子慍，責陸劍心屢破門規不知悔改。 陸劍心漫不經心拱手，引同輩修士上前比試。 有同輩修士引劍相擊，只覺虎口大震，相鬥數回合竟敗下陣來。 其餘弟子皆驚然，紛紛上前相鬥。 比至三個時辰，陸劍心未顯疲態，甚有愈戰愈勇之勢。 眾弟子漸力竭，只得結劍陣合力擊之，須臾間，陸劍心所帶兵器盡數折毀。 見手中已無兵器，陸劍心頷首稱妙，說罷轉身離去，剩眾弟子面面相覷。
    又數月，有弟子見陸劍心石廬換金廬，山峰時有火光印天，驚呼眾修士觀之。 原是那金廬為一大鍛爐，承陸氏技藝，起爐時夜明如白晝，能熔萬金，擊鐵時金聲震山林，百鳥飛盡。 廬內鍛造之器一應俱全，陸劍心以鑄劍之技助修行，又以修行之悟精技藝，二者相輔相成皆大進。 後宗門寶劍多出於陸劍心之手。

宗门弟子间有传，陆剑心与其父不合，遂修行数年不见其似寻常陆氏一般归庄探亲。又有传，陆剑心与其兄弟于铸剑之道不合。陆氏兄弟铸剑主数，为满三洲之需，常产下品兵甲，其中残品之数亦不在少，每有仙门所托，皆交于庄中老者。而陆剑心铸剑主品，更似庄中老者，铸一剑而常数月闭门不出。而近陆剑心者传，陆剑心与陆氏不可谓不亲，常有陆氏拜山，每至，所赠金石良木，锦罗绸缎，灵石仙玉，灵丹仙草不可计数。
    然陆剑心之剑道，仅一心一剑尔。陆剑心少时便喜剑，不似寻常孩童喧闹好动，整日只静坐于大锻炉旁，观庄中老者铸剑。年稍长，铁器甲胄兵器无一不造，兵器造好，使将开来，亦有模有样。
    后陆剑心入云灵剑宗，常外出寻铸剑之良材。数年，东海滨收紫玉玄团，南群岭采斑蓝雀金，西林地伐碧青香木，北雪山取赤焰琉璃。归庐后陆剑心掷良材入锻炉，开炉铸剑。初不相融，陆剑心以炁催炉而炼。至炁尽，又燃灵石，所燃灵石之众，金庐内如炼狱，浊气外泄罩山脉，灵气四散引得护山之灵皆侧目。宗主得报，只道陆剑心命有此劫，旁人切勿干扰。
    燃至七七四十九日，良材相融，陆剑心忙灌材入剑范，只见其剑柄成型，至剑身却无转冷之象。捶打之下剑温不降反升，陆剑心甚奇，引血淬之，剑得炁，不御自悬。至此，陆剑心与剑胚意相通，剑意长则剑锋利，道心怒则剑身灼。一心求一剑而胜万剑，此剑名为澄心。

There is a rumor among the disciples of the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect that Lu Jianxin and his father do not get along well on a regular basis, so Lu Jianxin has not returned to the village to visit his family like an ordinary Lu for several years of training in the sect. There are also rumors, Lu Jianxin and his brother in the sword forging philosophy has a conflict. The Lu brothers advocate forging swords in quantity first, in order to meet the needs of the three continents, they often produce low-grade weapons and armor, of which the number of defective products are not a few. Whenever the Immortal Sect entrusted the Lu's to forge magic weapons, the Lu brothers had to give the work to the more experienced blacksmiths in the Villa. The difference is that Lu Jianxin forging sword advocates quality first, more like the experienced blacksmiths in the village, forging swords often months in seclusion. In another rumor, a clan disciple, claiming to have a good relationship with Lu Jianxin, he revealed that Lu Jianxin and the Lu clan actually have a good relationship, he often saw some Lu disciples come to the clan, visiting Lu Jianxin, each time they came, brought Lu Jianxin a large number of metals, spiritual wood, brocade, spiritual stones, immortal jade, spiritual pills, immortal herbs, which are too many to count.

However, Lu Jianxin's sword path, not as complicated as rumors, only one heart and one sword. Lu Jianxin like the sword when he was young, unlike ordinary children noisy and active, Lu Jianxin only sit quietly by the big forging furnace, watching the old blacksmith in the village forging swords. When Lu Jianxin was a little older, there was no weapon that he could not forge. Whenever Lu Jianxin made a weapon, he had to personally wield the weapon to test it. When Lu Jianxin wielded the weapon, it was as if he had been specializing in the skill of using the weapon for many years.

Later, Lu Jianxin joined the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect, he often went out to look for good materials that could be used for forging swords. For a few years, he collected purple jade basalt on the east coast, picked blue sparrow gold in the southern mountains, cut green fragrant wood in the west woodland, and took red flame glaze in the north snow mountain. After returning to the hut, Lu Jianxin threw the good material into the forging furnace, opened the furnace forging sword. At first, the material does not melt, Lu Jianxin use Qi to push the furnace to increase the fire power. When Lu Jianxin ran out of Qi, he began to put the spirit stone into the furnace, the burning spirit stone is numerous, the gold hut hot as purgatory, turbid Qi leakage cover cloud spirit sword sect mountain range, Qi scattered to attract the guardian spirits of the mountain to gather around. The master was reported, only said Lu Jianxin fate has this calamity, others must not interfere.

The burning continued for forty-nine days, the materials in the forging furnace began to melt together, Lu Jianxin busy filling materials into the sword Fan, only to see the material gradually changed into the shape of the sword, the hilt has been shaped, but the sword body is still red. Lu Jianxin began to hammer the sword body, but the sword body temperature does not drop but rise, Lu Jianxin was surprised, after thinking for a moment, Lu Jianxin used his own blood to complete the quenching of the sword, the sword got qi, the sword body began to take shape, the shaped sword embryo began to float beside Lu Jianxin. At this point, Lu Jianxin and the sword embryo were connected. The sword embryo would become sharp when Lu Jianxin's will was strong, and the sword body would become hot when Lu Jianxin became angry. One heart seeks one sword, one sword superior to ten thousand swords, this sword is named Clear Heart Sword.

    燃至七七四十九日，良材相融，陸劍心忙灌材入劍範，只見其劍柄成型，至劍身卻無轉冷之象。 捶打之下劍溫不降反昇，陸劍心甚奇，引血淬之，劍得炁，不禦自懸。 至此，陸劍心與劍胚意相通，劍意長則劍鋒利，道心怒則劍身灼。 一心求一劍而勝萬劍，此劍名為澄心。

黎承云，东洲青烟郡黎氏幺女。年幼拜入云灵剑宗，受掌门点拨而悟瑞应神剑剑招。得掌门口令以监众弟子修行。

    平日黎承云常御剑而游连云群山，收八方来风之灵气而修为大进。因其生性活泼，常与众弟子闲谈而扰宗门清修，常为掌门处罚。

Li Chengyun is the youngest daughter of the Li Clan in Qing Yan County, East Continent. She joined the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect at a young age, and learnt about the Ruiying Divine Sword's moves from the master's instructions. She was instructed by the Sect Master to supervise the training of the disciples.
    By chance, she was able to obtain a good material from the immortals and forged a Yeying Sword. The sword's weight could be adjusted to its owner, and it consumed very little Qi to fly in the air. However, Cheng Yun is still young and small, so he is still a bit inconvenienced to use the Yeying with the same height. Fortunately, this year, she has grown half an inch taller, and her sword moves have improved slightly.
    On weekdays Li Chengyun often travelled to Lianyun mountains with her sword, collecting the spiritual qi of the winds from all directions and improving her cultivation greatly. Because of its lively nature, often gossip with the disciples and disturb the sect's cultivation, often punished by the master.

黎承雲，東洲青煙郡黎氏幺女。年幼拜入雲靈劍宗，受掌門點撥而悟瑞應神劍劍招。得掌門口令以監眾弟子修行。
    機緣之下得上仙良材，鑄一柄曳影。神兵認主，輕重自如，禦空所耗靈氣甚少。然承雲因尚年幼身小，使起等身高的曳影仍有些周轉不開。好在今歲長高了半寸，劍招略有進。
    平日黎承雲常禦劍而遊連雲群山，收八方來風之靈氣而修為大進。因其生性活潑，常與眾弟子閑談而擾宗門清修，常為掌門處罰。

中古时，西洲南海滨时有魔族肆虐，陵光牧氏退之，观东西二洲交界有群山，云海连绵，灵气充沛，遂定居于此而拒魔物。四周散族闻风而聚，始靠山而居。
    时凶兽繇入魔，力通天，感三洲南部灵气聚集，为其所引。后繇至连云山脉，食生灵无数，生灵尽而吞土，群峰几尽。饱而吐水为泽，绵延百里，往西近火焰山方止。群山修士不敌，皆退至高峰以避繇。众修士与繇相斗数日，牧氏宗主战至力尽，元神破碎而卒，神破之势洞穿苍穹，苍穹裂而有巨剑出，斩繇于峰顶，又降祥瑞之雨濯清毒泽，遂群山生灵无忧。后幸存之人皆拜牧氏为主，奉斩繇巨剑为瑞应，此天魔之战后剑修重生，而云灵剑宗初成。
    经千年，瑞应灵气散尽而同群山合一。云灵剑宗修士绕瑞应剑璧而建悟剑栈道，平日步栈道观神剑璧以悟道。有长老传剑璧内蕴剑招，需用心观之方可得，然众弟子常观而不得。日久，观剑璧弟子少矣。
    今有青烟郡黎氏幺女承云，幼时常听族中长者所述牧氏抗魔，牧氏后人御剑除魔之事，心生向往，遂年幼而拜入云灵剑宗。
    初入剑宗，承云即为神剑璧所引，数日盘坐于栈道，不动不食。围观弟子渐众，皆觉承云道龄尚幼，如此辟谷恐性命有损。有弟子劝之，承云目视神剑璧，不移分毫，似未闻一般，遂弟子报之于掌门。掌门至，见承云盘坐，示意四下禁声，手掐剑诀，运气轻点承云后颈大椎穴。轻点之下，承云忽动，大呼“得道”，语左右曰神剑璧内蕴万千招式，诚邀弟子共同研习。掌门大悦，传令承云，命其好生督促弟子参研神剑剑招。
    此后，承云虽道龄尚幼，修为不足，却将所悟剑招融会贯通，成己剑招。后承云从旁指点同门弟子，仗掌门所赐口令，常耳提面命同门弟子，每有不足，一点即通。初，众弟子觉受女娃教诲，实在有失颜面，然承云指点之下，众弟子剑法却均有大进。久之，承云多为众弟子所喜爱。

In the Middle Ages, there were devils rampaging along the southern coast of the Western Continent, and the Lingshuang Mu clan defeat the devils, after that, they saw that there were mountains at the border of the Eastern and Western Continent, with a continuous sea of clouds and an abundance of spiritual qi, so they settled there to reject the devils. The surrounding scattered clans heard the trend and gathered, and began to live by the mountains.

At that time, the beast Yao became a devil, and its power was heavenly, sensing the gathering of spiritual qi in the southern part of the three continents, and it was attracted by it. After the beast went to the Lianyun Mountain Range, it ate countless living beings and swallowed all the earth, and the peaks of the mountain ranges were exhausted. When it was full, it spat out water to become a swamp, which stretched for hundreds of miles and stopped near the Flame Mountain in the west. Cultivators of the mountains were unable to defeat him and retreated to the peaks to avoid him. Cultivators fought with Yao for several days, and the master of the Mu clan fought to the end of his strength, and his spirit was broken and died, and the broken spirit pierced through the dome of the sky, which was cracked and there was a huge sword appeared, and it chopped Yao on the top of the peak, and sent down auspicious rains to wash and clear the poisonous swamps, and then the living beings in the mountains were free from worry. Afterwards, all the survivors worshipped Mu as their master, and worshiped the huge sword as the Ruiyin, thus the sword cultivator was reborn after the battle of the Heavenly Devil, and the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect was first formed.

After thousands of years, Ruiyin's Qi was dispersed and united with the mountains. Cloud Spirit Sword Sect cultivators built the Wujian Plank Road around the Ruiying Sword, and they would walk along the plank road on regular days to observe the Sword to understand the Dao. Some elders said that the Sword contains sword moves, which can only be obtained by observing it with all one's heart, but all the disciples often observe it without being able to do so. As time passed, there were fewer disciples to watch the sword.

Now there is a Qing Yan County Li's youngest daughter Li Chengyun, when she was young, she often listened to the elders in the clan said that the Mu's battle against the devil, the Mu's descendants of riding a sword to get rid of the devil, and the young girl's heart was attracted to, so Li chengyun worshiped in the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect at a young age.

When she first entered the Sword Sect, Chengyun was attracted by the divine Sword and sat on the plank road for several days without moving or eating. The disciples who watched were all aware that Chengyun was still young, and that they were afraid that her life would be in danger if she did not eat. A disciple advised, Chengyun eyes just gazed at the divine Sword, do not move the slightest bit, as if she had not heard anything, so the disciple reported to the head master. The master arrived, see Chengyun sitting on the plank, he ordered the sound silence, and his hand pinched the sword knack, so his Qi lightly touched the back of Chengyun's neck. Under the light point, Chengyun suddenly moved, shouted ‘I've got the Dao’, and said to surroundings that the Divine Sword contains thousands of strokes, and invite disciples to study together. The master was pleased, order Chengyun to supervise his disciples to participate in the study of the divine sword's sword moves.

Since then, although Chengyun was still young and her cultivation was insufficient, she integrated the sword strokes that she had learnt into her own sword strokes. After Chengyun began to instruct her fellow disciples, with the command given to her by the master, she often instructed her fellow disciples every time there was a deficiency, and she was always able to help them overcome it. At the beginning, the disciples felt that it was disgraceful to be taught by a child, but under the guidance of Chengyun, all the disciples' sword skills were greatly improved. Over time, Chengyun became a favourite among the disciples.

中古時，西洲南海濱時有魔族肆虐，陵光牧氏退之，觀東西二洲交界有群山，雲海連綿，靈氣充沛，遂定居於此而拒魔物。四周散族聞風而聚，始靠山而居。
    時兇獸繇入魔，力通天，感三洲南部靈氣聚集，為其所引。後繇至連雲山脈，食生靈無數，生靈盡而吞土，群峰幾盡。飽而吐水為澤，綿延百裏，往西近火焰山方止。群山修士不敵，皆退至高峰以避繇。眾修士與繇相鬥數日，牧氏宗主戰至力盡，元神破碎而卒，神破之勢洞穿蒼穹，蒼穹裂而有巨劍出，斬繇於峰頂，又降祥瑞之雨濯清毒澤，遂群山生靈無憂。後幸存之人皆拜牧氏為主，奉斬繇巨劍為瑞應，此天魔之戰後劍修重生，而雲靈劍宗初成。
    經千年，瑞應靈氣散盡而同群山合一。雲靈劍宗修士繞瑞應劍璧而建悟劍棧道，平日步棧道觀神劍璧以悟道。有長老傳劍璧內蘊劍招，需用心觀之方可得，然眾弟子常觀而不得。日久，觀劍璧弟子少矣。
    今有青煙郡黎氏幺女承雲，幼時常聽族中長者所述牧氏抗魔，牧氏後人禦劍除魔之事，心生向往，遂年幼而拜入雲靈劍宗。
    初入劍宗，承雲即為神劍璧所引，數日盤坐於棧道，不動不食。圍觀弟子漸眾，皆覺承雲道齡尚幼，如此辟谷恐性命有損。有弟子勸之，承雲目視神劍璧，不移分毫，似未聞一般，遂弟子報之於掌門。掌門至，見承雲盤坐，示意四下禁聲，手掐劍訣，運氣輕點承雲後頸大椎穴。輕點之下，承雲忽動，大呼「得道」，語左右曰神劍璧內蘊萬千招式，誠邀弟子共同研習。掌門大悅，傳令承雲，命其好生督促弟子參研神劍劍招。
    此後，承雲雖道齡尚幼，修為不足，卻將所悟劍招融會貫通，成己劍招。後承雲從旁指點同門弟子，仗掌門所賜口令，常耳提面命同門弟子，每有不足，一點即通。初，眾弟子覺受女娃教誨，實在有失顏面，然承雲指點之下，眾弟子劍法卻均有大進。久之，承雲多為眾弟子所喜愛。

一日，承云于栈道打坐之时，耳旁闻缥缈之声，曰，后辈承吾志，诛魔当争先。声未绝而群山震荡，神剑璧忽金光乍现，有崩裂之势。少顷，声止。众弟子寻金光而至，见承云身前神剑璧现金光万丈。金光之盛，引众长老至，长老观之亦惧其神威而不敢上前。彼时，其金光极矣，然全则必缺，极则必反，正众人踱步之间，金光内敛入璧。刹那，只听得神剑璧隆隆作响，一玄黑石块自神剑璧崩裂而出，直落于承云身侧。
    众人惊，不敢上前。承云战栗，颤悠悠伸指轻触石块，却见那石块默默然无甚反应。 遂众人安心，上前欲将石块运至主殿请掌门发落。然众人搬石块，石块不动分毫。又试他法，或运气而搬，或以法器收之，皆不得动。承云心急如火燎，上前抱石块，石块竟轻若无物，众人惊奇。
    待承云运石块至主殿，示于掌门，掌门观之亦觉惊奇，道，自上仙斩魔以来，传千年不见神剑异动，今神剑有损，是告诫我等有魔将犯禁耶？正欲收石块，而石块自悬，藏于承云身后。掌门笑曰此石与尔有仙缘，暂且收下，静待他用。
    次日，陆剑心闻讯至，欲将石块带至金庐铸为神兵。然运之不动，只得请承云一道移步金庐。待到金庐，剑心以锤击石块而不崩，以火烧石块而不化。是剑心以百般锻造之术，亦拿石块无可奈何。正恼，见承云以锤击石，石块即变，不出数下已平如门板。剑心大喜，从旁相教承云铸剑之法。一时金庐火光冲天，金石相击之声不断。仅数时辰，火光即收，有黑影破庐而出。黑影形似剑，凌空盘桓，有虎啸龙吟之声。忽，剑池万剑齐出，随其影而御空，其势浩浩然，摇曳云巅，若飞龙在天。少顷，黑影落而万剑归池。剑心见此剑颇有上仙神兵之姿，取名曳影。
    曳影较其他修士佩剑为大，身长近承云，寻常修士拿其不动，不知其几千斤也。承云持曳影，因有神兵认主，不觉其重，却亦因其大而使将开时失了灵巧，所记剑招无法融会贯通。然承云尝再访金庐重铸曳影，曳影却已无坚可摧不动分毫。

One day, Chengyun was meditating on the Wujian plank road, suddenly she heard a misty voice beside her ear, said, the younger generation to undertake my will, all devils shell be found and killed. The sound is not over and the mountains shook,the divine sword suddenly shines golden, and there is a tendency to collapse. A short while, the sound stop. The disciples to find the golden light, see in front of Chengyun the divine sword bright light. The golden light of the flourish, attracted the elders arrived, the elders viewed also fear of its divine power and do not dare to go forward. At that time, the golden light is extremely, but everything has its counterpoint, while all the people pacing between the golden light, the golden light gathered into the Sword's body. In an instant, only heard the divine sword rumbling, a black stone from the divine sword crumbling out, straight down on the side of the Chengyun.

The crowd is shocked, do not dare to go forward. Chengyun was trembling, shaking and reaching out to touch the stone, but saw that the stone silently did not react. So all the people feel at ease, and want to transport the stone to the main hall to ask the head master to deal with it. However, all the people moved the stone, the stone did not move a bit. They also tried other methods, such as moving the stone with Qi or using magic crafts to collect it, but none of them move the stone. Chengyun was as anxious as fire, and she went up to hold the stone block, but she felt that the stone block was as light as nothing, and the people were amazed.

When Chengyun transported the stone to the main hall, shown it to the head master, the head master viewed it also felt surprised, said, since the immortal beheading the devil, it has been rumoured that the divine sword is not changed for thousands of years, and this time the divine sword is damaged, is it a warning to us that there are devils trying to invades the three continents? Then the head master wanted to collect the stone, but the stone was suspended by itself and hidden behind the back of Li Chengyun. The master laughed and said that this stone and Chengyun have immortal fate, so Chengyun need to receive it, and wait for it come to use.

The next day, Lu Jianxin heard the news and arrived, he wanted to bring the stone to the Golden Hut and cast it as a divine weapon. However, the stone is too heavy to carry, so Lu had to ask Chengyun to help him to move the stone to the golden hut. after the stone arrived, Lu Jianxin began to hammer and burn the stone, but the stone did not crumble or melt. Lu jianxin uses all sorts of forging techniques, but the stone has stay the same. While Lu Jianxin was annoyed, see Chengyun hammer the stone, the stone suddenly began to change, within a few hammers it has been as flat as a door plate. Jianxin was very happy, and taught Chengyun the method of sword casting from the side. Instantly gold hut fire light in the sky, the sound of gold and stone constantly. Only a few hours, the fire light closed, there is a black shadow broken hut and out. The black shadow shaped like a sword, hovering in the air, there is the sound of a tiger whistling and dragon roaring. Suddenly, there are thousands of swords come out of the sword pool, followed the shadow and fly in the air, its momentum is vast, swaying the top of the cloud, as if a dragon flying in the sky. A few moments, the black shadow fell and ten thousand swords return to the pool. Jianxin see this sword seems contain the power of the Immortals, so he named it Yeying, which refers to an immortal's weapon.

Yeying is bigger than other cultivators' swords, the length of the body is close to Chengyun, ordinary cultivators can't hold it, and don't know how many thousands of pounds it is. Chengyun can hold Yeying, because the divine weapon can recognise its owner. Chengyun do not feel the sword's weight, but because of its size, it will make Chengyun's move lost its dexterity, so she can't integrate the sword's moves into a coherent whole. However, when Chengyun tried to visit the Golden Hut to recast Yeying, it was already indestructible and did not move a bit.

一日，承雲於棧道打坐之時，耳旁聞縹緲之聲，曰，後輩承吾誌，誅魔當爭先。聲未絕而群山震蕩，神劍璧忽金光乍現，有崩裂之勢。少頃，聲止。眾弟子尋金光而至，見承雲身前神劍璧現金光萬丈。金光之盛，引眾長老至，長老觀之亦懼其神威而不敢上前。彼時，其金光極矣，然全則必缺，極則必反，正眾人踱步之間，金光內斂入璧。剎那，只聽得神劍璧隆隆作響，一玄黑石塊自神劍璧崩裂而出，直落於承雲身側。
    眾人驚，不敢上前。承雲戰栗，顫悠悠伸指輕觸石塊，卻見那石塊默默然無甚反應。 遂眾人安心，上前欲將石塊運至主殿請掌門發落。然眾人搬石塊，石塊不動分毫。又試他法，或運氣而搬，或以法器收之，皆不得動。承雲心急如火燎，上前抱石塊，石塊竟輕若無物，眾人驚奇。
    待承雲運石塊至主殿，示於掌門，掌門觀之亦覺驚奇，道，自上仙斬魔以來，傳千年不見神劍異動，今神劍有損，是告誡我等有魔將犯禁耶？正欲收石塊，而石塊自懸，藏於承雲身後。掌門笑曰此石與爾有仙緣，暫且收下，靜待他用。
    次日，陸劍心聞訊至，欲將石塊帶至金廬鑄為神兵。然運之不動，只得請承雲一道移步金廬。待到金廬，劍心以錘擊石塊而不崩，以火燒石塊而不化。是劍心以百般鍛造之術，亦拿石塊無可奈何。正惱，見承雲以錘擊石，石塊即變，不出數下已平如門板。劍心大喜，從旁相教承雲鑄劍之法。一時金廬火光沖天，金石相擊之聲不斷。僅數時辰，火光即收，有黑影破廬而出。黑影形似劍，淩空盤桓，有虎嘯龍吟之聲。忽，劍池萬劍齊出，隨其影而禦空，其勢浩浩然，搖曳雲巔，若飛龍在天。少頃，黑影落而萬劍歸池。劍心見此劍頗有上仙神兵之姿，取名曳影。
    曳影較其他修士佩劍為大，身長近承雲，尋常修士拿其不動，不知其幾千斤也。承雲持曳影，因有神兵認主，不覺其重，卻亦因其大而使將開時失了靈巧，所記劍招無法融會貫通。然承雲嘗再訪金廬重鑄曳影，曳影卻已無堅可摧不動分毫。

连云山脉东临百川之凉风，南面沧海之巨风，西受陵光之炎风，北收北境之寒风。山脉聚八方来风，阴阳相汇而灵气变化万千。然山脉广大，却弟子散居，众弟子常因居所灵气相异，而修为相去甚远。群山之中，灵气多聚于主、云、灵、剑四峰，需弟子御剑前往而修，以消灵气相异之扰。
    寻常弟子御剑耗灵甚多，而黎承云得曳影相助，于群山间来往，皆乘风而行，耗灵甚少。遂弟子常见凌空有黑影穿梭，往来弟子居所，助弟子往来各主峰修炼。常此，每日与承云相谈弟子众，宗门要事，小道传言，承云尽数听来，又传于他人。是故连云山脉之风，尽收于承云耳矣。
    宗门传言皆收于耳，承云不觉足，后常来往山麓听风殿。每接待别派弟子之时，承云皆热情相待，常行互通有无之举。日久，三洲大事，亦难逃其耳。一时门派风言四起，众弟子心散而不修。掌门寻风而捉承云，罚其闭关思过三月方止。
    后承云常随群山八方之风而修，是以年幼之躯承连云山脉之灵韵，修为以日增。遂承云入门日浅，修为却超寻常弟子，加之神兵傍身，一时声威如日中天。所谓树大招风风撼树，人为名高名丧人。日久，门内渐有传言，曰黎承云为掌门私生，遂有甚好处皆为其得。又有传，黎氏处心积虑，图谋宗门神兵已久。传言种种，承云听来也不恼，反而大笑附和，又自夸曰，黎氏一族为上仙血脉，遂有神兵认主，日后诛魔还须其当先。此言一出，众哗然，信者、不信者皆有，吵作一团。一时，宗门上下又若旋风过境，乱作一团。掌门叹道，是故风起则云涌，有此风常驻，云难清净也。遂承云又被罚闭关思过，三月不见其人。

The Lianyun Mountain Range faces the cool winds of the Hundred Rivers in the east, the giant winds of the Canghai Sea in the south, the hot winds of the Lingguang in the west, and the cold winds of the North in the north. The mountain range gathers winds from all directions, and the qi changes in a thousand ways as yin and yang converge. However, the mountains are vast, but the disciples are scattered, the disciples often due to the residence of the qi is different, and the cultivation is far from each other. Among the mountains, the spiritual qi is mostly gathered in the main, cloud, spirit, sword four peaks, disciples need to ride the sword to go to cultivate, in order to eliminate the disturbance of the different spiritual qi.

While ordinary disciples ride their swords and consume a lot of spirit, Li Chengyun, with the help of Yeying, travelled between the mountains on the wind, consuming very little spirit. As a result, it was common for disciples to see black shadows travelling in the air to and from the disciples' residences, helping them to travel to and from the main peaks for training. Often this, every day and Chengyun chat with the disciples, the important things of the clan, the trail rumours, Chengyun hear, and passed on to others. Therefore, the rumors wind of the Lianyun Mountain Range, all collected in the Chengyun's ear.

Sect rumours are all collected in the ear, Cheng yun do not feel enough, and then she often come and go to the foothills to Tingfeng Hall. Whenever they have visitor disciples of other sects, Chengyun will be warmly welcome them, and exchange information with them. Over time, the three continents events, it is difficult to escape Li Chengyun's ears. At a time when the sect wind rumours, all the disciples heart dispersed and do not cultivate. The headmaster searched for the wind and caught Chengyun, punished her with closed-door thinking for three months.

Later, Chengyun often followed the winds of the mountains and cultivation, so the young body bearing the spirit of the Lianyun Mountain Range, and her cultivation to increase day by day. Thus Chengyun entry the sect for shot time, but her cultivation is more than ordinary disciples, plus the divine weapon, her reputation is as high as the sky for a while. As the saying goes, ‘A big tree attracts the wind and shakes the tree, and a person's name is a high name and a person's name is lost'. Over time, there are rumours that Li Chengyun was a bastard of the head master, so there are many benefits for her. There are also rumours, Li's intention to seek the Sect's Divine Weapon for a long time. Li Chengyun felt not annoyed by the rumours, but laughed and agreed, and boasted that Li's clan for the immortal bloodline, so there are always has divine weapons to identify Li clan as they master, in the future all devils shall be put to death by the Li's hand. Once this statement was made, the crowd burst into an uproar, those who believe, those who don't believe make a mess of noise. For a moment, the whole clan is like a whirlwind, in chaos. The head master sighed, and said, when the wind rises, the cloud surges, with this Wind resident, the Cloud is difficult to be peaceful again. So Chengyun was punished and closed for three months again.

連雲山脈東臨百川之涼風，南面滄海之巨風，西受陵光之炎風，北收北境之寒風。山脈聚八方來風，陰陽相匯而靈氣變化萬千。然山脈廣大，卻弟子散居，眾弟子常因居所靈氣相異，而修為相去甚遠。群山之中，靈氣多聚於主、雲、靈、劍四峰，需弟子禦劍前往而修，以消靈氣相異之擾。
    尋常弟子禦劍耗靈甚多，而黎承雲得曳影相助，於群山間來往，皆乘風而行，耗靈甚少。遂弟子常見淩空有黑影穿梭，往來弟子居所，助弟子往來各主峰修煉。常此，每日與承雲相談弟子眾，宗門要事，小道傳言，承雲盡數聽來，又傳於他人。是故連雲山脈之風，盡收於承雲耳矣。
    宗門傳言皆收於耳，承雲不覺足，後常來往山麓聽風殿。每接待別派弟子之時，承雲皆熱情相待，常行互通有無之舉。日久，三洲大事，亦難逃其耳。一時門派風言四起，眾弟子心散而不修。掌門尋風而捉承雲，罰其閉關思過三月方止。
    後承雲常隨群山八方之風而修，是以年幼之軀承連雲山脈之靈韻，修為以日增。遂承雲入門日淺，修為卻超尋常弟子，加之神兵傍身，一時聲威如日中天。所謂樹大招風風撼樹，人為名高名喪人。日久，門內漸有傳言，曰黎承雲為掌門私生，遂有甚好處皆為其得。又有傳，黎氏處心積慮，圖謀宗門神兵已久。傳言種種，承雲聽來也不惱，反而大笑附和，又自誇曰，黎氏一族為上仙血脈，遂有神兵認主，日後誅魔還須其當先。此言一出，眾嘩然，信者、不信者皆有，吵作一團。一時，宗門上下又若旋風過境，亂作一團。掌門嘆道，是故風起則雲湧，有此風常駐，雲難清凈也。遂承雲又被罰閉關思過，三月不見其人。

谭舒雁，西洲谭国公主，国灭，流亡于东洲，为七星阁所救。为承谭氏风术，不入内门，现为七星阁外门最强弟子。使一套雪羽清风扇，邪祟不可近，平日勤学苦练，于阁中卦术亦有所长。阁主知其常念旧国，每有所思悲从中来，久之，忧其白白浪费仙缘，遂常劝之，望其一心向道，早日脱离尘世之纷扰。

Tan Shuyan, the princess of Tan was exiled to the east continent after her country was destroyed and rescued by the Heptastar Pavilion. In order to inherit Tan's trick, she did not enter the inner sect; now she is the strongest disciple of the outer sect of Heptastar Pavilion. She uses a set of wind snow fans that keeps the evil spirit away and she usually studies hard and practices hard hence she is good at hexagrams in the pavilion. The master of the pavilion knew that she often missed the old country and every thought and sorrow came from it for a long time. He is worried that she wasted the immortal fate in vain, so he often persuaded her and hopes that she would devote herself to the Dao and escape from the turmoil of the world as soon as possible.
譚舒雁，西洲譚國公主，國滅，流亡於東洲，為七星閣所救。為承譚氏風術，不入內門，現為七星閣外門最強弟子。使一套雪羽清風扇，邪祟不可近，平日勤學苦練，於閣中卦術亦有所長。閣主知其常念舊國，每有所思悲從中來，久之，憂其白白浪費仙緣，遂常勸之，望其一心向道，早日脫離塵世之紛擾。

昔日西洲谭国，乃太山山麓小国，北临灵河而拒北洲，南远陵光而独立，西面太山之水过境，多分支，渐成泽，水草丛生，常年有大雁栖息，土地肥沃，五谷丰登，百姓勤勉，皆丰衣足食，与世无争。又传谭国常有朱雀过境，羽翼生风聚山谷，风和煦而有灵，谭氏随风而修，多有会法术者。
    经多年，北洲芦苇国初立北风军，人兽妖皆录为兵，其中魔修者亦不在少数，军心不稳，军队多自立，北洲内忧外患，纷乱不止。是时有凶兽穷奇，好邪僻，常唆使北风兵行恶。弈仙六壬寅年，穷奇率部渡河，于边境驻军欲攻谭国。谭氏求救于邻国，邻国主垂涎谭氏幺女舒雁已久，欲先立谭舒雁为妃而后发兵救援，谭氏不从，抵抗数月，双方拼得兵尽粮绝，宫宇崩倾，池田尽毁，谭主拼死而伤穷奇，穷奇遁走，谭国灭，民皆散于三洲。

In the past, Country Tan in the western continent was a small country at the foot of the Mountain Tai. It was adjacent to the Linghe river in the north and near the northern continent. The grain is plentiful, the people are diligent, they are well-fed and there is no competition with the world. It is also said that in the country of Tan, there are often Vermilion Bird passing through the border and the wings are blown and gathered in the valley. The wind is warm and spiritual, Tan's family can cultivate with wind, and most of Tan's family can use some immortals tricks.

After many years, the Country Luwei in the north continent first set up the north wind army, and all humans, beasts, and monsters were recruited as soldiers and there were not a few evil cultivators among them. The army is unstable and most of the troops were independent. At that time, there is a ferocious beast called Qiongqi, who likes to do evil things. Qiongqi openly instigates the soldiers of the north wind to do evil. YiXian calendar, six RenYin year, qiongqi led his troops across the river and stationed troops on the border to attack Tan. The Tan family asked for help from the neighboring country. But the neighboring country's lord coveted Tan's little daughter ShuYan for a long time. He wanted to make Tan Shuyan his concubine first and then send troops to rescue them. The Tan family refused and resisted for several months. In the end, the pond and fields were completely destroyed, the lord of Tan desperately injured Qiqiong and Qiqiong fled, Country Tan was destroyed, and the people were scattered over three continents.

昔日西洲譚國，乃太山山麓小國，北臨靈河而拒北洲，南遠陵光而獨立，西面太山之水過境，多分支，漸成澤，水草叢生，常年有大雁棲息，土地肥沃，五穀豐登，百姓勤勉，皆豐衣足食，與世無爭。又傳譚國常有朱雀過境，羽翼生風聚山谷，風和煦而有靈，譚氏隨風而修，多有會法術者。
    經多年，北洲蘆葦國初立北風軍，人獸妖皆錄為兵，其中魔修者亦不在少數，軍心不穩，軍隊多自立，北洲內憂外患，紛亂不止。是時有凶獸窮奇，好邪僻，常唆使北風兵行惡。弈仙六壬寅年，窮奇率部渡河，於邊境駐軍欲攻譚國。譚氏求救於鄰國，鄰國主垂涎譚氏么女舒雁已久，欲先立譚舒雁為妃而後發兵救援，譚氏不從，抵抗數月，雙方拼得兵盡糧絕，宮宇崩傾，池田盡毀，譚主拼死而傷窮奇，窮奇遁走，譚國滅，民皆散於三洲。

谭舒雁生时，啼哭不止，忽得春风动归雁鸣，而止啼转笑，父母奇之，遂名雁。谭舒雁幼时常与雁群为伴，每年将入冬时，秋风厉鸿雁征，谭舒雁不舍，冬日常拾雁羽而藏。谭舒雁豆蔻之年，偶拾得一朱雀赤羽，羽身金光火红，白日下，华彩夺目，似有灵气自其中涌出，无穷尽也。谭舒雁差工匠将赤羽与平日所藏雁羽合而为扇，唤作雪羽清风扇，舞扇而动，有清风绕身，妖邪不可近。
    谭国灭时，谭舒雁风术已有小成。父战穷奇而死后，谭舒雁率众杀将出去，附清风于鸿雁，乘雁而去。

When Tan Shuyan was born, she kept crying and never stop. As the spring wind breeze and the geese sang and then she stopped crying and turned to laughter. Her parents were amazed, so she was named Yan which means geese. Tan Shuyan was often accompanied by geese when she was young. Every year when winter comes, the autumn wind is fierce and geese march. Tan Shuyan cannot bear to leave the geese hence she always picks up the feather of the geese in the winter and collects them. In the year of Tan Shuyan's cardamom, she occasionally picked up a Vermilion Bird’ feather, the feathers were golden and fiery red, dazzling in daylight, and there seemed to be Qi gushing out of it, endless. Tan Shuyan sent craftsmen to combine the red feathers with the wild goose feathers that she usually collected into a fan and call it as wind-snow fans. When the fan dances, there is a breeze around the body and evil spirits cannot get close.

When Country Tan was destroyed, Tan Shuyan's wind skills had already achieved a small success. After Tan Shuyan's father died in battle with Qiongqi, Tan Shuyan led the remnant clan to break out of the siege, and rode away on the geese with the breeze.

譚舒雁生時，啼哭不止，忽得春風動歸雁鳴，而止啼轉笑，父母奇之，遂名雁。譚舒雁幼時常與雁群為伴，每年將入冬時，秋風厲鴻雁征，譚舒雁不舍，冬日常拾雁羽而藏。譚舒雁豆蔻之年，偶拾得一朱雀赤羽，羽身金光火紅，白日下，華彩奪目，似有靈氣自其中湧出，無窮奇也。譚舒雁差工匠將赤羽與平日所藏雁羽合而為扇，換作雪羽清風扇，舞扇而動，有清風繞身，妖邪不可近。
    譚國滅時，譚舒雁風術已有小成。父戰窮窮奇奇後，譚舒雁率眾殺將出去，附清風于鴻雁，乘雁而去。

国灭后，谭氏旧部迁至良州，或入洛商会，或进天工坊，谭氏习风术者多入术字门。谭舒雁一套羽扇功法出众，被七星阁所收，因其不忍弃家族所传法门，遂不入内门，仅在外门修炼。
    此后，谭舒雁勤学苦练，合谭氏风术于八卦，渐成最强外门弟子。然谭氏旧人多另成新家，谭母病故后，更是鲜有来往。彼时谭国公主，自幼锦衣玉食，天赋脱俗，骄傲明艳，如今身旁仅剩儿时一群鸿雁尔，谭舒雁每有所思，思必及旧国，往泪水洗面。七星阁主见此，为谭舒雁卜卦，算得地天为泰，知其仙缘甚远，遂望其一心向道，早日脱离尘世之纷扰。

After the country was destroyed, the old Tan family moved to LiangZhou, joined the Luo Chamber of Commerce, or participated in the Tiangong Workshop. Most of the Tan family's wind trick practitioners enter the art of calligraphy. Tan Shuyan's skill as a fan dancer was outstanding and was accepted by Heptastar Pavilion. She could not bear to abandon the dharma passed down by her family, so she did not enter the inner sect and only practiced in the outer sect.

Since then, Tan Shuyan has studied hard and practiced hard, combined with Tan's style of wind trick, and gradually became the strongest outer disciple. However, most of the old members of Tan's family formed a new family, and after Tan's mother died of illness, there was even less contact. At that time, Princes Tan who was born in fine clothing and fin food was gifted and refined, proud and glamorous,  now there is only a flock of wild geese around her which were met in her childhood. Seeing this, the master of the Heptastar Pavilion made a divination for her and calculated that the hexagram is Pervading which means smooth going and greatness, knowing that her immortal fate is long. So he hoped that Shuyan would devote herself to daoism and escape from the turmoil of the world as soon as possible.

國滅後，譚氏舊部遷至良州，或入洛商會，或進天工坊，譚氏習風術者多入術字門，譚舒雁一套羽扇功法出眾，被七星閣所收，因其不忍棄家族所傳法門，遂不入內門，僅在外門修煉。
    此後，譚舒雁勤學苦練，合譚氏風術於八卦，漸成最強外門弟子。然譚氏舊人多另成新家，譚母病故後，更是鮮有來往。彼時譚國公主，自幼錦衣玉食，天賦脫俗，驕傲明豔，如今身旁僅剩兒時一群鴻雁爾，譚舒雁每有所思，思必及舊國，往淚水洗面。七星閣主見此，為譚舒雁卜卦，算得地天為泰，知其仙緣甚遠，遂望其一心向道，早日脫離塵世之紛擾。

炎尘，炎雪之弟，身怀魔血却三魂七魄皆健全，为族中异类。幼年便发丝赤红，性格如火，同辈皆远之。在族内与炎雪较亲，常与其共舞。后拜入七星阁，得阁主指点，以五行树之芽引血，戾气略消，合阁中筮法，又得燃血引雷之术。曾访良州遇奇石，雷法击之成无极卦盘，有逆天改命威能。

Yan Chen, Yan Xue's younger brother, who possesses demonic blood but has both the Three Souls and Seven Spirits, is a different kind in the clan. His hair was red when he was young, his personality was fiery, and he was far away from his peers. he is close to Yan Xue in the clan and often dances with her. Later, he entered the Heptastar Pavilion and was instructed by the pavilion master to draw blood with the buds of the five-element tree, and the hostility was slightly eliminated. Combined with the divination method in the pavilion, he also got the art of burning blood to attract thunder. He once visited Liangzhou and found a strange stone, which was struck by lightning to form an Ultimate Hexagram Base, which has the power to change fate against the fate.
炎塵，炎雪之弟，身懷魔血卻三魂七魄皆健全，為族中異類。幼年便髮絲赤紅，性格如火，同輩皆遠之。在族內與炎雪較親，常與其共舞。後拜入七星閣，得閣主指點，以五行樹之芽引血，戾氣略消，合閣中筮法，又得燃血引雷之術。曾訪良州遇奇石，雷法擊之成無極卦盤，有逆天改命威能。

大衍国炎氏，乃上古之名门望族。彼时，大衍北纷争不断，东北蚩尤氏为魔族朱厌部落所惑，遂起兵事。炎氏战朱厌于东海滨，过九天，亡者众，双方皆力疲，后炎氏伤朱厌，浴其血而舞，其势惊天骇地，引得金乌自西方飞来，分魂而助炎氏，朱厌遂斩。又退蚩尤氏至北洲，蚩尤臣服，余部皆归大衍。战后，炎氏立于大衍北境，奉金乌为尊。因战时浴朱厌血，而魂魄受损，炎氏后代多有魂魄残缺者，需引金乌分魂方得幸存。
    炎尘于炎氏氏族，实属异类之存在，身怀魔血而三魂七魄皆健全，幼年发丝便赤红，性烈如火，稍有不如意则必耍脾气，于同辈拳脚相加，于长辈则戟指怒目出言不逊，族长恐其入魔，寻名医诊之，非但无入魔迹象，身体更是强于常人，族人遂心安。平日里炎尘只觉族里同辈甚是无趣，不愿与之来往，却喜观炎雪巫舞，观之内心平静怒气尽消，遂常坐宗祠观舞，不时与炎雪同起舞，族人见之皆奇，同是孤僻人，却以舞共鸣。
    至炎尘幼学之年，炎雪求剑云灵剑宗，炎尘更厌炎氏宗门，后辞家人而远行，拜入七星阁。

The Yan family of the Dayan Kingdom was a famous family in ancient times. At that time, there was a lot of war in the north of the Dayan Kingdom and the Chiyou clan in the northeast was bewitched by the Zhuyan tribe of evil, so they started the war. Yan's family fought against Zhuyan at the east sea. After nine days, there were many dead and both sides were exhausted. And then Yan's family hurt Zhuyan, dances in their blood, and their momentum is terrifying attracting the golden crow from the west. The golden crow split its soul to help the Yan family and the Zhuyan was killed by the Yan family. Hit back the Chiyou clan to the north and surrender, the rest tribe all belong to the Dayan kingdom. After the war, Yan's family stands in the north of Dayan, serving in golden crow. Because during the battle they were covered with Zhuyan's blood so their soul was damaged. There is a lot of Yan's posterity that is soul damaged and needs the golden crow's split soul to survive.

Chan Yan belongs to the Yan Clan. He is a different kind of existence. He possesses the blood of the devil, and his three souls and seven spirits are healthy. His hair is red when he was young, and his temper is as fierce as fire. If he feels unsatisfactory, he will be angry. For the same generation, he will fight with a fist; for elders, he uses finger points and glares at them with insulting words. The patriarch feared that he might be possessed by a demon, so he sought out a famous doctor to diagnose him. Not only is there no sign of being possessed by demons, but his body is stronger than ordinary people, and the people in the clan feel at ease. Normally, Yan Chen only feels that his peers in the clan are very boring, and he doesn't want to associate with them. But he likes to watch Yan Xue do witch dance which will make he calms down, so he often sits in the ancestral hall to watch the dance, and dances with Yan Xue from time to time, the clansmen think it is strange to see it, because both of them are lonely people, but they resonate with each other through dance.

When Yan Chen was 11 years old, Yan Xue join the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect, and Yan Chen hated Yan's clan even more. Later, Yan Chen said farewell to his family and traveled far away , till he join the Heptastar Pavilion.

大衍國炎氏，乃上古之名門望族。彼時，大衍北紛爭不斷，東北蚩尤氏為魔族朱厭部落所惑，遂起兵事。炎氏戰朱厭于東海濱，過九天，亡者眾，雙方皆力疲，後炎氏傷朱厭，浴其血而舞，其勢驚天駭地，引得金烏自西方飛來，分魂而助炎氏，朱厭遂斬。又退蚩尤氏至北洲，蚩尤臣服，餘部皆歸大衍。戰後，炎氏立於大衍北境，奉金烏為尊。因戰時浴朱厭血，而魂魄受損，炎氏後代多有魂魄殘缺者，需引金烏分魂方得倖存。

    至炎塵幼學之年，炎雪求劍雲靈劍宗，炎塵更厭炎氏宗門，後辭家人而遠行，拜入七星閣。

传万物之初，鸿蒙未开，万物皆为混沌，混沌者无极也。
    弈仙六辛亥年，有飞石自无极中来，落于东洲，为天工坊所收，铁锤击之有碎石出，却不见飞石外形有变，连击七日，飞石大小不变，知其绝非凡物。恰逢炎尘于良州市集闲逛，听得飞石传闻，至天工坊，衍飞石知其中命局无穷尽，欲带回取之，又衍，为大凶之兆，只得作罢，怒从中来将要发作，却见周边碎石似有灵气暗藏其中，细观之，碎石间嵌有玄金，遂驱动血脉，足踏震位化雷劈之，飞石炸裂，玄金尽出。炎尘收玄金，随手抛下一袋灵石便走，只剩天工坊众人呆于原地良久不敢动弹。
    炎尘收玄金后，访陆氏，置玄金于炉炼为玄铁，又灌雷击之，数日，卦盘方成。此盘随炎尘运行灵气而悬，定中宫而生卦，卦象从中来，不可断绝，催之有逆天改命威能。

傳萬物之初，鴻蒙未開，萬物皆為混沌，混沌者無極也。
    弈仙六辛亥年，有飛石自無極中來，落於東洲，為天工坊所收，鐵錘擊之有碎石出，卻不見飛石外形有變，連擊七日，飛石大小不變，知其絕非凡物。恰逢炎塵於良州市集閒逛，聽得飛石傳聞，至天工坊，衍飛石知其中命局無窮盡，欲帶回取之，又衍，為大凶之兆，只得作罷，怒從中來將要發作，卻見周邊碎石似有靈氣暗藏其中，細觀之，碎石間嵌有玄金，遂驅動血脈，足踏震位化雷劈之，飛石炸裂，玄金盡出。炎塵收玄金，隨手拋下一袋靈石便走，只剩天工坊眾人呆於原地良久不敢動彈。

曜灵，鼠妖。生于幽暗却心向光辉，受寰宇之曜而生灵，修苍生之道而化妖。
    初行遍三洲望入仙门，未果。一日访七星阁，阁主承有教无类仙训，收入门下。平日里喜囤物，灵石仙草所藏者众，阁众见其每日常持物而食，却不知其所食何物。又擅为商，随群阁起落，做些商旅营生，有传其恐为三洲最富修士。

Yao Ling, a hamster demon, was born in the dark but has a heart for the brilliance. She receives the light of the universe to obtain Qi, and cultivates the way of life to transform into a demon.

Yao Ling traveled all over the three continents to enter the immortal gate, but failed. 曜靈，鼠妖。生於幽暗卻心向光輝，受寰宇之曜而生靈，修蒼生之道而化妖。
    初行遍三洲望入仙門，未果。一日訪七星閣，閣主承有教無類仙訓，收入門下。 平日裏喜囤物，靈石仙草所藏者眾，閣眾見其每日常持物而食，卻不知其所食何物。 又擅為商，隨群閣起落，做些商旅營生，有傳其恐為三洲最富修士。
    於修行之道，曜靈所思异於常人，自研一套逆行八卦法門，傳言其逆行八卦之間，竟能跳出三界。 須臾間至未知之境，竊得一盞絳紗燈，旋燈而衍，無往不利。 又傳其所至之境，所遇之人皆服裝怪異，常手持盒而觀，盒間有光，似又有萬千世界……

鼠族遍三洲，其中能感灵气者寡。曜灵实乃族中异类，生于北洲至北蛮荒之地，出生即不惧光辉，常受日月星辰之曜，渐生灵力，百年化形。至西洲，游走于城邦之间，学起百姓言行，又百年，渐生灵智。至东洲市集，初始捡些凡人所弃之物为食，尚有余者，竟学起商贾，择其良品，摆摊而贩。又百年，财有所积，渐做起修士买卖，所贩之物灵草法器俱全。
    曜灵自食丹药，灵气渐长，却因修不得法，修为不得再进。遂访三洲仙门而求修行法门，初始者皆因其仓鼠成妖，不愿收之。后至七星阁，阁主承有教无类仙训，收入门下。曜灵得八卦之术，修行方得正道，又因其以曜开心智，天生有侵日月玄机之能，此后修行之路畅通无阻。

Rat tribes spread all over the three continents, but few can sense Qi. The Yao Ling is actually a different kind in the tribe. 鼠族遍三洲，其中能感靈氣者寡。曜靈實乃族中異類，生於北洲至北蠻荒之地，出生即不懼光輝，常受日月星辰之曜，漸生靈力，百年化形。至西洲，游走於城邦之間，學起百姓言行，又百年，漸生靈智。至東洲市集，初始撿些凡人所棄之物為食，尚有餘者，竟學起商賈，擇其良品，擺攤而販。又百年，財有所積，漸做起修士買賣，所販之物靈草法器俱全。
    曜靈自食丹藥，靈氣漸長，卻因修不得法，修為不得再進。遂訪三洲仙門而求修行法門，初始者皆因其倉鼠成妖，不願收之。後至七星閣，閣主承有教無類仙訓，收入門下。曜靈得八卦之術，修行方得正道，又因其以曜開心智，天生有侵日月玄機之能，此後修行之路暢通無阻。

寻常七星阁弟子，于八卦之道常顺运之，曜灵则逆行之。同辈弟子恐其常此有损修行，每相劝，曜灵皆不以为意。曰，修行本非常之道，夺天地之造化，侵日月之玄机，择适者尔。

曜灵之财，穷极而至。昔日于良州市集初始摆摊之时，曜灵所贩之物，仅酒家所弃果蔬，水中所采芦蒿，山间所掘鲜笋，田间所捉促织。初时，无人光顾，仅有零星老者见其外形年幼，甚怜之，每日帮衬买些商品。过数月，曜灵所积之财散于乡里，收些手工织物，运来城中贩卖，客渐多。过数年，所积渐多，始囤百货，无所不易。

    洛商会闻曜灵发迹，遣员访之，求其经商之道。曰，曜灵亦不识经商之道，只是看人类相处久了能发现，天地万物都可以交易，但感情不行。

Yao Ling's wealth comes from extreme poverty. In the past when the stalls were first set up in the Liangzhou market, Yao Ling sold only fruits and vegetables discarded by restaurants, artemisias picked in the water, and fresh bamboo dug in the mountains and caught in the fields for weaving. In the beginning, no one patronized her store, only a few elderly people saw she was young in appearance, felt sorry about her fate, and helped to buy some commodities every day. After a few months, the wealth accumulated by Yao Ling was scattered in the village, and buy some handmade fabrics. She transported them to the city to sell, and the number of customers gradually increased. After a few years, she accumulated more and more, and she began to stock up on daily-use items and sold everything.
One day, Yao Ling saw a pocket at a pawn shop in the city. It was small and exquisite. She thought it could hold some snacks and carried it with her usually. The shopkeeper saw that it was just an ordinary cloth pocket and give it to her without collecting money, only saying that more business need to be done in the future. Yao Ling got the pocket and filled it with a lot of food, but there was no sign that the pocket was full. Put some more fruits and vegetables, there is still a lot of space in the pocket, Yao Ling was shocked, and then put tables, stools, screens, and vats, all of which were put into the bag leisurely without feeling the weight. It turns out that this object is a Qiankun pocket made by Tianji Valley, it seems to be from the hands of trainee disciples, it is low-grade. However, it was like a god's help when she was doing business, and she began to realize the wonder of the practitioner. Then spend a lot of money to buy spiritual stones, immortal herbs, and artifacts, and the guests will have cultivators. Yao Ling often gives discounts to cultivators, so she makes many friends.
When the Luo Chamber of Commerce heard that Yao Ling had made a fortune, it sent staff to visit her, seeking her way of doing business. Which said, Yao Ling also doesn't know how to do business, but after watching human beings get along for a long time, she can find that everything in the world can be traded, but the interpersonal relationship can't.

曜靈之財，窮極而至。昔日於良州市集初始擺攤之時，曜靈所販之物，僅酒家所棄果蔬，水中所采蘆蒿，山間所掘鮮筍，田間所捉促織。初時，無人光顧，僅有零星老者見其外形年幼，甚憐之，每日幫襯買些商品。過數月，曜靈所積之財散於鄉里，收些手工織物，運來城中販賣，客漸多。過數年，所積漸多，始囤百貨，無所不易。
    一日，曜靈於城中當鋪見一口袋，小巧精緻，想來可裝些小食，平日隨身攜帶，掌櫃見其僅乃一尋常布口袋，卻也沒收錢，只道今後生意還須多加往來。曜靈得口袋，盛上好些吃食，卻不見口袋有盛滿之象。又裝些瓜果蔬菜，任有餘，曜靈大驚，又放桌凳屏缸，皆悠然入袋而不感其重。原此物乃天機穀所造乾坤口袋，似出自見習弟子之手，為下品。然曜靈使來，行商時有如神助，始覺修者奇妙之處。而後多花重金，購靈石仙草法器，客者始有修士。曜靈常予修士優惠，遂廣結道友。
    洛商會聞曜靈發跡，遣員訪之，求其經商之道。曰，曜靈亦不識經商之道，只是看人類相處久了能發現，天地萬物都可以交易，但感情不行。

姜氏乃三洲名门，氏族多出修士，入七星阁者多。姜袭明自幼入七星阁，承父之法，又得阁主亲传，修行远超同辈。传闻出生时有白鹿相伴，受白鹿灵气，发丝渐白。于星辰之力有先天感应，修行数年渐展星辰之力，为七星阁屡立奇功，升占星使，手执七星尺为群阁引航。现常管阁中大小事务，每夜观星而衍，运筹帷幄之中。

The Jiang family is a well-known family on the three continents. There are many cultivators in the clan, and many people enter the Heptastar Pavilion. Jiang Ximing entered the Heptastar Pavilion when he was a child, inherited his father's arts, and was taught by the pavilion master himself, and his practice far surpassed his peers. It is hearsay that when he was born, he was accompanied by a white deer, and his hair gradually turned white due to the Qi of the white deer. He has an innate sense of the power of the stars. After several years of practice, he has gradually developed the ability of the stars. He has repeatedly made extraordinary achievements for the Heptastar Pavilion. He often manages the big and small things in the pavilion, watches the stars every night, and plans strategies.
姜氏乃三洲名門，氏族多出修士，入七星閣者多。姜襲明自幼入七星閣，承父之法，又得閣主親傳，修行遠超同輩。傳聞出生時有白鹿相伴，受白鹿靈氣，髮絲漸白。於星辰之力有先天感應，修行數年漸展星辰之力，為七星閣屢立奇功，升占星使，手執七星尺為群閣引航。現常管閣中大小事務，每夜觀星而衍，運籌帷幄之中。

姜谨，初代七星阁主姜尚之后，承祖之业，得流枢阁与万符宗相助，以灵石为源，神木为轴，画万符引星辰之力，驱群阁凌长空，传八卦于三洲。又著字辈，曰：谨厚为丰，重仁袭义，望后世子孙纵得八卦之术，任修身为重，心存正道，助苍生避祸趋福。遂姜氏后代入七星阁者多，为官大衍国者亦不在少。
    姜袭明之父姜仁惟，乃七星阁当世杰出弟子，得姜谨亲传，位居占星使。弈仙五癸亥年，姜仁惟奉命查暗谷炼化邪祟一事，不幸为邪祟偷袭所伤，遁至巫格山为蓝瑜心所救，而后二人互生情愫，二人不贪权贵，琴瑟和鸣，入深林隐居数年，生姜袭明。传是夜星辰闪耀，有白鹿至林深处来，于茅屋前低鸣久不愿去，后伴姜袭明成长至今。遂姜袭明年少受白鹿灵气，发丝渐白，灵力醇远，又有父授于七星法门，修行远超同辈。
    入七星阁后，姜袭明星辰之力渐展，屡立奇功，遂子承父业，升占星使，众人见其常骑白鹿而行，称其星河鹿使。

Jiang Jin, the descendant of Jiang Shang who is the first master of Heptastar Pavilion, inherited his ancestor's career and got the help of the Liushu Pavilion and the Ten Thousand Runes Sect. Using the spirit stone as the source and the sacred tree as the axis, he drew ten thousand runes to draw the stars' power and drove the pavilions into the sky. Spread Trigrams on three continents. And he uses eight words to make eight seniorities in the family which are: Jin Hou Wei Feng, Zhong Ren Xi Yi.  He hopes that future generations even if they have learned Trigrams but self-cultivation is always the most important thing and be righteous and help mortal people avoid disasters and seek blessings. Therefore, many descendants of the Jiang family entered the Heptastar Pavilion, many of whom were officials of the Dayan kingdom.

Jiang Ximing's father, Jiang Renwei, was an outstanding disciple of the Heptastar Pavilion, Jiang Jin personally taught him, and he was the astrologer. In the five GuiHai years of the Yi Xian calendar, Jiang Renwei was ordered to investigate the matter of Angu refining and transforming evil spirits. Unfortunately, he was injured by an attack by evil spirits. He fled to Wuge Mountain and was rescued by Lan Yuxin.  Afterward, the two falls in love with each other and they are not greedy for power and wealth, play the zither with each other. Finally, they go into the deep forest to live in seclusion for several years and born Jiang Ximing. It is said that the stars are shining at night, and a white deer came to the depths of the forest. It hummed in front of the hut for a long time and refused to go. After growing up with Jiang Ximing, Jiang Ximing was affected by the Qi of the white deer, and his hair gradually turned white and his Qi is pure and long. His father taught him the Heptastar arts, and his practice is far superior to his peers.

After entering the Heptastar Pavilion, Jiang Ximing's power gradually developed, and he made outstanding achievements repeatedly. Then the son inherited his father's career and was promoted to astrologer. When people saw him often riding a white deer, they called him the Star River Deer Envoy.

姜謹，初代七星閣主姜尚之後，承祖之業，得流樞閣與萬符宗相助，以靈石為源，神木為軸，畫萬符引星辰之力，驅群閣淩長空，傳八卦於三洲。又著字輩，曰：謹厚為豐，重仁襲義，望後世子孫縱得八卦之術，任修身為重，心存正道，助蒼生避禍趨福。遂姜氏後代入七星閣者多，為官大衍國者亦不在少。
    姜襲明之父姜仁惟，乃七星閣當世傑出弟子，得姜謹親傳，位居占星使。弈仙五癸亥年，姜仁惟奉命查暗穀煉化邪祟一事，不幸為邪祟偷襲所傷，遁至巫格山為藍瑜心所救，而後二人互生情愫，二人不貪權貴，琴瑟和鳴，入深林隱居數年，生姜襲明。傳是夜星辰閃耀，有白鹿至林深處來，於茅屋前低鳴久不願去，後伴姜襲明成長至今，遂姜襲明年少受白鹿靈氣，髮絲漸白，靈力醇遠，又有父授于七星法門，修行遠超同輩。
    入七星閣後，姜襲明星辰之力漸展，屢立奇功，遂子承父業，升占星使，眾人見其常騎白鹿而行，稱其星河鹿使。

经曰：北斗者，天地之大德大化，真为正道结为玄象，运乎中天，建四时，均五行，生杀万物，统治天地，察录善恶，无一物不系其所管也。
    七星阁量天之尺，取五行树树根，浸太山源头之水百年而不烂，烧之成碳，混灵石埋于土中又百年，化为金，承三洲万物相生法则是以为坤。又取陨星七颗，悬于七星阁，任凭风吹雨淋，待百年自然成玉，聚苍穹之炁是以为乾。遂以尺长凭乾坤之力能容北斗，在璇玑玉衡，以齐七政，测北斗而衍三洲大势。执尺登高而测星辰者，炁之流转尽在手中，近可控群阁，远可牵星辰。
    阁主以姜袭明亲星辰之力又年少而行事沉稳，授其七星尺，自此七星阁于三洲之动向，尽在姜袭明之手。

The scriptures say: The Big Dipper, the great virtues of the heaven and the earth, the true righteousness and the formation of the mysterious image, transported to the mid-heaven, established four seasons, equalized the five elements, lived and killed all things, ruled the heaven and the earth, checked and recorded good and evil, and nothing is inseparable. It is in charge of everything.

The artifact in the Heptastar Pavilion which shaped like a ruler so-called Heptaster Ruler. It can be used in divination or observing the stars. It takes the root of the five-element tree, soaks in the water from the source of Mount Tai for a hundred years, and burns it into carbon, and the mixed spirit stone is buried in the soil for a hundred years and turns into gold it inheriting the law of mutual generation of all thing in the three continents and it is to think that as Kun. And then take seven meteorites, hang them in the Heptastar Pavilion, use the wind and rain to drench them, and wait for a hundred years to become jade naturally, gathering the Qi of the sky and it is to think as Qian. Hence the ruler has the power of Qian-Kun which means the sky and the earth. Qi measures The Big Dipper and develops the general trend of the three continents. Those who hold a ruler to climb high and measure the stars have all the flow of Qi in their hands. They can control the pavilions near them and hold the stars far away.

The master of the pavilion thinks Jiang Ximing is good at the power of the stars young and steady and gave him the Heptastar Ruler. Since then, the movement of the Heptastar Pavilion on three continents has been controlled by Jiang Ximing.

經曰：北斗者，天地之大德大化，真為正道結為玄象，運乎中天，建四時，均五行，生殺萬物，統治天地，察錄善惡，無一物不系其所管也。
    七星閣量天之尺，取五行樹樹根，浸太山源頭之水百年而不爛，燒之成碳，混靈石埋於土中又百年，化為金，承三洲萬物相生法則是以為坤，又取隕星七顆，懸於七星閣，任憑風吹雨淋，待百年自然成玉，聚蒼穹之炁是以為乾，遂以尺長憑乾坤之力能容北斗，在璿璣玉衡，以齊七政，測北斗而衍三洲大勢。執尺登高而測星辰者，炁之流轉盡在手中，近可控群閣，遠可牽星辰。
    閣主以姜襲明親星辰之力又年少而行事沉穩，授其七星尺，自此七星閣於三洲之動向，盡在姜襲明之手。

经曰：是以圣人常善救人，故无弃人；常善救物，故无弃物。是谓袭明。
    姜袭明出生之时，父母便寄以宏愿，望其成圣，姜袭明龆年，二老将其托入七星阁中，后多年隐居不复出。姜袭明于家人聚少，平日多由阁中长老照顾，比之父母，姜袭明身旁白鹿却是寸步不离，胜似亲人。
    七星阁中生活修行繁重且无甚趣味，众长老皆鼓励弟子课余时多下阁历练，实践占卜之术，增长见闻，多行善举。七星群阁无定所，凡炁之所引，三洲境内无不可达处。数年间，姜袭明随阁而游历三洲，世人见其骑白鹿皆奇之，每有上前攀谈者，姜袭明皆问无不答言无不尽。遇凡人时，答疑解惑占卜吉凶，遇修士时，心法丹药有求必应，心甚诚。常此，相识者众，皆凭姜袭明之名与七星阁互通有无，遂年少即名望颇高。
    姜袭明至而立之年，升占星使，渐少下七星阁。平日里于内，录宗门大小事务，夜观星象，宗门迁移，开航启程，执七星尺而令。外出则多忙于宗门事务，每领弟子秘境历练，凡市贸易，仙门交流，发兵制魔，皆驾白鹿而行，事毕则速归，终不似少年时游历心境。弟子见姜袭明常待阁内，却将上下里外打理得有条不紊，皆称星河鹿使乃运筹于帷幄之中，决胜于千里之外之谋士也，然反观姜袭明，身居要职，身边得抒心肠者仅白鹿矣，是故求道者寡，圣人之路皆寂寥。

The scriptures say: Likewise, the Holy One is good at saving people, And no one is abandoned. He is good at saving all things, And nothing is abandoned. This is called following the light. 
When Jiang Ximing was born, his parents made great wishes for him to become a saint. When he was a child, the two elders entrusted him to the Heptastar Pavilion, and lived in seclusion for many years. Jiang Ximing rarely gets together with his family and is usually taken care of by the elders in the pavilion. Compared with his parents, Jiang Ximing's white deer beside him is close at every step, which is better than his relatives.

Life and practice in the Heptastar Pavilion are heavy and not very interesting. All the elders encourage the disciples to experience in the world to practice more in their spare time, to practice divination, to increase their knowledge, and to do more good deeds. There is no definite location for the Heptastar group pavilions, and where the Qi is drawn, the pavilion can move across the three continents easily. For several years, Jiang Ximing traveled to three continents with the pavilions, and the world was amazed to see him riding a white deer. Every time someone came up to ask things, Jiang Ximing would answer all kinds of questions.  When meeting mortals, he would answer questions and solve doubts about the ominous or auspicious of divination. When he meet a cultivator, he responded to every request from medicine to dharma, and his heart was very sincere. He was always like this, and many acquaintances all communicated with Heptastar Pavilion in the name of Jiang Ximing, so he was very famous at a young age.

In the year of Jiang Ximing's thirties, he was promoted to be an astrologer, but he was less and less likely to experience in the world. Usually, when he stays in the Pavilion, he records the big and small affairs of the Pavilion, watches the stars move at night, moves the position of the Pavilion, set sail, holds the Heptastar Ruler, and gives orders to everyone. And when he goes out, he is busier with the affairs of the Pavilion. Sending disciples to the uncharted realm, marketing in mortal's market, communicating with other sects or sending disciples to fight with the devils, he all rides on a white deer and returns quickly when he is done, it is not like wandering in the state of mind when he were young. The disciples saw that Jiang Ximing often stayed in the pavilion, but managed everything in an orderly manner. They all said that the Star River Deer Envoy was a strategist who planned a strategy and won a decisive victory thousands of miles away. However, Jiang Ximing held an important position, there are only white deer around who can express their hearts, so the seekers are few, and the road of saints is lonely.

經曰：是以聖人常善救人，故無棄人；常善救物，故無棄物。是謂襲明。
    姜襲明出生之時，父母便寄以宏願，望其成聖，姜襲明齠年，二老將其托入七星閣中，後多年隱居不復出。姜襲明于家人聚少，平日多由閣中長老照顧，比之父母，姜襲明身旁白鹿卻是寸步不離，勝似親人。
    七星閣中生活修行繁重且無甚趣味，眾長老皆鼓勵弟子課餘時多下閣歷練，實踐占卜之術，增長見聞，多行善舉。七星群閣無定所，凡炁之所引，三洲境內無不可達處。數年間，姜襲明隨閣而遊歷三洲，世人見其騎白鹿皆奇之，每有上前攀談者，姜襲明皆問無不答言無不盡，遇凡人時，答疑解惑占卜吉凶，遇修士時，心法丹藥有求必應，心甚誠，常此，相識者眾，皆憑姜襲明之名與七星閣互通有無，遂年少即名望頗高。
    姜襲明至而立之年，升占星使，漸少下七星閣。平日裡于內，錄宗門大小事務，夜觀星象，宗門遷移，開航啟程，執七星尺而令，外出則多忙於宗門事務，每領弟子秘境歷練，凡市貿易，仙門交流，發兵制魔，皆駕白鹿而行，事畢則速歸，終不似少年時遊歷心境。弟子見姜襲明常待閣內，卻將上下裡外打理得有條不紊，皆稱星河鹿使乃運籌於帷幄之中，決勝於千里之外之謀士也，然反觀姜襲明，身居要職，身邊得抒心腸者僅白鹿矣，是故求道者寡，聖人之路皆寂寥。

关于谭舒雁：昔日谭国气数已尽了，但看谭师妹似乎还耿耿于怀，不肯入内门。凭她这身本事，别说是外门了，就是放眼整个三洲，也是其中翘楚。还望谭师妹能早日看透，入内门，同为宗门尽心力。

关于炎尘：东洲炎氏，无论在凡人间或是仙门之中，都颇具名望。与炎氏交好，于七星阁有利无害。只是这炎尘师弟……生性张狂，同族人关系似乎亦不甚好。入七星阁后虽性情平和了些，但……还是过些时日再同他议论此事吧。

关于曜灵：近来观星辰，衍得西洲妖族似有异动，吉凶未明。此时报于阁主为时尚早，反扰其清修。曜灵师妹和妖族关系近些，要不先请她帮着查查。顺便还能寻些妖族中能人异士，邀为同道，为七星阁所用。

关于吴策：策儿于星辰之力的掌握虽为我所点化，但是今日有此成就，全凭自身造化。七星阁有策儿相助，让人颇为安心。

关于吾行之：三洲各大门派，同辈弟子中颇具名望者……五行道盟吾道友，平日对宗门似乎不太关心。要知其动向还须费神演算。阁中可备些好酒，如哪天拜阁，可以好好招待一番。

关于牧逸风：云灵剑宗牧道友……据传平日多在宗门内修行，似乎喜欢喝茶……改天备些好茶，去拜访一下牧道友。宗门之间还须互通有无，共助正道。

关于叶冥冥：和锻玄宗的交流隔着一位叶道友，实在…难以做出万全判断。尝试卜了一卦，金钱竟立了起来。

About Tan Shuyan: In the past, Tan's fate was exhausted, but she still seemed to be brooding and refused to enter the inner sect. With her ability, she has already better than the most cultivator in the outer sect, even if she looks at the whole three continents, she is also the best among them. I hope that Junior apprentice Tan can see through it as soon as possible, enter the inner sect, and work hard for the sect.

About Yan Chen: The Yan clan is quite famous no matter in the mortal world or among the immortals. It is beneficial and harmless to Heptastar Pavilion to make friends with the Yan family. It's just that this junior apprentice Yan Chen... is arrogant by nature, and the relationship with his clan seems not to be very good. Although his temperament became calmer after entering the Heptastar Pavilion... let's discuss this matter with him after a while.

About Yao Ling: Looking at the stars recently, it seems that the demon clan in the west continent has changed, and it is not clear whether it is good or bad. At this time, it is too early to report to the pavilion master, so as not to disturb his practice. Junior apprentice Yao Ling has a closer relationship with the demons, why don't I ask her to help me find out first? By the way, we can also find some capable people from the monster clan, invite them to be fellows, and help Heptastar Pavilion.

About Wu Ce: Although Ce's mastery of the star power was taught by me, but today's achievement is all due to Ce's own creation. I feel relieved that we has Ce's assistance.

About Wu Xingzhi: The various sects of the three continents, the most famous among the disciples of the same generation... Wu Xingzhi of the Five Elements Alliance doesn't seem to care much about the sect usually. It takes a lot of calculations to know his movements. We can prepare some good wine in the pavilion. If he visits the pavilion one day, we can treat him well.

About Mu Yifeng: Fellow daoist Mu of the Cloud Spirit Sword Sect... It is said that he usually practices in the sect, and seems to like drinking tea... Prepare some good tea another day, and go to visit Fellow daoist Mu. The sects also need to communicate with each other to help the righteous way.

About Ye Mingming: The communication with the Duan Xuan Sect is separated by a fellow Daoist Ye, it is really...difficult to make a foolproof judgment. When I tried to divine, the money even stood up.
