吴策，北风军右将军吴恒之后，少时得姜袭明所赠星月折扇，善观星，长于谋。
    曾任吴恒军军师，屡立战功，后因吴恒军功高盖主，为奸人所妒，遭其陷害，不知所踪。有传为魔物所害，又有传已入七星阁，常于北洲东海滨见其身影。

Wu Ce, the child of Wu Heng. Wu Heng, the right general of the North Wind Army. When Wu Ce was young, Jiang Ximing gave Wu Ce a Star Moon Folding Fan, and also taught Wu Ce the cycle of Qi. Later, Wu Ce grew up to be good at stargazing and scheming.

Wu Ce once was the military advisor of Wu Heng Army and achieved many successes in battle. However, Wu Ce was jealous by the superior because of Wu Heng Army's high achievements, and Wu Ce was set up by the superior and disappeared. There is a rumor that Wu Ce was killed by devils, and there is also a rumor that Wu Ce has entered the Seven Stars Pavilion, and often be seen in the East Coast of North Continent.

吳策，北風軍右將軍吳恒之後，少時得薑襲明所贈星月摺扇，善觀星，長於謀。
    曾任吳恒軍軍師，屢立戰功，後因吳恒軍功高蓋主，為奸人所妒，遭其陷害，不知所踪。 有傳為魔物所害，又有傳已入七星閣，常於北洲東海濱見其身影。

北洲东接沧海，北风军近岸设填海营，四方乡里得填海营之庇护，多以渔为业。白昼常有舰队近岸戒巡。千帆影动，万里云分，风萧萧兮飞雪，水澹澹兮鸣湍。每入夜，下卧渔火灿烂，上斜北斗阑干，近闻炊烟聚落，远观星汉就列。
    吴策之父，吴恒，时任北风军偏将军，善海战，有私部曲百人。弈仙六己亥年，姜袭明同吴恒军于东海滨诛邪，见年幼吴策常卧于楼船爵室之顶，仰而观星辰。袭明奇之，问其星象，皆对答如流。袭明掐指一算，微颔首，赠折扇一柄，又传心法数十句，孩童听罢复述，竟一字不差。后姜袭明辞行，临行前，言此孩童颇具仙缘，常带左右可保平安。
    沧海入夜后，偶有瘴气笼罩，瘴气浓时，如灰纱障目，舟入深海为魔气所侵，鲜有生还者。吴策常随父夜间行船，手执折扇而领航。合扇聚炁于丹田，行炁时可感星月之力。开扇散炁于身侧，挥扇间可窥天地生机。扇舞之处，明月星辰光辉闪耀，瘴气尽散。众舰从吴策而行，未尝失航也。

The eastern part of the North Continent is connected to the Sea, and the North Wind Army has set up the Sea Filling Camp near the coast, under the shelter of the Sea Filling Camp, the nearby villages are mostly engaged in fishing. During the daytime, there is often a fleet of ships patrolling near the shore. Thousands of sails move, ten thousand miles of clouds are divided, the wind is sluggish and snowy, and the water is tantalizing and turbulent. Every night, the fishing fires are brilliant, the Big Dipper appendages are slanted upward, the cooking smoke is gathered near, and the stars are listed in the distance.

Wu Ce's father, Wu Heng, was the deputy general of the North Wind Army at that time, good at sea warfare, and had a private army of one hundred men. YiXian calendar, six JiHai year, Jiang Ximing helped Wu Heng's army to exterminate the evil in the eastern seashore, and saw the young Wu Ce often lying on the top of the room of the houseboat, looking up and watching the stars. Jiang was curious, so he went up to test Wu Ce's astrological knowledge and found that Wu Ce answered all the questions correctly. Later, Jiang Ximing calculated Wu Ce's fate, nodded his head to express his approval, and then gave Wu Ce a folding fan and taught Wu Ce dozens of phrases of the Qi circulation, and Wu Ce listened and repeated them without missing a word. Later, before Jiang Ximing left, he told Wu Heng that this child had a immortal's fate, so he could always bring the child around to keep him safe.

After nightfall, the sea is occasionally covered with miasma. Whenever the miasma is thick, it is like a gray veil to block the eyes. If a ship sails into the deep sea at this time, it will be invaded by the demonic Qi and few people will survive. Wu Ce often accompanies father to sail at night, holding a folding fan and navigating. When Wu Ce closes the fan, Qi can be gathered in the dantian, and the power of the stars and the moon can be felt when the Qi flows. When Wu Ce opens the fan, the Qi is dispersed on the side of Wu Ce, and when Wu Ce swings the fan, vitality of heaven and earth can be seen. With Wu Ce's fan dance, the moon and stars shone brightly, and the miasma was dispersed. All the ships travel with Wu Ce never lost their voyage.

北洲東接滄海，北風軍近岸設填海營，四方鄉裏得填海營之庇護，多以漁為業。 白晝常有艦隊近岸戒巡。 千帆影動，萬裏雲分，風蕭蕭兮飛雪，水澹澹兮鳴湍。 每入夜，下臥漁火燦爛，上斜北斗闌幹，近聞炊烟聚落，遠觀星漢就列。
    吳策之父，吳恒，時任北風軍偏將軍，善海戰，有私部曲百人。 弈仙六己亥年，姜襲明同吳恒軍於東海濱誅邪，見年幼吳策常臥於樓船爵室之頂，仰而觀星辰。 襲明奇之，問其星象，皆對答如流。 襲明掐指一算，微頷首，贈摺扇一柄，又傳心法數十句，孩童聽罷複述，竟一字不差。 後姜襲明辭行，臨行前，言此孩童頗具仙緣，常帶左右可保平安。
    滄海入夜後，偶有瘴氣籠罩，瘴氣濃時，如灰紗障目，舟入深海為魔氣所侵，鮮有生還者。 吳策常隨父夜間行船，手執摺扇而領航。 合扇聚炁於丹田，行炁時可感星月之力。 開扇散炁於身側，揮扇間可窺天地生機。 扇舞之處，明月星辰光輝閃耀，瘴氣盡散。 眾艦從吳策而行，未嘗失航也。

东海之滨，童子多好戏蟹逐浪，筑沙拾贝。吴策不乐此，唯悦望星辰，为父领航。领航之余，又常待父之营中，听众议事，若有所思。听事之余，亦好读兵书，览之甚速，不数月间，营中已无吴策所未读者矣。 
    后吴策旁听父与众人议事，众人论战时，吴策或有所言。初闻吴策之言，众人皆以孩童妄言而愠，欲斥之而畏其父之威严，而其父亦有不悦之色。然稍思吴策之计，众人皆默然无语。须臾，吴恒大笑曰：既无人对答，便是策儿之计有可取者也，便从此行事可乎？ 遂吴军因之而行，果真得胜。
    过数年，吴策渐成军师。吴恒军中大小事务皆过吴策之手。平日，吴策随父巡营，士兵之姓氏容貌，皆过目不忘，攀谈时尽能唤其名，如有难处，亦能为其出谋划策，长久，众兵士皆以吴策为亲。吴策又教众兵士些行气法门，后部曲依法行军，少受魔气扰矣。
    为助行军，吴策求机关于天机谷，参星辰之方位而布机关于众舰，曰北斗连环。海军依此阵法，以机关为号，入沧海而不惧散，船相呼应，寻常魔物不可奈何。又因吴策善占天象，常引士兵于上风处起火，火攻而魔物奔走。岸有火，而海有众舰，相夹而攻。数年，东海滨魔物少矣。

Most of the children on the East Coast like to play with crabs and waves, build sand and collect shells. Wu Ce did not enjoy this, but only enjoyed looking at the stars and navigating for the army. At other times, Wu Ce often stayed in father's camp, listening to the deliberations and thinking. Besides listening to the deliberations, Wu Ce also likes to read military books, the speed of reading is very fast, in less than a few months, there is no book in the camp that Wu Ce has not yet read. 

Later, Wu Ce observed father and others' deliberations, and when they discussed the war, Wu Ce might have something to say. At first heard Wu Ce's words, the people were sulking with the child's presumptuous words, and wanted to reprimand Wu Ce but feared Wu Heng's majesty, while Wu Heng also had a look of displeasure. However, after thinking about Wu Ce's plan, everyone went silent. After a while, Wu Heng said with a big laugh:" since no one can criticize Ce's speech, that is, Ce's plan is also acceptable, we will act on this plan, okay?" So Wu's army acted on Wu Ce's plan and actually gained the victory.

After a few years, Wu Ce gradually became a strategic advisor, and Wu Heng's army was entrusted to Wu Ce on all matters of importance. Normally, Wu Ce would accompany father to patrol the camp and the soldier met during the patrol, Wu Ce would remember his name and appearance, then if Wu Ce met the soldier again, Wu Ce would be able to call his name, and if the soldier had difficulties, Wu Ce could also advise him. After a long time, the soldiers all take Wu Ce as their relative. Wu Ce also taught the soldiers the method of qi circulation, and later the soldiers marched according to Wu Ce's method and were rarely disturbed by the demonic qi.

In order to help the army, Wu Ce purchased devices from Tianji Valley, referring to the direction of the stars to install the devices between the fleets. The formation formed by the fleet is called the Dipper Interlocking Formation. According to this formation, the navy uses devices as the communication tool, sailing into the sea without fear of dispersion, and the ships look after each other, so ordinary devils cannot be a threat. Because Wu Ce is good at divination and can determine the direction of the wind, the soldiers often build fires upwind according to Wu Ce's dispatch to drive away the devils. Fire on the shore, and ships in the sea, together they attacked the devils, and for several years, the devils on the east coast gradually became less and less.

東海之濱，童子多好戲蟹逐浪，築沙拾貝。 吳策不樂此，唯悅望星辰，為父領航。 領航之餘，又常待父之營中，聽眾議事，若有所思。 聽事之餘，亦好讀兵書，覽之甚速，不數月間，營中已無吳策所未讀者矣。
    後吳策旁聽父與眾人議事，眾人論戰時，吳策或有所言。 初聞吳策之言，眾人皆以孩童妄言而慍，欲斥之而畏其父之威嚴，而其父亦有不悅之色。 然稍思吳策之計，眾人皆默然無語。 須臾，吳恒大笑曰：既無人對答，便是策兒之計有可取者也，便從此行事可乎？ 遂吳軍因之而行，果真得勝。
    過數年，吳策漸成軍師。 吳恒軍中大小事務皆過吳策之手。 平日，吳策隨父巡營，阿兵哥之姓氏容貌，皆過目不忘，攀談時盡能喚其名，如有難處，亦能為其出謀劃策，長久，眾兵士皆以吳策為親。 吳策又教眾兵士些行氣法門，後部曲依法行軍，少受魔氣擾矣。
    為助行軍，吳策求機關於天機穀，參星辰之方位而布機關於眾艦，曰北斗連環。 海軍依此陣法，以機關為號，入滄海而不懼散，船相呼應，尋常魔物不可奈何。 又因吳策善占天象，常引阿兵哥於上風處起火，火攻而魔物奔走。 岸有火，而海有眾艦，相夾而攻。 數年，東海濱魔物少矣。

时右将军王甚彧，统填海营全军，见吴恒军近年屡立战功，颇有功高盖主之势，不悦久已。
    一日，斥候报关外有魔物群聚，王甚彧命吴恒军弃舰而从陆路，出关击之。吴恒得令默而不发，吴策卜之，垂泪。翌日，北风萧萧，吴恒与部曲共祭热酒一杯，出御寒关而去。
    至魔物群数里处，吴策带兵掘坑设伏，三面又设火兵。是夜，吴策引星辰之力，转风向为北，吴恒下令弓兵齐射，三面火起。魔物惊而向北奔走，踩踏焚烧者众，数大减。火势稍歇，有魔物向南袭来，皆入陷坑。陷坑满时，吴恒率步兵拼杀，且战且退，待箭支耗尽，已至御寒关下。然王甚彧立于高墙，以魔物未尽为由，紧闭关门，亦不放箭相助。吴恒军冲杀出去，渐不知行踪。
    数日后，魔群散去，吴恒军回营，出时部者众，归来不过百矣。只见吴恒推一木车，上盖其披风，众人皆面愤恨而有泪。吴恒以披风裹车上之物，置于小舟之上，众人皆哭丧，送小舟入沧海。
    过数月，王甚彧本觉吴策已除，吴恒闭门不出，将军之位无忧矣。然数月间，各部出征时，常得高人相助，只见其身披吴恒之披风，迫在眉睫而显，纷乱将除而走。众人只道吴策冤魂不散，誓要报仇不可。王甚彧怒从中起，又使手段迫害饶舌者。此行多次，军中怨声载道。更有不满者，醉酒而刺王甚彧于帐中，未果。
    翌日夜，将星陨落。狂风吹王甚彧之帐，王甚彧惊醒，出帐，见吴策，大惊，挥刀驱之，不中，遂大喊。见众兵士出，吴策大斥王甚彧昏庸无能，陷害忠良，为尸位素餐之无耻奸徒，三洲之祸害，人人得而诛之。王甚彧听罢，急火攻心，金疮迸裂而亡。众人回过神来，吴策已不知去向。
    后北风军主帅得七星阁书信，赞吴恒之忠勇，吴恒遂迁右将军，统填海营全军。

At that time, the right general Wang Shenyu was in charge of the whole army of Sea Filling Camp. Seeing Wu Heng's repeated successes in recent years, he felt that Wu Heng had a tendency to surpass himself in terms of fame and was not happy for a long time.

One day, the scouts reported that there were demons gathering outside of the Cold Pass, and Wang Jian Yu ordered Wu Heng's army to abandon the ship and take the land route out of the Cold Pass to expel the demons. After receiving the order, Wu Heng fell into silence and did not take any action. After Wu Ce divined the fate, and also wept in silence. On the next day, with the breeze blowing in the north, Wu Heng and his soldiers drank hot wine together and went out of the Cold Pass.

A few miles to the devil group, Wu Ce led troops to dig a pit and set up an ambush, and set up fire soldiers on the other three sides of the devil group. That night, Wu Ce drew the power of the stars and turned the wind to the north. Wu Heng ordered the bow soldiers to shoot at the devils, while the other three sides of the devils were surrounded by blazing fire. The devils were frightened and ran to the north, and for a while a large number of devils were trampled and burned, and the number of devils was greatly reduced. After a while, the fire weakened a little, some devils turned to the south to attack, and they all entered the trap set by Wu Ce. When the trap was full, Wu Heng led his infantry to fight and move slowly southward while fighting, and when they ran out of arrows, they had already reached the bottom of the Cold Pass. However, Wang Shenyu stood at the high wall and closed the gate tightly with the excuse that the devils were not yet exhausted, and not even release arrows to help. Wu Heng's army rushed out and gradually disappeared in the wind and snow of the North Continent.

A few days later, the devil group dispersed, Wu Heng army back to camp. The number of soldiers was large when they left the camp, but when they returned, there were not even a hundred left. Wu Heng pushed a wooden cart, covered with his cloak, followed by the soldiers all have angry and sad look. Wu Heng wrapped his cloak around the body on the cart and put it on a boat, and all the soldiers wept and sent the boat into the sea.

After a few months, Wang Shenyu felt that Wu Ce had been eliminated and Wu Heng was depressed and ignoring military affairs, so he had nothing to worry about in his position as general. However, during the next few months, the troops were often assisted by a mysterious person who wore Wu Heng's cloak and always appeared when there was an imminent crisis, but left as soon as the crisis was over. The soldiers talked privately that it was Wu Ce's ghost who was vowing to take revenge. When Wang Shenyu heard this, he was furious and persecuted the soldiers who had spread the rumors. Gradually, the number of persecuted soldiers increased, and the army was filled with discontent. A discontented soldier even drunkenly assassinated Wang Shenyu, but was unsuccessful.

The following night, the star fell. The wind blew Wang Shenyu's tent, Wang Shenyu woke up, went out of the tent, and saw Wu Ce standing straight in front of him, Wang Shenyu was shocked, waving his sword at Wu Ce, the sword penetrated Wu Ce's body and passed, as if there was nothing to cut, Wang Shenyu had to shout for help. Seeing all the soldiers out of the tent, Wu Ce rebuked Wang Shenyu's faint, incompetent and shameless, saying that he was only good at framing loyalty, wasting military pay, and really is the scourge of the three continents, everyone would like to kill Wang Shenyu for justice. After hearing this, Wang Shenyu's anger attacked his heart and his wounds burst open before he died. When the soldiers came back to their senses, they no longer knew where Wu Ce had gone.

Later, the commander of the North Wind Army received a letter from the Heptastar Pavilion, praising Wu Heng's loyalty and bravery, and Wu Heng was promoted to the right general, in charge of the whole army of Sea Filling Camp.

    吾行之得葫芦观之，内自有炁，遇水化浆而起酒香，吾行之甚喜，又铭以五行金纹理其炁，后所注之水，不论毒污，化酒后皆饮之无碍，愈清则酒香愈纯，愈浊则酒味愈烈，故行走江湖，备一悠然葫芦足矣。

When Wu Xingzhi was traveling on three continents, he visited a lot of villages, but with more demons wandering around fewer people will occur. The so-called inhumanity of heaven and earth regards all things as dogs, and as far as the eye can see, there are miserable scenes everywhere. Whenever Wu Xingzhi encounters evil spirits, he will try his best.

One day, a demon called Si came from the mountain road near the sea in the eastern continent. It was more than ten feet tall and had a big arm and a round waist. It held a purple gourd on the road. There is water coming out of the gourd, and the living beings will faint after drinking it, and when they faint, they will be eaten by evil spirits and eat their marrow. As Wu traveled to this place he saw that the demon was extremely swift, grabbed his body, and poured the gourd into his mouth. When he was caught, he had no time to resist. He drank most of the water from the gourd, but he didn't feel faint. His refreshing and Qi increased greatly, so he urged the five elements and the demon to fight for a long time. When Wu Xingzhi went to grab the gourd and drink it, he became more and more courageous in the battle. The Si demon is defeated and flees by the sea. It is that the gourd is a supernatural thing, but it was obtained by Demon Si by chance, and Si doesn't know its origin, and used it to harm the three continents.

Wu Xingzhi got the gourd to observe it. There is energy inside, and when it meets water, it turns into a pulp and gives off the aroma of the drink. Wu is very happy with the gourd and he inscribed it with the five-element runes on the energy. Since then, no matter whether the water is safe or poisoned, after turning it into a drink, he can safely drink it. The clearer the drink, the purer the aroma, and the more turbid the wine, the stronger the taste, so walking in the world, it is enough to prepare a leisurely gourd.

吾行之於三洲遊歷之時，訪山村鄉里為多，但見人跡愈稀，邪祟愈甚，所謂天地不仁以萬物為芻狗，目之所及，慘像環生，每遇邪魔，則盡全力除之。
    一日，東洲臨海山道有兕妖至，高十餘尺，生得膀大腰圓，持一紫葫蘆於山道間起舞，但凡有生靈路過，不論人獸，皆拎頸掐口而起，傾倒葫蘆，似有水從葫蘆出，生靈飲畢即昏，昏即遭兕妖食骨啖髓。吾行之遊歷至此，只見那妖身法快極，搶至吾行之身前提葫蘆便灌，吾行之一時被拿竟無暇反抗，葫蘆之水飲了大半，卻也不見昏，倒覺神清氣爽靈力大增，便催動五行與兕妖周璿，戰良久，吾行之奪葫蘆而飲，竟有愈戰愈勇之勢，兕妖不敵，遁滄海而走。想是那葫蘆並非凡間之物，巧為兕妖所得，不知其乾坤，卻用來禍害三洲。
    吾行之得葫蘆觀之，內自有炁，遇水化漿而起酒香，吾行之甚喜，又銘以五行金紋理其炁，後所注之水，不論毒汙，化酒後皆飲之無礙，愈清則酒香愈純，愈濁則酒味愈烈，故行走江湖，備一悠然葫蘆足矣。

吾行之行江湖之初，曾返芦雪城收捡旧物，于城门拆旧日所立旗杆，遇亭长俞风，俞风见其行为粗鄙，疑为不法之徒，上前制止，二人拉扯一通皆怒从肝起，赤手空拳打作一团，周围百姓忙上前劝开，一番解释方知误会一场，然一个说五行之术蓄势待发，一个道兵器尚在马上未取，皆是不服，二人相约以一月为限，诛魔之数为赌，败者于城门叩首称服。
    此后数日间，二人策马北洲，愈行愈北，白日斩魔，夜间生火歇马，饮酒造饭，谈天说地好不快活。一日，酒过三巡，俞风于马背取一包裹道：此包内藏刀三柄，曰龙牙，虎翼，犬神，为祖上贩舟时，一奇人所押，那人即得舟，便行舟远去，而后多年，无人归来赎刀，后请陆家鉴刀，只道内含魔气，威力不凡，却是三柄妖刀，久使恐魔气侵神，或有血光之灾，传祖上有前辈曾使过，不久便风魔了。说罢倒头便睡，吾行之听罢却也不以为意，运起功法守夜。至寅时，有路人自北方哭喊而来，但见其身后有巨熊追赶，只见那熊本是通体雪白，却面染赤红，掌大如蒲扇，疾走时声如雷霆，大地生颤。吾行之急唤俞风，二人合力击之，不敌，皆受重伤，情急之下，俞风取妖刀，二人拼死而击，终伤白熊，白熊咆哮而走。经此一役，二人自觉修为尚浅，改约为一年一聚，比诛魔之数，至一方心服口服方止。
    过数年，吾行之游历三洲，五行之术有成，俞风则常策马北境，二人每年时相聚把酒言欢，相比赌约各有胜负，却都是不服。然俞风生性桀骜，遇有难者必救，不敌便持妖刀，渐入魔道，神识将灭之际，以刀自刎而亡。吾行之闻讯，立于芦雪城门外良久，至深夜，叩首大哭。之后，吾行之收妖刀交于陆家，三柄妖刀融而成一，又以玄铁为鞘，铭纹封之，使妖气不得外泄，唤之为定风波。

At the beginning of Wu Xingzhi's trip to three continents, he returned to Luxue City to collect old things and demolished the old flagpole at the city gate. He met Yu Feng, the head of the city. Yu Feng saw that his behavior was vulgar and suspected that he was an outlaw, so he stepped forward to stop him. The two of them got angry when they argued, they fought together with their bare hands, and the people around hurriedly stepped forward to persuade them to leave, after some explanations, they realized that there was a misunderstanding, but one said that the art of the five elements is ready to go, and the other said weapon is still on the horse. They are all dissatisfied. The two meet for a limit of one month, and the number of devils killed is a gamble. The failed one needs to kowtow at the city gate.

For the next few days, the two rode their horses to the northern continents, further northward, killing devils during the day, lighting a fire at night, resting their horses, drinking and cooking, and chatting about how happy they were. One day, after drinking for three rounds, Yu Feng took a package on his horse's back and said: This package contains three handles of knives, called dragon teeth, tiger wings, and dog gods. They were held by a strange man when his ancestors were selling boats. After many years, no one came back to redeem the sword. Later, he asked the Lu family to learn about the sword. It was said to contain demonic Qi and its power was extraordinary, but it was three devil sabers. There are predecessors in the ancestors who once used it, and soon it turns into devils. Yu Feng fell asleep after he said it, but Wu Xingzhi didn't care about what Yu Feng said after hearing it, so he sat in meditation and vigil. At the time of Yin, a passerby came crying from the north but saw a giant bear chasing after him. The bear was originally white, but its face was dyed red, its palms were as big as palm-leaf fans, and when it ran, it made a booming sound, and the ground trembled. Wu Xingzhi was in a hurry to call Yu Feng, and the two fought together, lost, and both were seriously injured. In a hurry, Yu Feng took the devil sword, and the two fought desperately, eventually hurting the white bear, and the white bear roared away. After this battle, the two felt that their cultivation was still shallow, so they decided to meet once a year, and compare the number of devils until one of them was convinced.

A few years later, Wu Xingzhi traveled to the three continents and achieved success in the five elements, while Yu Feng often rode horses to the north. The two of them would meet every year to have a drink and chat. Comparing the bets, each had its own outcome, but they were both unconvinced. However, Yu Feng is rebellious by nature, and he will save anyone in trouble. If Yu Feng is defeated, he will hold a devil sword and gradually fall into the devil's way. When Yu Feng's consciousness is about to be destroyed, he kills himself with the sword. When Wu heard the news, he stood outside the gate of Luxue City for a long time, until late at night, kowtowed and wept loudly. Afterward, Wu Xingzhi collected the devil sabers and handed them over to the Lu family. The three devil sabers were fused into one, and the sheath was made of black iron, sealed with inscription patterns so that the demonic Qi could not leak out, and it was called Settle the Storm.

    一日，杜伶鸳于五行树下执伞踱步时，有五行之花落于眉心，好似女子花钿，顿觉灵气灌注，遂激发其五行元灵之能。执伞行炁可布五行阵法，入阵者休得再脱。
    平日里杜伶鸳常笑盈盈待人，举止轻佻，颇具媚气。然如有登徒浪子妄想轻薄，还须问问这五行道盟至上灵阵是否答应。

The mother of Du Lingyuan is the unparalleled beauty of three continents. When she was practicing in the Five Elements Alliance, an endless stream of people wanted to see her beauty. Later she gave birth to Du Lingyuan and didn't know Lingyuan's biological father, so Lingyuan followed her mother's surname. Inherited from her mother, Du Lingyuan also has the appearance of a celestial being. Every Five Elements Mountain holds a grand tree viewing ceremony. Among the visitors, few cultivators are not from the Five Elements Alliance, and most of them come to see her beauty.

One day, when Du Lingyuan was pacing under an umbrella under the five-element tree, a flower of the five elements fell between her eyebrows, just like a woman's flower makeup, and suddenly felt that the Qi was infused, and then stimulated the energy of the five-element primordial spirit. Holding an umbrella and using Qi to make a five-element formation, those who enter the formation will never escape again.

On weekdays, Du Lingyuan often treats people with a smile and behaves frivolously and charmingly. However, if there is a prodigal one who wants to be frivolous, he still has to ask the Supreme Spirit Formation of the Five Elements Alliance if it agrees.

杜伶鴛之母，乃三洲無雙絕色，于五行道盟修行之時，想睹其芳容者絡繹不絕。後生杜伶鴛，不知生父為何人，遂隨母姓。杜伶鴛承其母，亦有天人之姿，每五行山舉觀樹盛典，來者中，非五行道盟修士亦不在少，多半皆為睹其芳容而來。
    一日，杜伶鴛於五行樹下執傘踱步時，有五行之花落於眉心，好似女子花鈿，頓覺靈氣灌注，遂激發其五行元靈之能。執傘行炁可布五行陣法，入陣者休得再脫。
    平日裡杜伶鴛常笑盈盈待人，舉止輕佻，頗具媚氣。然如有登徒浪子妄想輕薄，還須問問這五行道盟至上靈陣是否答應。

五行山上五行神树，立于三洲心腹，诞生之时已不可考。其枝干为木，所开花为火，花落成土，土养树而长叶为金，金叶摇曳又降水成池。五行道盟分舵遍三洲，总舵设于五行山，设坛而守五行树，树多年而结混元果，每有果成，则五行道盟修士尽聚树下，开坛论道，又举办比赛斗法，胜者得混元果。
    却说这守树神坛，历代皆由总舵主设坛主专管，设有禁制，平日里弟子皆不得进。杜伶鸳长居总舵，欲进神坛，只道欢喜五行树旁景致，娇媚作态起来，守门弟子拦其不住，遂入，却未触发禁制。守门弟子甚奇，报于总舵主。总舵主只道杜伶鸳仙缘至此，却也不管。
    一日，杜伶鸳于五行树下执伞踱步时，有五行之花落于眉心印堂。花消后仅剩梅花印记，好似女子花钿，先有灼烧之痛，而后顿觉体内五行之气，自树而来，源源不绝。此后，杜伶鸳五行之气具备，每有战时，任择一行气而运，皆可于顷刻间布阵，其势浑厚悠长，不可断绝也。

The sacred tree of the five elements on the Five Elements Mountain stands in the center of three continents, and the time of its birth is unreliable. Its branches are wood, the blossoms are fire, the flowers are soil, the soil grows the tree and the leaves become metal, and the metal leaves sway and become rain to form a pond. The Five Elements Alliance is divided into three continents, and the main rudder is set in Five Elements Mountain. An altar is set up to guard the Five Elements Tree. The tree grows for many years and produces world fruit. Every time there is fruit, the cultivator of the Five Elements Alliance gathers under the tree and opens the altar to discuss the Dao. There is also a competition for fighting skills, and the winner will get the world fruit.

It is said that the tree guard altar has been set up by the chief rudder in the past dynasties. There are restrictions, and no disciples are allowed to enter it usually. Du Lingyuan lived in the main rudder for a long time, and wanted to enter the altar, she only said she was happy with the scenery beside the five-element tree, and she acted coquettishly, and the gatekeeper couldn't stop her, so she entered, but the restriction was not triggered. The gatekeeper's disciple was very strange about this, so he reported it to the chief rudder. The chief rudder only said that Du Lingyuan was destined to come here, and they said just let her go with the flow.

One day, when Du Lingyuan was pacing under the five-element tree holding an umbrella, the flowers of the five elements fell on the head between her eyebrows. After the flowers are gone, only the imprint of plum blossoms remains, just like a woman's flower makeup, first there is a burning pain, and then Du Lingyuan suddenly feel the energy of the five elements in her body, which comes from the tree and has an endless Qi supply. Since then, Du Lingyuan possesses the Qi of the Five Elements. Whenever there is a battle, any type of Qi can be deployed in an instant.

五行山上五行神樹，立于三洲心腹，誕生之時已不可考。其枝幹為木，所開花為火，花落成土，土養樹而長葉為金，金葉搖曳又降水成池。五行道盟分舵遍三洲，總舵設於五行山，設壇而守五行樹，樹多年而結混元果，每有果成，則五行道盟修士盡聚樹下，開壇論道，又舉辦比賽鬥法，勝者得混元果。
    卻說這守樹神壇，歷代皆由總舵主設壇主專管，設有禁制，平日裡弟子皆不得進。杜伶鴛長居總舵，欲進神壇，只道歡喜五行樹旁景致，嬌媚作態起來，守門弟子攔其不住，遂入，卻未觸發禁制。守門弟子甚奇，報於總舵主。總舵主只道杜伶鴛仙緣至此，卻也不管。
    一日，杜伶鴛於五行樹下執傘踱步時，有五行之花落於眉心印堂。花消後僅剩梅花印記，好似女子花鈿，先有灼燒之痛，而後頓覺體內五行之氣，自樹而來，源源不絕。此後，杜伶鴛五行之氣具備，每有戰時，任擇一行氣而運，皆可於頃刻間佈陣，其勢渾厚悠長，不可斷絕也。

杜伶鸳平日厌恶污浊之气，至天工坊，打造一柄清气护身之伞。伞面外为水，内为火，伞骨为金，伞把为木，伞穗系玉石，成混元之势。平日里此伞遮风挡雨，与人斗起法来，可助杜伶鸳外引五行之气，须臾间成阵，以伞催阵亦能牵引灵气，伤敌护身转换自如，实乃百变神兵。
    然杜伶鸳使此伞，却喜逆施五行，以相克之法催之，灵气汇聚而成双鸳，随伞而转。汇气成形，似知其不可为而强为之。众人视其这般胡闹，于修行竟行些事倍功半之事。然杜伶鸳只道：妾身心上有几人，便化几只鸳，若有人能让妾身欢喜，那便再多添几只又何妨？众人皆哗然，此中真意又有何人知。

Du Lingyuan usually hates dirty air, so she went to Tiangong Workshop to build an umbrella with clean air to protect her body. The outside circle of the umbrella surface is water, the inner circle is fire, the umbrella bone is metal, the umbrella handle is wood, and the umbrella fringe is made of jade, forming a mixed element. Usually, this umbrella protects against wind and rain, and when fighting with others, it can help Du Lingyuan attract the Qi of the five elements to form a formation in an instant, and use the umbrella to stimulate the formation. It can also draw Qi, and it can easily transform from protecting the body to hurting the enemy. It becomes a variety weapon.

However, when Du Lingyuan uses this umbrella, she likes to apply the five elements to overcome each other, urging them with the method of mutual overcome, and the Qi gathers to form a couple of mandarin ducks, which rotate with the umbrella. Gathering Qi to form, Du Lingyuan forced the Qi to do what it shouldn't do. Everyone was surprised to see her doing such things with half the effort and half the effort during her practice. However, Du Lingyuan only said: "I have few people in my mind, so I can form the same number of mandarin ducks on my umbrella. If someone can please me, then why not add a few more?" Everyone was in an uproar, but who knew the true meaning of this?

杜伶鴛平日厭惡污濁之氣，至天工坊，打造一柄清氣護身之傘。傘面外為水，內為火，傘骨為金，傘把為木，傘穗系玉石，成混元之勢。平日裡此傘遮風擋雨，與人鬥起法來，可助杜伶鴛外引五行之氣，須臾間成陣，以傘催陣亦能牽引靈氣，傷敵護身轉換自如，實乃百變神兵。
    然杜伶鴛使此傘，卻喜逆施五行，以相克之法催之，靈氣彙聚而成雙鴛，隨傘而轉。匯氣成形，似知其不可為而強為之。眾人視其這般胡鬧，于修行竟行些事倍功半之事。然杜伶鴛只道：妾身心上有幾人，便化幾隻鴛，若有人能讓妾身歡喜，那便再多添幾隻又何妨？眾人皆譁然，此中真意又有何人知。

杜伶鸳之母，杜心麟，乃三洲无双绝色，于五行道盟修行之时，想睹其芳容者络绎不绝。后生杜伶鸳，不知生父为何人，遂随母姓。待杜伶鸳年稍长，其母命其入门修法，而自己只于宗门池边观鸳鸯，渐疏远。至杜伶鸳七岁，是年入冬后天寒地冻，仅一日间，鸳鸯皆南飞。是夜，杜伶鸳见母未归，至池寻之，但见孤零零双鸳灯一盏，哪里还有母亲身影。
    时至今日，杜伶鸳依然不解其母为何弃女而去，亦不知其生死。然每见双鸳，便想起娘亲，其心哀极。多年，渐成心魔，杜伶鸳往往以气化鸳，逆施五行，却哪知因其先天元灵充沛，竟亦能施展开来，其势比之寻常五行法来，更具神威。

The mother of Du Lingyuan is the unparalleled beauty of three continents. When she was practicing in the Five Elements Alliance, there was an endless stream of people who wanted to see her beauty. Du Lingyuan, the younger generation, didn't know who his biological father was. When Du Lingyuan was a little older, her mother ordered her to start practicing dharma, but her mother only watched the mandarin ducks by the sect's pool, and gradually became estranged. When Du Lingyuan was seven years old, it was freezing cold after winter, and the mandarin ducks all flew south in just one day. At night, Du Lingyuan saw that her mother had not returned, so she went to the pond to look for her, but she saw only a lonely pair of mandarin lanterns, and her mother was nowhere to be seen.

Until today, Du Lingyuan still does not understand why her mother abandoned her daughter, nor does she know her mother live or death. However, every time she sees the pair of mandarin ducks, she thinks of her mother, and her heart is extremely sad. Over the years, the abandonment by her mother has gradually become a demon in her heart. Du Lingyuan often uses Qi to transform mandarin ducks and applies the five elements to overcome as her will, but who knows that because of her innate vitality, she can also use it, which is more powerful than the ordinary five elements method.

杜伶鴛之母，杜心麟，乃三洲無雙絕色，于五行道盟修行之時，想睹其芳容者絡繹不絕。後生杜伶鴛，不知生父為何人，遂隨母姓。待杜伶鴛年稍長，其母命其入門修法，而自己只于宗門池邊觀鴛鴦，漸疏遠。至杜伶鴛七歲，是年入冬後天寒地凍，僅一日間，鴛鴦皆南飛。是夜，杜伶鴛見母未歸，至池尋之，但見孤零零雙鴛燈一盞，哪裡還有母親身影。
    時至今日，杜伶鴛依然不解其母為何棄女而去，亦不知其生死。然每見雙鴛，便想起娘親，其心哀極。多年，漸成心魔，杜伶鴛往往以氣化鴛，逆施五行，卻哪知因其先天元靈充沛，竟亦能施展開來，其勢比之尋常五行法來，更具神威。

关于吾行之：吾师兄平日都不在盟里，人家的孤单寂寞可真是少了处排解呢。每每返来，只要看到他对我避如水火的样子，这趣味就增了大半。不管是躲进酒窖还是在武场结伴，撩拨两三句就落荒而逃的样子真是让人……哈哈，不能再多说了。

关于慕虎：每次到山下麒麟舵，都能见着虎子在打坐，十分无趣。一身虎皮倒是手感不错，尤其是尾巴，摸起来呀，光滑柔顺，嘻嘻，让我都想养只狸奴来时常摸摸了。

关于花沁蕊：小花每次见我都十二分殷勤，但是夸完我，转身又夸起其他宗门道友来，打点什么主意真是藏不住呢，哈哈。可惜啊，人家这把流鸳伞排太满了，上面的鸳鸯，数都来不及数呢。

关于南宫生：小生很机灵呢，每次跟他说些有的没的，马上就能明白你的意思。他来五行山啊，总坛也变得热闹了，嘻嘻，妾身也很是欢喜。

关于曜灵：小曜灵每次来盟里会带些香泽，白膏。说是以仙草炼制，有驻颜清心之效。妾身天生丽质，倒也用不着这些。只是其中不同香味，妾身每日用一种，闻着心情也变好了些。

About Wu Xingzhi: Senior apprentice Wu is not in the alliance usually, so there are really few places to relieve my loneliness. Every time I come back, as long as I see how he avoids me like a flood, the fun will increase by more than half. Whether Whether he is hiding in the wine cellar or competing in the martial arena, the appearance of running away after a few words of teasing is really... Haha, I can't say more.

About Mu Hu: Every time I go to Qilin Rudder at the foot of the mountain, I can see Tiger meditating, which is very boring. But his tiger skin feels good to touch, especially the tail, it feels very smooth and supple, hehe, Makes me want to get a cat to pet it from time to time.

About Hua Qinrui: Every time Qinrui sees me, she is extremely attentive, but after she compliments me, she begin to introduce other fellow daoists Immediately. so she really can't hide her plans, huh? It's a pity that my umbrella is too full, and there are too many mandarin ducks on it already.

About Nangong Sheng: Sheng is very smart, every time you say something to him, he will immediately understand what you mean. When he comes to Five Elements Mountain, the main altar will become very lively, hehehe, I am also very pleased.

About Yao Ling: Every time little Yao Ling comes to the alliance, she will bring some incense and white ointment. It is said that it is made from spirit herbs, which have the effect of calming the face and clearing the heart. I am naturally beautiful, so there is no need for these. It's just that there are different fragrances, I use one every day, and my mood improves after smelling it.

關於吾行之：吾師兄平日都不在盟裡，人家的孤單寂寞可真是少了處排解呢。每每返來，只要看到他對我避如水火的樣子，這趣味就增了大半。不管是躲進酒窖還是在武場結伴，撩撥兩三句就落荒而逃的樣子真是讓人……哈哈，不能再多說了。

關於慕虎：每次到山下麒麟舵，都能見著虎子在打坐，十分無趣。一身虎皮倒是手感不錯，尤其是尾巴，摸起來呀，光滑柔順，嘻嘻，让我都想养只狸奴来时常摸摸了。

關於花沁蕊：小花每次見我都十二分殷勤，但是誇完我，又夸其他宗門道友，打點什麼主意真是藏不住呢，哈哈。可惜啊，人家這把流鴛傘排太滿了，上面的鴛鴦，數都來不及數呢。

關於南宮生：小生很機靈呢，每次跟他說些有的沒的，馬上就能明白你的意思。 他來五行山啊，總壇也變得熱鬧了，嘻嘻，妾身也很是歡喜。

關於曜靈：小曜靈每次來盟裡會帶些香澤，白膏。說是以仙草煉製，有駐顏清心之效。妾身天生麗質，倒也用不著這些。只是其中不同香味，妾身每日用一種，聞著心情也變好了些。

慕虎，太山虎精之遗腹，由慕家村抚养，幼时食仙草，壮时聚灵气，而化妖。本性纯良，多助乡里。使一只金晃晃锟铻环，由村民献矿，慕虎亲锻之。以虎威催动，环随掌动，有山崩地裂之势。
    五行道盟白虎舵以慕虎仙缘深厚而邀之，至金灵灵气有成，转麒麟舵。慕虎平日善静功，传其修静功时能见麒麟。慕虎得麒麟土之造化，又同太山颇具渊源，土灵灵气修为精进神速。慕虎凭此二炁，同辈之中，少有能出其右者。

Mu Hu, the posthumous son of a tiger spirit from Mount Tai, was raised by the people of Mu Village. Mu Hu ate spiritual herbs when he was young, and gathered Qi to transform into a demon when he was an adult. He has a pure nature and helps the village a lot. Mu Hu usually uses a Kun Wu Metal Ring, which is donated by the villagers and Mu Hu personally forges it. Mu Hu moved the golden ring with the power of the tiger, and when the ring moved with his palm, it was as powerful as a landslide.

The White Tiger Rudder of the Five Elements Alliance invites Mu Hu because he has a deep connection with cultivating immortals. After Mu Hu successfully mastered Metal Spirit, he transferred to Qilin Rudder. Mu Hu is usually good at meditation, and there are rumors that he can see Qilin while meditating. Mu Hu obtained Qilin's spirit of earth, and at the same time, he has a deep connection with Mount Tai, so his cultivation of earth spirit has improved rapidly. With Mu Hu's two spirits of soil and gold, few of his peers can match him.

慕虎，太山虎精之遺腹，由慕家村撫養，幼時食仙草，壯時聚靈氣，而化妖。本性純良，多助鄉里。使一隻金晃晃錕铻環，由村民献矿，慕虎亲锻之。以虎威催動，環隨掌動，有山崩地裂之勢。
    五行道盟白虎舵以慕虎仙緣深厚而邀之，至金靈靈氣有成，轉麒麟舵。慕虎平日善靜功，傳其修靜功時能見麒麟。慕虎得麒麟土之造化，又同太山頗具淵源，土靈靈氣修為精進神速。慕虎憑此二炁，同輩之中，少有能出其右者。

五行道盟白虎舵向西行数百里，近太山山脉中段，有一锟铻山，山中多矿洞。锟铻山旁有村，曰慕家村，村中多金工石匠，平日以贩金石为营生。彼时，魔物屡犯慕家村，村民皆凡人，不可抵挡，遂以金石献于白虎舵，以求庇护。后常有修士驻村以拒魔物，偶遇有缘者，亦教些粗浅行气法门。经多年，村内虽不出修士，然能感先天炁者多矣。魔物虽凶，亦不敌炼气者之众。
    一日，有一吊睛白额虎精，于村口徘徊，步履踉跄，似身负有伤。村民执锄驱之，虎啸声弱矣。少顷，依于村口碑旁，气绝而亡。村民剖之，见腹中有子，怜之，不忍弃，遂合力而养，望其成年后重归于野。却说此幼虎，以羊乳为食，仅三日便如成年狸奴般大小，已能田间捕鼠捉蛇。蛇虫鼠蚁食不够，又咀嚼起灵草。有村民见其生得可爱，亦常采灵草喂之，渐与幼虎熟络，为其取名慕虎，平日以虎儿唤之，皆有回应。过数月，慕虎已如成年男子般大小，竟双足而立，学起人来。村民大惊，急请修士，修士见罢，只道此为虎精化妖，请诛之。村民以其本性纯良，不似有危害乡里之意，为慕虎作保，修士方止。此后村中孩童，见虎双足而立却也不惧，常攀附其身，扯其毛，嬉戏打闹者不在少数，慕虎却也不恼，和孩童耍作一团。又过数月，慕虎灵气小成，便要化形。见其脸毛渐褪，似人一般，村中孩童嚎啕大哭。慕虎大惊，忙返原形，哭声方止，此后慕虎便不再化形。
    而后数年，慕虎身形愈发高大，直立而行，其貌甚威。常助村民运金石，拒魔物，久之，亦得行气法门。有白虎舵修士见其颇有仙缘，邀入舵中，此慕虎修行之始也。

Hundreds of miles westward from White Tiger Rudder of the Five Elements Alliance, near the middle of the Tai Mountains, there is a Kun Wu Mountain, where many mines are hidden. There is a village beside Kun Wu Mountain, called Mu Village. There are many metalworkers and stonemasons in the village, who make a living selling ore. At that time, the devil repeatedly attacked Mu Village, and the villagers were all mortals, irresistible, so they offered ore to White Tiger Rudder for protection. After that, practitioners are often stationed in the village to fight against the devil. If cultivators meet mortals who are predestined, they will also teach them some superficial methods of qi circulation. After many years, although none of the mortals in the village have become immortal cultivators, the number of mortals who can feel qi has gradually increased. Although the devils are fierce, they are no match for the crowd of qi refiners.

One day, a white-fronted tiger spirit with eye-catching eyes wandered around the entrance of the village, walking staggeringly, as if she had been wounded. The villagers took up hoes to drive her away, and her roar gradually became weaker. After a while, she leaned against the stone tablet at the entrance of the village and died of exhaustion. The villagers dissected her and saw a tiger cub in her belly. They felt sorry for him and couldn't bear to abandon him, so they worked together to raise him, hoping that he would return to the wild when he became an adult. Villagers fed this cub with goat milk, and in just three days he was as big as a grown-up cat, and was able to catch mice and snakes in the fields. He couldn't get enough of snakes, insects, rats and ants, so he started chewing spiritual herbs. Some villagers saw that he was born cute, and often fed him with spiritual herbs. The villagers gradually became familiar with the cub, and named him Mu Hu. The villagers usually call him Tiger, and Mu Hu always responds. After a few months, Mu Hu was as big as an adult man, and he stood on two feet like a human. The villagers were shocked and asked the cultivator urgently. When the cultivator saw it, he thought it was a tiger spirit turned into a demon, so he wanted to kill him. The villagers believed that Mu Hu was pure in nature, and that Mu Hu did not seem to have the intention of harming the village, so they protected Mu Hu so that the cultivator would not kill him. Since then, the children in the village have not been afraid to see the tiger standing on both feet. They often cling to Mu Hu's body and pull his fur. There are many children playing like this, but Mu Hu is not annoyed, and still plays with the children. After a few more months, Mu Hu's qi has achieved a small achievement, and he is about to transform into form. Seeing Mu Hu's facial hair gradually faded, looking like a human, the children in the village wept loudly. Mu Hu was shocked, and quickly returned to his original form, and the crying stopped. After that, Mu Hu no longer changed his form.

In the next few years, Mu Hu became taller and taller, walking upright, and his appearance was very majestic. Mu Hu often helps the villagers transport ore and resist the devil. Over time, he also learns the method of promoting Qi. A cultivator from the white tiger rudder saw that Muhu was quite destined to be a fairy, and invited him into the rudder. This was the beginning of Mu Hu's cultivator.

五行道盟白虎舵向西行數百里，近太山山脈中段，有一錕铻山，山中多礦洞。錕铻山旁有村，曰慕家村，村中多金工石匠，平日以販金石為營生。彼時，魔物屢犯慕家村，村民皆凡人，不可抵擋，遂以金石獻於白虎舵，以求庇護。後常有修士駐村以拒魔物，偶遇有緣者，亦教些粗淺行氣法門。經多年，村內雖不出修士，然能感先天炁者多矣。魔物雖凶，亦不敵煉氣者之眾。
    一日，有一吊睛白額虎精，於村口徘徊，步履踉蹌，似身負有傷。村民執鋤驅之，虎嘯聲弱矣。少頃，依於村口碑旁，氣絕而亡。村民剖之，見腹中有子，憐之，不忍棄，遂合力而養，望其成年後重歸於野。卻說此幼虎，以羊乳為食，僅三日便如成年狸奴般大小，已能田間捕鼠捉蛇。蛇蟲鼠蟻食不夠，又咀嚼起靈草。有村民見其生得可愛，亦常采靈草餵之，漸與幼虎熟絡，為其取名慕虎，平日以虎兒喚之，皆有回應。過數月，慕虎已如成年男子般大小，竟雙足而立，學起人來。村民大驚，急請修士，修士見罷，只道此為虎精化妖，請誅之。村民以其本性純良，不似有危害鄉里之意，為慕虎作保，修士方止。此後村中孩童，見虎雙足而立卻也不懼，常攀附其身，扯其毛，嬉戲打鬧者不在少數，慕虎卻也不惱，和孩童耍作一團。又過數月，慕虎靈氣小成，便要化形。見其臉毛漸褪，似人一般，村中孩童嚎啕大哭。慕虎大驚，忙返原形，哭聲方止，此後慕虎便不再化形。
    而後數年，慕虎身形愈發高大，直立而行，其貌甚威。常助村民運金石，拒魔物，久之，亦得行氣法門。有白虎舵修士見其頗有仙緣，邀入舵中，此慕虎修行之始也。

锟铻山内多洞穴，三洲金石多出于此。然洞穴深邃，时有魔物，洞中穿梭间常引岩壁坍塌，采矿者伤亡不在少。慕虎成年后，常同村民一道采矿。每有坍塌，慕虎以身躯抗之，以护村民周全。然以血肉之躯硬抗顽石，终不能全身而退，遂身常带伤。
    村民为谢慕虎护矿之恩，集全村多年所藏锟钢，赠与慕虎，望其铸成法器，以护身躯。平日，慕虎常学村中工匠做些物件，其掌虽粗大，却十分灵巧，所做玩物，甚得孩童欢喜。今得锟钢，虽于锻兵之法不甚明了，慕虎心中却若有所思。只见慕虎于村中铁匠铺徘徊数日，运碳控火，铁锤纷飞，火花四溅，有时竟运起双掌，使起蛮劲，硬是将那锟钢，百拧千锤成环。又内嵌虎须，上刻五行印记，遂成锟铻金环。
    慕虎戴环于臂，环悬于臂而不触毛发，运气于环而成金光护体。此后，慕虎以金光护采矿者，皆能无伤。闲暇时，慕虎竟似学起锻玄宗，以掌击石，石碎洞穿，遂矿洞渐宽。又运木材架起支护，搬石区隔魔物，采矿渐无忧也。
    后慕虎主修金土二灵，聚环而发，其势如山崩地裂，掌至之处，如天神击锤。

There are many caves in the Kun Wu Mountain, and the ores from the three continents are mostly found here. Although the cave is deep, there are devils shuttling in the cave from time to time, often causing the rock wall to collapse, and there are many casualties among miners. When Mu Hu became an adult, he often worked with the villagers to mine. Every time there is a collapse, Mu Hu fights it with his body to protect the villagers. However, he resisted the stubborn stone with his flesh and blood, but he couldn't retreat completely, so he was often injured.

In order to thank Muhu for his kindness in protecting the mine, the villagers gathered the kun steel that the whole village had collected for many years and presented them to Muhu, hoping that he would cast them into armor to protect his body. Usually, Mu Hu often learns from the craftsmen in the village to make some objects. Although his palms are thick, they are very dexterous, and the playthings he makes are very popular among children. Now that Mu Hu has acquired Kun Steel, although he is not very clear about the method of forging protective gear, he seems to have an idea in his mind. Mu Hu wandered around the blacksmith shop in the village for a few days. He first transported carbon to control the fire, then he swung the hammer up and down, causing sparks to fly everywhere, and then he simply lifted his palms and twisted the steel with force, and finally forged the steel into a ring. Then Mu Hu embedded a tiger whisker inside the ring, and engraved the five-element mark on the surface, thus forming the Kun Wu Metal Ring.

Mu Hu wears the Kun Wu Metal Ring on his arm, the ring hangs on the arm without touching the fur, and Mu Hu transports the energy in the ring to form a golden body protection. Afterwards, Muhu used the ring to protect the miners, and they were never harmed again. In his spare time, Mu Hu seems to have learned the method of Duan Xuan Sect, hitting the stone with his palm, and after the stone is broken, the mine tunnel is connected, and the space gradually widens. Mu Hu also transported wood to set up a support in the mine, moved stones and built walls to separate the devils, and the mining became worry-free.

Since then, Mu Hu has mainly practiced the Metal spirit and the Earth spirit. Every time Mu Hu moves the qi, the qi is sent out from the ring, and its momentum is like a landslide. Where Mu Hu's palm reaches, it is like being swung with a hammer by an immortal.

錕铻山內多洞穴，三洲金石多出於此。然洞穴深邃，時有魔物，洞中穿梭間常引岩壁坍塌，採礦者傷亡不在少。慕虎成年後，常同村民一道採礦。每有坍塌，慕虎以身軀抗之，以護村民周全。然以血肉之軀硬抗頑石，終不能全身而退，遂身常帶傷。
    村民為謝慕虎護礦之恩，集全村多年所藏錕鋼，贈與慕虎，望其鑄成法器，以護身軀。平日，慕虎常學村中工匠做些物件，其掌雖粗大，卻十分靈巧，所做玩物，甚得孩童歡喜。今得錕鋼，雖於鍛兵之法不甚明了，慕虎心中卻若有所思。只見慕虎於村中鐵匠鋪徘徊數日，運碳控火，鐵鎚紛飛，火花四濺，有時竟運起雙掌，使起蠻勁，硬是將那錕鋼，百擰千錘成環。又內嵌虎鬚，上刻五行印記，遂成錕铻金環。
    慕虎戴環於臂，環懸於臂而不觸毛髮，運氣於環而成金光護體。此後，慕虎以金光護採礦者，皆能無傷。閒暇時，慕虎竟似學起鍛玄宗，以掌擊石，石碎洞穿，遂礦洞漸寬。又運木材架起支護，搬石區隔魔物，採礦漸無憂也。
    後慕虎主修金土二靈，聚環而發，其勢如山崩地裂，掌至之處，如天神擊鎚。

慕虎成年后，助安顿乡里，村民生计渐好转，已能自保无忧。村民见慕虎终不似肉体凡胎，望其能入仙门，亦为慕家村之荣也。慕虎遂就近入五行道盟白虎舵。过数年，五行树结混元果，五行道盟修士多聚神坛相庆，麒麟舵舵主见慕虎天生土灵气之盛，远超同辈，实为难得，强邀慕虎转入麒麟舵。白虎舵主见其盛情难却，遂也不管。慕虎天生纯朴，随遇而安，便答应下来。
    却说这五行道盟麒麟舵，位于五行山山麓。常居五行山修士之中，平日于总舵修炼者多，麒麟舵修炼者少。舵主以修者少，不以星宿设堂，全舵上下仅设麒麟堂一堂，弟子亦多由舵主亲授。慕虎于麒麟舵修行以来，土灵灵气大进，与舵主进招之时已能不弱下风。
    一日，慕虎修静功时，隐约间见一兽，羊头，狼蹄，身有鳞，以慕虎身含仁义之气，而与其甚亲。兽以鳞赠慕虎，鳞触掌即消，消则二者通神识。兽传慕虎三洲土地之造化，慕虎合舵中印法而修，顿觉灵台澄明，修为精进。遂传于舵中，同门修士皆有所进。后慕虎常修静功，与兽所交渐深，兽望其多行仁义之事，方能见黄龙，以得天道。慕虎甚奇之，却不以为意，平日行事不为所变。众人只道虎儿本性如此，多行仁义不为功利。

After Mu Hu became an adult, he helped the villagers, and the livelihood of the villagers gradually improved, and they were able to protect themselves without any worries. Seeing that Mu Hu is not like a mortal, the villagers hope that he can enter the sect of immortals, which is also the honor of Mu Village. Mu Hu then joined the White Tiger Rudder of the Five Elements Alliance. After a few years, the Five Elements Tree bears fruit, and Five Elements Alliance cultivators gather at the altar to celebrate. Qilin rudder's master saw that Mu Hu was born with a strong earth spirit, far surpassing his peers, which is really rare, so he forced Mu Hu to transfer to the rudder of Qilin. The White Tiger Rudder's master saw that The Qilin Rudder's master's will was hard to refuse, so he agreed to Mu Hu's transfer to Qilin Rudder. Mu Hu was born simple and easygoing, so he agreed.

The Qilin Rudder of the Five Elements Alliance is located at the foot of the Five Elements Mountain. Among the cultivators who often live in the Five Elements Mountain, there are more cultivators in the main rudder and fewer in the Qilin rudder. Because there are few cultivators under the rudder, the rudder master does not set up halls based on stars. There is only one Qilin hall on the whole rudder, and most of the disciples are taught by the rudder master himself. Since Mu Hu practiced in Qilin Rudder, the earth spirit has made great progress, and he is no longer at a disadvantage when he is fighting with the rudder master.

One day, when Mu Hu was practicing meditation, he vaguely saw a beast with a sheep's head, wolf's hooves and scales on its body. Because of the benevolence and righteousness in Mu Hu's body, the beast is very close to Mu Hu. The beast presented Mu Hu with scales, and the scales disappeared when they touched Mu Hu's palm. After the scales disappeared, the beast and Mu Hu communicated with each other. The beast passed the good fortune of the three continents earth spirit to Mu Hu, and Mu Hu combined the seal method in the rudder to cultivate, suddenly felt that the spiritual platform was clear, and he cultivated diligently. Mu Hu then passed it on to the rudder, and all fellow cultivators made progress. Later, Muhu often practiced meditation, and his relationship with the beast gradually deepened. The beast hoped that Mu Hu would do more benevolent and righteous things, so that he could see the Yellow Dragon and understand the way of heaven. Mu Hu was very surprised, but he didn't take it seriously, and did not change his daily behavior. Everyone only said that Mu Hu's nature is like this, and that doing more benevolence and righteousness is not for utilitarianism.

慕虎成年後，助安頓鄉里，村民生計漸好轉，已能自保無憂。村民見慕虎終不似肉體凡胎，望其能入仙門，亦為慕家村之榮也。慕虎遂就近入五行道盟白虎舵。過數年，五行樹結混元果，五行道盟修士多聚神壇相慶，麒麟舵舵主見慕虎天生土靈氣之盛，遠超同輩，實為難得，強邀慕虎轉入麒麟舵。白虎舵主見其盛情難卻，遂也不管。慕虎天生純樸，隨遇而安，便答應下來。
    卻說這五行道盟麒麟舵，位於五行山山麓。常居五行山修士之中，平日於總舵修煉者多，麒麟舵修煉者少。舵主以修者少，不以星宿設堂，全舵上下僅設麒麟堂一堂，弟子亦多由舵主親授。慕虎於麒麟舵修行以來，土靈靈氣大進，與舵主進招之時已能不弱下風。
    一日，慕虎修靜功時，隱約間見一獸，羊頭，狼蹄，身有鱗，以慕虎身含仁義之氣，而與其甚親。獸以鱗贈慕虎，鱗觸掌即消，消則二者通神識。獸傳慕虎三洲土地之造化，慕虎合舵中印法而修，頓覺靈臺澄明，修為精進。遂傳於舵中，同門修士皆有所進。後慕虎常修靜功，與獸所交漸深，獸望其多行仁義之事，方能見黃龍，以得天道。慕虎甚奇之，卻不以為意，平日行事不為所變。眾人只道虎兒本性如此，多行仁義不為功利。

花沁蕊，五行道盟玄武舵修士，大衍国有缘堂少堂主。
    世传有天地造化之桃树，积五行树与玄冥池先天之水，又得有缘堂人气，所结之果孕一女婴。女婴由有缘堂堂主花如清所养，取名沁蕊。后花沁蕊入五行道盟，又得同树之枝所化如意，木灵灵气运转随心所欲，自此水木灵气修为远超同辈。
    花沁蕊平日里活泼伶俐，承有缘堂渡天下有缘人宗旨，好助人结缘。

Hua Qinrui, the cultivator of Black Tortoise Rudder of the Five Elements Alliance, the young master of the Fate Hall of Dayan Kingdom.

It has been handed down from generation to generation that there is a peach tree that was blessed with good fortune, accumulated the innate water of the Five Elements Tree and Xuanming Pool, and gained the popularity of the Fate Hall. A baby girl was born from the fruit of the peach tree. The baby girl was raised by Hua Ruqing, the master of Fate Hall, and named Qinrui. Later, Hua Qinrui joined the Five Elements Alliance, and obtained the Peach Branch Ruyi, which was transformed from the branches of the same peach tree.

Hua Qinrui is usually lively and bright, inherits the purpose of Fate Hall, and likes to help fellow Daoists to fall into the fate of love.

花沁蕊，五行道盟玄武舵修士，大衍國有緣堂少堂主。
    世傳有天地造化之桃樹，積五行樹與玄冥池先天之水，又得有緣堂人氣，所結之果孕一女嬰。女嬰由有緣堂堂主花如清所養，取名沁蕊。後花沁蕊入五行道盟，又得同樹之枝所化如意，木靈靈氣運轉隨心所欲，自此水木靈氣修為遠超同輩。
    花沁蕊平日里活潑伶俐，承有緣堂渡天下有緣人宗旨，好助人結緣。

大道破碎之后百年，三洲方有灵气复苏。有紫纹细桃核自裂隙来，乘风至三洲，落于五行山。初不得地利，未尝芽，然有五行树之灵气护身，却也不腐。经千年，神树生长，树底生池。核得五行树之水而萌发，数日成木，数年成林。
    时玄武舵牛金堂堂主花如玉，见此桃林水灵灵气醇厚，可助修行。便运起乾坤螺，将一桃树连根收入其中。后运至东洲玄武舵，置桃树于玄冥池旁。桃树得玄冥水，花叶窈窕，生机益旺。经数年，桃树感池边灵气流转，随气而动，又开枝散叶，至今已满树花果。玄武舵得桃树相助，灵气大盛，修士渐多。后常有池边修行者，行气之时，见点头摇首眼前果，闻桃风骤缓耳畔声，似桃树有灵智初生，欲与人话心一般。坊间有传，花沁蕊便由此桃树而生。

A hundred years after the shattering of the Great Rules, the three continents have just begun to recover. There is a fine peach pit with purple veins that came from the crack of the Great Rules, took the wind to Three Continents, and landed in the Five Elements Mountain. The peach pit didn't have a good growing environment at first, so it didn't germinate, but it was protected by the five-element tree, so it didn't rot. After thousands of years, the five-element tree grows, and a pond grows at the bottom of the tree. The peach pit germinates after getting the water of the five elements tree, and it only takes a few days to grow into a big tree, and it only takes a few years for the peach tree to become a peach forest.

Later, Hua Ruyu, the master of Jinniu Hall of Black Tortoise Rudder, saw that the water spirit in this peach forest is mellow and can help practice. So she picked up the Qiankun Snail and put a whole peach tree into it. Afterwards, it was transported to Black Tortoise Rudder of East Continent, and the peach tree was placed beside Xuanming Pool. The peach tree gets Xuanming water, the flowers and leaves are slim, and the vitality is flourishing. After several years, the peach tree feels the spiritual flow by the pool, the branches of the peach tree move with the air, the branches and leaves of the peach tree bloom, and the tree is full of flowers and fruits. Thanks to the peach tree's help, Black Tortoise Rudder's middle Qi flourished, and the number of cultivators gradually increased. Later, when cultivators were meditating by the pool, they would see the peach tree nodding and shaking its heads, and hear the sound of the wind ringing in their ears. It seems that the peach tree have produced spiritual wisdom, and it want to talk to people. According to legend, Huaqin stamens are born from this peach tree.

大道破碎之後百年，三洲方有靈氣復甦。有紫紋細桃核自裂隙來，乘風至三洲，落於五行山。初不得地利，未嘗芽，然有五行樹之靈氣護身，卻也不腐。經千年，神樹生長，樹底生池。核得五行樹之水而萌發，數日成木，數年成林。
    時玄武舵牛金堂堂主花如玉，見此桃林水靈靈氣醇厚，可助修行。便運起乾坤螺，將一桃樹連根收入其中。後運至東洲玄武舵，置桃樹於玄冥池旁。桃樹得玄冥水，花葉窈窕，生機益旺。經數年，桃樹感池邊靈氣流轉，隨氣而動，又開枝散葉，至今已滿樹花果。玄武舵得桃樹相助，靈氣大盛，修士漸多。後常有池邊修行者，行氣之時，見點頭搖首眼前果，聞桃風驟緩耳畔聲，似桃樹有靈智初生，欲與人話心一般。坊間有傳，花沁蕊便由此桃樹而生。

桃树所落之枝，坚如顽石。
    百年前，有桃枝落于池面，花如玉观其内有炁，欲炼为法器。遂差人使金斧，金凿，金刨，金铲，摧之，形不为所变。过九日，仅得一地桃花泪。有弟子敛其泪，以玄冥水泡之而饮，如琼浆玉液，木行灵气自聚丹田。再摧之，纹丝不动已。花如玉见其坚不可摧，不能为己所用，弃之可惜，便以土覆之，不再理会。
    后花沁蕊化人，与桃枝出于同根，自有先天感应。花沁蕊初返玄武舵时，桃枝破土而出，凌空化作一柄如意，绕于花沁蕊身侧，久不愿去。花沁蕊积五行树与玄冥池先天之水，现又得此桃枝如意，木行灵气为所聚，既得水木，五行之气运行无阻也。

The branches of the peach tree are as hard as a rock.

A hundred years ago, a peach branch fell on the surface of Xuanming Pool. Hua Ruyu saw Qi in it, and wanted to refine it into a magic weapon. So she ordered the disciples to use gold axes, gold chisels, gold planes, and gold shovels to transform the peach branch, and the shape of the peach branch remained unchanged. After nine days, there was only peach gum all over the ground. Some disciples collected peach gum, soaked it in the water of Xuanming Pool and drank it. It tasted like fine nectar. After drinking, the disciples felt that the wood spirit gathered in the dantian. Everyone tried to transform the peach branches again, but the peach branches remained unchanged. Hua Ruyu saw that the peach branch was indestructible and could not be used by herself, so she wanted to discard it, but felt it was a pity, so she covered it with soil and ignored it.

Later Hua Qinrui turned into a human being, and came from the same root as the peach branch, and they have mutual affection. When Hua Qinrui returned to Black Tortoise Rudder for the first time, the peach branch broke through the ground and turned into a Ruyi in the air, wrapping around Hua Qinrui's side, unwilling to go for a long time. Hua Qinrui has accumulated the innate water of the Five Elements Tree and Xuanming Pool, and now she has this Peach Branch Ruyi, which gathers the spiritual energy of the wood. With the water and wood, Hua Qinrui's Qi can operate very efficiently.

蝠妖婺与花如玉之弟花如清，曾同修道于五行道盟玄武舵女土堂，多年而生情愫，结为道侣。一日，婺与花如清月下论道，感万物皆有缘，却多因时不待而求不得。言至深处，皆愿倾其一生，成万物之机缘造化。遂此一人一妖，弃多年修行，至大衍国，创有缘堂，渡天下有缘者。
    时七夕将近，花如清奔走三洲，寻吉祥之物，以装点厅堂。至玄武舵，见满树桃花，灵动活泼，甚是可爱，便求起姐来，望其允花一枝。花如玉只道此木无坚不摧，折之不断，若有能耐自取去便是。花如清盘坐于桃树下，良久，道：桃之夭夭，宜其室家。忽来桃风，吹枝而下，落于花如清怀中。
    花如清得桃花一枝，以翡翠玉瓶盛之，置于厅堂中央。后不论仙凡，来往有缘堂者以人为多，桃花得人气，日渐活泼，能自作声，如人窃窃私语。一日，花闭而声止。婺与花如清甚奇之，试百法而花不得复开。至仲秋，花复开，有萤光点点，伴紫霞氤氲，花心现一女婴。
    花如清得女甚是欢喜，取名沁蕊，与婺一同抚养之。花沁蕊年幼时，喜与有缘堂来客清谈，常于谈笑之间促成来客姻缘，似命里为此所生一般。后年稍长，颇具顽劣之气，父母望其修身养性，遂求花如玉收为弟子。花沁蕊修起水灵之法，其势如天成，寻常法术皆信手拈来。又喜嬉戏，常以法术戏弄舵内同辈。同辈者又以花沁蕊天真烂漫而不忍责怪，遂与其一同嬉戏起来。常此，玄武舵与寻常仙门之氛围却是大有不同。

Bat Demon Wu and Hua Ruyu's younger brother Hua Ruqing once practiced Taoism in the Black Tortoise Rudder Nutu Hall of the Five Elements Alliance. They have been in love for many years and became a Taoist couple. One day, Wu and Hua Ruqing discussed the Tao under the moonlight, feeling that everything is destined, but most of them can't get it because time doesn't wait. Wu and Hua Ruqin communicated to the depths of their souls, and both are willing to spend their lives to fulfill the fate of all things. Thus, one person and one demon, abandoned many years of cultivation, went to Dayan Kingdom, created the Fate Hall, and fulfilled the predestined relationship of all the people in the world.

One year, when the Qixi Festival was approaching, Hua Ruqing traveled all over the three continents, looking for auspicious things to decorate the hall. When he arrived at Black Tortoise Rudder, Hua Ruqing saw that the tree was full of peach blossoms, lively and cute, so he begged his sister for a flower. Hua Ruyu only said that this tree is invincible, if the younger brother is capable, he can take it by himself. Hua Ruqing sat under the peach tree for a long time, and said: The peach tree is slender and sturdy, Flaming red are its blossoms. The girl is getting married, Most suitable for the house. Suddenly, the wind blows, blowing a branch down, falling In Hua Ruqing's arms.

Hua Ruqing got the peach blossom branch, put it in a jade bottle, and placed it in the center of Fate Hall. Later, whether they were cultivators or mortals, most of the people who came and went to Fate Hall were humans. Under the influence of human beings, Peach Blossom has become more and more lively. It can make its own voice, like a whisper. One day, the flowers close and the sound stops. Both Wu and Hua Ruqing were very surprised. They tried all kinds of methods but the flowers could not bloom again. In mid-autumn, the flowers bloom again, with little fluorescent lights, accompanied by purple clouds, and a baby girl appears in the heart of the flowers.

Hua Ruqing was very happy to have a daughter, named Qinrui, and raised her with Wu. When Hua Qinrui was young, she liked to chat with the visitors of Fate Hall, and often made marriages between the visitors through talking and laughing, as if she was born for this. Later, when Hua Qinrui was a little older, she seemed quite mischievous. Her parents hoped that she would cultivate her morality, so she begged Hua Ruyu to accept her as a disciple. When Hua Qinrui practiced the water spirit technique, her aura seemed natural, and she could easily perform ordinary spells. Hua Qinrui also likes to play, and often teases her peers in the rudder with spells. Cultivators of the same generation couldn't bear to blame Hua Qinrui for her innocence, and after a long time, they all started playing with her. Later, the atmosphere of Black Tortoise Rudder was quite different from that of ordinary cultivation sects.

    生性顽劣，嫉恶如仇，于陵光国小有名望，颇受陵光各州孩童青睐，人送外号陵光小霸王。

Nangong Sheng, the Westerner. His Westerner's name is Milad, and surname is unknown. Nangong Sheng encountered the West Continent Gu Insect Crisis when he was young and was saved by Vermilion Bird. Later, he was brought back to the Vermilion Bird Rudder by Master Nangong, and was given the name Nangong Sheng. Because of the original fire spirit given by Vermilion Bird, Nangong Sheng cultivated very fast and was quite talented in the five element seal method.

Nangong Sheng is mischievous by nature and full of justice. He is quite famous in the Lingguang country, very popular with the children of the states of the Lingguang country, and they gave him a nickname, called the little overlord of the Lingguang.

南宮生，西來者。 西來者名米拉德，姓氏不詳。 幼時遇西洲蠱亂，為朱雀所救。 後被朱雀舵舵主南宮炟帶回舵中，取名南宮生。 因受朱雀原初火靈靈氣，修行神速，於五行印法亦頗有天賦。

先于五行修士相聚五行山立盟之时，西洲百姓受到朱雀气息所引，迁火焰山山麓。火焰山山脉延绵千里，火灵灵气充盈，魔物惧朱雀气息而少至。
    百姓中能感火灵灵气者，依山而修，多年而成火灵修士。后众火灵修士入五行道盟，于㶦州境内设朱雀舵。平日，朱雀舵修士常于邻近各州设坛，收有仙缘者，传五行之术。坛中常燃火灵之焰，可助驱魔气。百姓有染邪祟者，予修士以灵石，可保性命。
    遂凡人休养生息，以人数之众，开疆拓土，沿山筑城，跨数州，而成陵光国。陵光下设天眼宗，收能感炁却修而不达者。经多年，天眼宗人众数千，善结百人阵法，开阵时能通天道之眼，陵光境内大小事物，尽收眼底。陵光依此阵所得情报，全境稳矣。
    后经千年，三洲修士因天道枷锁而修行受阻。修士苦平日修行，所缺灵石繁多。凡人望益寿延年，又需问道仙门。两者相辅相成，各取所需，相安无事。
    陵光因其安稳而闻名三洲，百姓慕名而来者众。更有甚者，自太山以西，三洲之外，翻山越岭而来。初始，西来者与三洲百姓言谈相貌均有大不同。经多年，各族交融，虽相貌仍有不同之处，然平日举止与三洲百姓无异矣。
    南宫生与其族人，皆为西来者。

Before the five elements cultivators gathered in the Five Elements Mountain to establish the alliance, the people of the West Continent were attracted by the QI of the Vermilion Bird, have come to the foothills of the Flaming Mountain. Flaming Mountain range stretches for thousands of miles, and is full of fire spirit Qi, the devils are afraid of the QI of the vermilion bird and do not dare to come to the Flaming Mountain.

The people who could sense the fire spirit qi settled at the foot of the Flaming Mountain and practiced for many years to become fire spirit cultivators. Later, the fire spirit cultivators joined the Five Elements Alliance and set up the Vermilion Bird Rudder in the Jinzhou. Usually, the Vermilion Bird rudder cultivators would set up altars in the neighboring states to recruit people with immortal destiny and pass on to them the skills of the five elements. The altars are always lit with the flame of fire spirits, which can help the people expel the demonic Qi. People who are infected with evil spirits can pay spirit stones to the fire spirit cultivators to save their lives.

Later the mortals recuperated, and with their numbers, they opened up the land and built cities along the Flaming Mountains. The cities were connected by roads across several states and gradually became the country of Lingguang. The Heaven's Eye Sect was established in the country to recruit people who could sense the Qi but did not reach the level of cultivation. After many years, the Heaven's Eye Sect has thousands of people, and is good at forming hundred-man formations, so that when the formations are opened, they can connect with the eyes of the Heavenly Path, so that they can see all the things in the territory of Lingguang. With the information of this formation, the administrators of Lingguang Country have kept the whole territory safe and secure.

After a thousand years, the cultivation of cultivators in the three continents was hindered by the shackles of the heavenly path. On the one hand, the cultivators are suffering from the lack of spiritual stones for their daily cultivation. On the other hand, the mortals want to live longer and need the help of the immortals. The two complemented each other, each take what they need, and everything remained peaceful.

Lingguang is famous for its peace and stability in the three continents, and many people come here with admiration. There were even some people from outside the three continents who came from the west side of Tai Mountain. These people who came over the mountains were called the Westerners. At the beginning, the westerners were very different from the people of the three continents in language and appearance. After many years, the westerners and the people of the three continents integrated, although there are still differences in appearance, but the language and behavior of the westerners are already very similar to the people of the three continents.

Nangong Sheng and his people are all Westerners.

弈仙六戊申年，传暗谷有修魔道者，窃巫格山牯藏谷衔月楼之蛊虫，以魔气染蛊，散于巫格山，妄破西洲炁局。蛊经巫格山，过妖族之地，向西至太山山麓，染生灵无数。彼时，不论仙凡皆闭门不出，燃焰自保。西洲生灵染蛊虫者，或化为魔物，或炁尽而亡。数月，西洲游魂众矣。魂众则朱雀出，徘徊西洲七日，蛊虫燃尽，众魂为其所引。
    其间，朱雀至火焰山近处。见西来者众露宿于此，似已殒命多时，魔气环绕。朱雀挥羽化炎燃之，魂皆出。欲飞，见一孩童尚有一息尚存，有魂相护，不为所燃。原为孩童双亲以魂护子，久不愿去。朱雀为其所感，以喙啄出孩童蛊虫，又注入原初火之灵气，孩童性命无忧矣。见子无忧，孩童双亲之魂归位，朱雀感其离别之苦而泣泪，泪坠孩童身侧鞠毬中，鞠毬熠熠生光。
    朱雀徘徊良久方离去，去时西洲魔气尽散。时朱雀舵舵主南宫炟感舵外火灵灵气充盈，出舵寻之，遁数百里，至西来者暂居之地，只见灰烬中有一孩童，怀抱鞠毬，炁若滔天之焰，直冲云霄。南宫炟甚奇，掐诀观之，见朱雀之气，感叹此孩童颇具仙缘，于此绝境竟能逢凶化吉。遂抱回舵中，取名南宫生。

YiXian calendar, six WuSheng year, there is a demonic cultivator of Dark Valley, who stole the Gu Insects from Guzang Valley of WuGe Mountain, he infected the Gu Insects with demonic Qi and spread the Gu Insects in WuGe Mountain, hoping to destroy the Qi pattern of the West Continent. The Gu Insects passed through the Wuge Mountain, crossed the land of the demons, and went west to the foothills of the Tai Mountain, infecting countless living beings. At that time, both immortals and mortals were locked down and kept their flames indoors to protect themselves. If the living beings in the West Continent were infected with Gu Insects, they would either turn into devils or die of exhaustion. After a few months, the West Continent is full of wandering souls, which attracted the attention of the Vermilion Bird. The Vermilion Bird wandered around the West Continent for seven days, burning out all the Gu Insects, and all the souls were drawn by the Vermilion Bird and returned to Tai Mountain.

During that time, the vermilion bird flew to the flame mountain near, saw a lot of westerners lying in the wild, seems to have died for a long time, and surrounded by demonic Qi. The Vermilion Bird waved its wings and burned them, and all the souls came out. Vermilion Bird wanted to fly away, suddenly saw a child still has a breath of life, because there are souls to protect him, he was not swallowed by the flame. It turns out that the child's parents to protect their son with their souls, unwilling to leave. The vermilion bird was touched by it and pecked out the child's Gu Insect with its beak, and injected the original fire spirit, so the child's life was safe. Seeing the child safe, the child's parents' soul slowly drifted to the vermilion bird, the vermilion bird felt the pain of parting and sobbed tears, tears fell into the ball next to the child, and the ball glittered.

Vermilion Bird wandered for a long time before leaving, when the vermilion bird left, the demonic Qi of the west continent scattered. At that time, the Master of the Vermilion Bird Rudder, Nangong Da, who sensed the fullness of the fire spirit outside the Rudder, so he went out of the Rudder to investigate. Nangong ran hundreds of miles, to the temporary residence of the Westerners, only to find a child lying in the ashes, embracing a ball, the child's Qi like a monstrous flame, straight to the clouds. Nangong was very surprised, used spells to strengthen his vision, and took a good look at the child, only to find that the child was full of vermilion bird's Qi. Nangong sighed that this child is quite fortunate, even in such desperate circumstances can be turned into good fortune. So he took the child back to the rudder and named him Nangong Sheng.

弈仙六戊申年，傳暗穀有修魔道者，竊巫格山牯藏穀銜月樓之蠱蟲，以魔氣染蠱，散於巫格山，妄破西洲炁局。 蠱經巫格山，過妖族之地，向西至太山山麓，染生靈無數。 彼時，不論仙凡皆閉門不出，燃焰自保。 西洲生靈染蠱蟲者，或化為魔物，或炁盡而亡。 數月，西洲遊魂眾矣。 魂眾則朱雀出，徘徊西洲七日，蠱蟲燃盡，眾魂為其所引。

    朱雀徘徊良久方離去，去時西洲魔氣盡散。 時朱雀舵舵主南宮炟感舵外火靈靈氣充盈，出舵尋之，遁數百里，至西來者暫居之地，只見灰燼中有一孩童，懷抱鞠毬，炁若滔天之焰，直沖雲霄。 南宮炟甚奇，掐訣觀之，見朱雀之氣，感歎此孩童頗具仙緣，於此絕境竟能逢凶化吉。 遂抱回舵中，取名南宮生。

论五行道盟修士中，五行印记所学之全者，非吾行之莫属也。然所学之精妙者，却无人出南宫生之右。有传南宫生四岁练炁，五岁而精通火灵印法，六岁反以其所学，授盟内众修士。
    然曰授法者，实为南宫生以朱砂涂鸦尔。前后仅数日，舵内大小墙围，门柱窗椅，皆有其画。所画之印匪夷所思，舵中修士初见时皆愕然，后静心参之，皆有所得。见舵内已无处可画，南宫生便于舵中大闹，灵气升腾之时，仅有舵主能施展手段安抚之。久之，每逢舵主闭关之时，南宫生常远遁陵光国各州。
    初至陵光国㶦州城，南宫生见城中朱雀玉像，只觉颇为亲近，便翻身而上，骑于玉像颈，如骑竹马一般，嬉笑耍闹好不自在。天眼宗闻讯而至，便要拿南宫生。只见数人施展手段拿其不中，南宫生飞身而下，拳脚齐出，打得天眼宗人众抱头而作鼠窜。少顷，又闯入城中学堂，唤来孩童数人，于城中集市生起篝火，绕篝火而舞。孩童嬉戏之声引来集市民众，众人见是先前伤天眼宗之孩童，皆惧之，不敢上前。至申时，南宫生只觉无甚趣味，昂首阔步出城而去。
    天眼宗派使者至朱雀舵诉南宫生所为，其言慷慨激昂，声泪俱下。舵主唤来南宫生，使者立即靦面相迎，眼含惶恐之色。只见那南宫生双目如炬，似要喷出火来，再瞧使者，早已夺门而出，不见身影。舵主见此状却未多加指责，仅和南宫生约法三章，其一不得伤凡人，其二不得助魔物，其三不得误修行，望其承正道之火，还须早开灵智，勿为阴火所噬。
    而后，南宫生于天眼宗不再拳脚相迎，平日多与各州孩童嬉戏。每至集市，散玩物于各户孩童，孩童皆喜之，以南宫生为王。南宫生与众孩童招摇过市，其势浩浩然。有见作奸犯科者，便原地捆之，戏弄一番，交于天眼宗。常此，坊间有童子谣曰，㶦州城，篝火起。烧天眼，骑玉像。拳为鞭，火为马。团团走，市集下。朱雀泪，碧眼娃。陵光国，小霸王。恶人忧，魔物愁。天道清，南宫归。

Among the cultivators of the Five Elements Alliance, Wu Xingzhi is the best to learn all the five elements of the seal. However, no one has learned more than Nangong Sheng in terms of sophistication. There is a rumor that Nangong Sheng was four years old to cultivate the Qi, and five years old to master the fire spirit seal method, and six years old to teach the Alliance's cultivators what he had learned.

However, instead of saying that Nangong Sheng is teaching other cultivators, it is better to say that Nangong Sheng is using vermilion powder to scribble randomly and other cultivators are just watching. In just a few days, the walls, doors, pillars, windows and chairs of the rudder were all covered with Nangong Sheng's graffiti. The seals painted by Nangong Sheng are unimaginable, and the cultivators in the rudder were stunned when they first saw them. But then the cultivators meditated on it and actually got something out of it. Seeing that there was nowhere else to draw in the rudder, Nangong Sheng began to make a fuss in the rudder, and when his Qi rises, only the rudder master can pacify him. Over time, whenever the rudder master is in seclusion, Nangong Sheng will escape to the states of the Lingguang Country for entertainment.

When he first arrived at Jinzhou City, Nangong Sheng saw the jade statue of the vermilion bird in the city and felt quite close to it, so he rolled over and rode on the neck of the jade statue, like riding a bamboo horse, laughing and joking around. The Heaven's Eye Sect heard the news and wanted to arrest Nangong Sheng. Several people from the Heaven's Eye Sect used tactics to catch Nangong Sheng but failed, Nangong Sheng flew down, with a combination of fists and kicks, beat the people of the Heaven's Eye Sect to hold their heads and make a flee. A short while later, Nangong Sheng broke into the city school, and called several children, they came to the city market to build a bonfire, and dance around the bonfire. The sound of the kids' play attracted the people of the market, but when they saw that it was the child who hurt the Heaven's Eye Sect earlier, they were all afraid and did not dare to come forward. At the time of Shen, Nangong Sheng began to feel bored, so he walked out of the city gates with his head held high and went elsewhere.

The Heaven's Eye Sect sent an messenger to the Vermilion Bird Rudder to complain about what Nangong Sheng had done, and his words were impassioned and tearful. The rudder master summoned Nangong Sheng, the messenger immediately with a shameful look to meet Nangong Sheng, while the eyes with a look of fear. Nangong Sheng eyes like a torch, seems to emit fire, he looked at the messenger, the messenger immediately seized the door and went away in a flash. The helmsman saw this situation but did not blame Nangong Sheng, only and Nangong Sheng about the three rules, one shall not hurt mortals, the second shall not help the devil, the third shall not miss practice. The rudder master hopes that Nangong Sheng to bear the fire of the righteousness, sooner open his spiritual wisdom, and do not be devoured by the Yin fire.

After that, Nangong Sheng no longer bully the people of the Heaven's Eye Sect, usually just play with the children of the states. Every time Nangong Sheng came to the market, he gave toys to the children of each family, and the children all liked it and called Nangong Sheng their king. Nangong Sheng and all the children waved through the market, looking very powerful. When they see a treacherous person, they will tie him up right where he is, and tease him a bit, then hand him over to the Heaven's Eye Sect. Some time later, there was a child rhyme in the community that said, Jinzhou city, bonfire up. Burning the eye of heaven, riding the jade statue. Fist for the whip, fire for the horse. Group walking, under the bazaar. Vermilion tear, blue-eyed children. Lingguang state, little overlord. Bad people worry, devils fear. The way of heaven is clear, the Nangong return.

Qi Wangyou, the young sect master of the Hundred Herbs Sect, also known as Xuanxuan. Legend says she grew up surrounded by flowers in her childhood, exuding a natural fragrance from her body. Her botanical knowledge was extraordinary.

In her youth, she encountered a golden ox spirit and serendipitously obtained the Five Elements Pure Vase. This mystical vase harmonized the five elements and contained a dimension within. Wangyou used it to collect flowers to cure her mother's depressive illness, store water to nourish plants, and gather Qi for cultivation. Later, she joined the Five Elements Alliance after rescuing the master of the Azure Dragon Rudder.

    幼時曾遇一金牛精，機緣之下得其五行凈瓶。此瓶五行調和，內蘊乾坤。忘憂以此瓶盛花而治其母郁疾，盛水以養百草，盛炁以修行。後因救青龍舵舵主而入五行道盟。

相传天魔之战前，各洲先天之炁充盈，降本流末，而生百草。生灵食百草而生智，渐可感天地灵气。彼时千年不夭渐得道者多，后历天魔之战，灵气稀魔气盛，百草凋敝，仙途荆棘。今灵植渐多为修士自养，又常寻三洲宝地而采撷。其中灵草盛者当数百草门。
    百草门初由苍州百姓所立。于苍州山林以西设院，占四方之地数百亩。东临五行道盟青龙舵，北有良州洛商会，仙凡多有走动，遂魔物少。其四面环山，谷深幽秀，雾屏掩翠，长风拂壑，修竹留云，清气不散，浊气流转。门中五季分明，春开百花不谢，夏结百果子鲜，秋收百谷丰穰，冬藏百药凝香。中有长夏润万物，清风宜人无剧暑。
    千年间，百草门门人集山中药材，又游而收各州珍奇，植于门内。其灵植品类之全，彼时为三洲之最矣。三洲不论仙凡，皆购灵植于百草门。而百草门门人修行则不似其他仙门。不研心法，只食草而修。虽未有寻常仙门之势，却强于凡人多矣。
    彼时百草门因其灵植之全而闻名三洲，而五行道盟之青龙舵同为苍州仙门，舵中弟子常习木灵法术，好灵植，为百草门名望所引，常至其境内修炼。然灵植金枝玉叶，易随四周灵气变化，有木灵灵气催之则易伤根基。遂百草门以损灵植为由而拒青龙舵弟子。青龙舵弟子亦愠百草门，责其占地夺利阻己修行。后二宗门多起争执，终于苍州山林间大战一场。此战延绵数里，有魔物为杀戮所引，冲入山林。三方相斗数日，至灵植尽毁，二宗弟子死伤众。后五行道盟总舵修士至，止戈驱魔，杀戮方止。此战后，二宗以山涧为界，互不相犯。
    近百年，百草门凋敝，灵植所藏大不如前，弟子之数锐减。每有魔物侵扰，皆苦于抵抗。休养生息多年，终不复当年之荣。后现任百草门门主娶妻生女，其妻感宗门之凋敝，忧小女今后所承复兴之重任，渐生郁疾，卧床不出。门主为小女取名忘忧，小字萱萱，望其如萱草，常伴左右以解母之郁疾。

According to legend, before the Battle of the Immortals and Evils, the Innate Air flowed abundantly across the continents. From its essence sprang the Hundred Herbs, nourishing all living beings. Consuming these herbs granted sentience, allowing creatures to attune to the spiritual Qi of heaven and earth. In that era, countless beings cultivated the Dao over millennia without perishing. Yet after the Battle of the Immortals and Evils, spiritual Qi waned while demonic Qi surged. The Hundred Herbs withered, and the path to immortality grew treacherous. Today, most spirit plants are cultivated by cultivators or harvested from rare sanctuaries across the Three Continents. Among them, the Hundred Herbs Sect reigns supreme in nurturing spiritual herbs.

Founded by the common folk of Cangzhou, the Hundred Herbs Sect established its courtyard west of the mountain forests, spanning hundreds of acres. Bordered to the east by the Azure Dragon Rudder of the Five Elements Alliance and to the north by Luo Chamber of Commerce of Liangzhou, its proximity to both immortal and mortal realms kept demonic threats at bay. Nestled among mist-shrouded peaks, deep valleys, and bamboo groves cradling drifting clouds, the sect’s lands were blessed with pure, untainted Qi. Five distinct seasons graced the sect: eternal spring blooms, summer’s bountiful fruits, autumn’s golden harvests, winter’s medicinal fragrances, and a “long summer” of gentle breezes nurturing all life.

Over millennia, disciples gathered rare herbs from mountains and distant lands, cultivating them within the sect. Its collection of spirit plants once surpassed all others in the Three Continents, supplying both immortals and mortals alike. Unlike conventional sects, the Hundred Herbs Sect’s disciples cultivated not through esoteric arts but by ingesting herbs. Though lacking the martial prowess of typical immortal sects, their strength far surpassed ordinary humans.

Renowned for its spiritual herbs, the sect drew disciples from the Azure Dragon Rudder of the Five Elements Alliance, who practiced Wood Spirit spells and sought rare plants. However, the delicate spirit plants suffered under the volatile wood Spirit of their cultivation, prompting the sect to bar the Azure Dragon disciples. Resentment brewed, with each side accusing the other of greed and obstruction. Tensions erupted into a bloody clash across Cangzhou’s mountains, drawing demonic hordes to the carnage. After days of slaughter, the Five Elements Alliance’s central envoys intervened, quelling the conflict. The sects established a mountain stream as their boundary, vowing eternal non-aggression.

In recent centuries, the Hundred Herbs Sect declined. Its spirit plant reserves dwindled, disciples grew scarce, and demonic incursions battered its weakened defenses. Decades of recovery failed to restore its former glory. The current sect master, after marrying and fathering a daughter, watched his wife succumb to despair over the sect’s fate and their child’s burdened future. Bedridden with melancholy, she inspired her husband to name their daughter Wangyou (“Forget Worries”), with the childhood name Xuanxuan—hoping she grow like daylilies (xuancao) to ease her mother’s anguish.

祁忘忧幼时，常行于山林间，采百花，植于其母院中，愿花景可解母之郁疾。此后不论日月轮转，春夏交替，院中皆有花开争艳。积数载，繁花乱目不可穷尽也。忘忧自幼有百花相伴，传言其遍体生香，近嗅之如临百花群中。后忘忧见其母喜花，遂常出百草门，图寻便天下之花以解母之疾。然其父以其年幼，不允其出苍州山林而游。
    一日，忘忧于苍州山林间采花，见溪中有一金牛精徘徊。那金牛精身着龙鳞甲，肩披火焰袍，腰挂宝瓶，威风凛凛，不似魔物。金牛见忘忧走近，便摇首摆尾上前嗅之，闻其气如灵植，张口欲啖之。忘忧惊，大哭。
    刹那，忽地生藤蔓，绕于金牛精周身，使其不得动弹。金牛精挣扎之下，腰间玉瓶落地。忘忧怀抱宝瓶而拒金牛精，泪洒宝瓶，而宝瓶忽熠熠生光，似认主一般，悬空护于忘忧身前，瓶口自旋，对向金牛精，似要将其纳入瓶中。金牛精惧，使蛮力挣脱藤蔓，凌空化作青烟消失不见。此时忘忧再瞧那宝瓶，却与寻常宝瓶无甚区别。
    过片刻，忘忧稳定心神，隐得听见对岸有修士伏地呻吟，似受重伤。遂忘忧握宝瓶盛水，越界过去，使修士饮之。修士饮罢，还不及答谢，便昏厥过去。而忘忧此时方知，先前是此修士施木灵法术相救。忘忧不胜感激，查其有伤，就近采了熟识之灵草，敷其创口。又以幼小身躯拖修士至青龙舵近处。此时天时已晚，忘忧以石叩门，躲于远处，见青龙舵弟子抬修士入舵内，方放下心来，欣然而归。
    后忘忧采花，以宝瓶盛之。置于母房内，不出数日，其母郁疾竟愈。门主又惊又喜，不明其理，书信请丹鼎峰查之。鹤老闻讯差丹歌前来，丹歌查良久，终见宝瓶。丹歌道，此瓶内蕴五行，可调和万物得清净，能容纳天地定乾坤，必是仙家之物。又道，以此瓶盛花，凡人嗅来，五行调和，自是郁疾即除。众人皆叹忘忧之造化，然众人执瓶一试却无甚反应，似此瓶认主一般，仅听忘忧差遣。
    后忘忧以此五行净瓶之水养百草，五行调和，门中百草渐旺。又遣门人三洲寻灵草，使灵草种类日增。遂只数载，百草门重焕生机。

In her childhood, Qi Wangyou often wandered the mountain forests, gathering flowers to plant in her mother’s courtyard, hoping the floral beauty might ease her mother’s melancholic illness. Over the years, no matter the season, the courtyard remained ablaze with never-fading blooms. By the time Wangyou grew older, the flowers had multiplied into an overwhelming kaleidoscope. Legends say her body carried a natural fragrance, as if she were perpetually bathed in a garden’s essence. Noticing her mother’s joy in the flowers, Wangyou began venturing beyond the Hundred Herbs Sect, determined to scour the world for rare blooms to cure her mother. Yet her father, fearing for her safety, forbade her from leaving Cangzhou’s mountains.

One day, while gathering flowers, Wangyou spotted a golden ox spirit lingering by a stream. Clad in dragon-scale armor, draped in a fiery mantle, and bearing a jade vase at its waist, the creature radiated majesty, unlike any devil. As Wangyou approached, the ox sniffed her curiously, drawn by her plant-like aura, then lunged to devour her. Terrified, she burst into tears.

Suddenly, vines erupted from the earth, binding the ox spirit. In its thrashing, the jade vase at its waist fell. Wangyou snatched the vase and held it protectively as tears splashed onto its inside. The vase erupted in radiant light, hovering before her like a loyal guardian. Its opening spun toward the ox, threatening to suck the beast inside. Panicked, the ox shattered the vines with brute force and vanished into smoke. The vase then dimmed, appearing ordinary once more.

Moments later, Wangyou heard groans across the stream—a wounded cultivator lay collapsed. Filling the vase with water, she crossed to offer him a drink. Before he could thank her, he fainted. Realizing he had cast the vine spell to save her, Wangyou gathered herbs to dress his wounds and dragged his limp form toward the Azure Dragon Rudder. At dusk, she knocked on their gate with a stone and hid, watching as disciples carried him inside before slipping home, relieved.

Later, Wangyou placed flowers from the vase in her mother’s room. Within days, her mother’s illness vanished. The sect master, astonished, sought answers from the Danding Peak. Elder Crane dispatched Dan Ge to investigate. After studying the vase, Dan Ge declared it a celestial artifact—the Five Elements Pure Vase—capable of harmonizing the five elements and purifying all things. Flowers stored within it cured melancholy by balancing one’s Qi. Yet when others tried using it, the vase lay inert, obeying only Wangyou.

Using the vase’s water to nourish herbs, Wangyou revitalized the sect’s gardens. Disciples scoured the Three Continents for rare plants, expanding their collection. Within years, the Hundred Herbs Sect flourished anew.

五行道盟青龙舵有传，常在山涧之界见一少女，手执宝瓶，浇灌百草，其所到之处，木灵灵气充盈，随其而修事半功倍。
    遂于百草门与青龙舵之界可见奇景，是一众修士不做功课，专至两派边界，随一女娃徘徊良久。而祁忘忧不以为意，更是越界而同青龙舵修士辩经。忘忧曰，万物生长自然也，何故设界阻其生长。又责众修士功法不精，以致损草木生长。后于忘忧指导之下，众修士竟觉长久所修之功法融会贯通，更感木灵气息。众修士甚奇，问忘忧从何得知青龙舵法门，忘忧只答，并无他法，通晓百草尔。
    后众修士报于青龙舵舵主。舵主至，愠忘忧越界多时，坏祖宗之规，便差人诉之于百草门门主。门主亦至，怒一众修士竟为难其女。双方于山涧两岸对质，似又有一战在弦，顷刻即发。而忘忧见此景，亦愠，责双方有背自然，竟有再兴兵戈之意。情急之下垂泪，泪落五行净瓶之中而掀起波澜。有雨自瓶口而出，洒四方修士。修士受雨，怒气渐消。此时青龙舵舵主见宝瓶，忆起那日与金牛精死战，身受重伤，好在此女娃机缘下夺了宝瓶，退了那精怪，这才逃过一劫。忙喝退弟子，上前拜谢祁忘忧救命之恩。忘忧亦回谢其解围之谊。
    以此为契。百草门门主与青龙舵舵主相约长谈，二人约定消去此前边界，摒弃前仇。青龙舵助百草门研习心法，而百草门助青龙舵了然草木。祁忘忧则拜入青龙舵门下，由舵主亲传功法。

Rumors spread through the Azure Dragon Rudder of the Five Elements Alliance: a girl often appeared along the mountain stream boundary, wielding a mystical vase to water plants. Wherever she walked, Wood Spiritual Qi flourished, amplifying the efficacy of cultivation. 

Soon, a peculiar sight emerged at the border—cultivators from both sects abandoned their duties to trail the girl. Qi Wangyou paid them no mind, even crossing into the Azure Dragon Rudder territory to debate cultivation philosophies. “All life thrives in nature. Why set boundaries to stifle their growth?” she chided, rebuking the disciples for their crude techniques that harmed plants. Under her guidance, they found their stagnant practices suddenly coalescing, their connection to Wood Spirit deepening. Astonished, they demanded to know how she understood their sect’s methods. Wangyou simply replied, “There’s no secret—I merely understand the herbs.”

When the disciples reported this to the Azure Dragon Master, he stormed to the border, furious at Wangyou’s defiance of ancestral rules, and summoned the Hundred Herbs Sect Master. The sect master arrived in a rage, accusing the Azure Dragon disciples of harassing his daughter. As tensions flared between the factions, Wangyou intervened, scolding both sides for betraying the natural order. Tears streaming down her face, she clutched the Five Elements Pure Vase. Her tears splashed into the vase, stirring ripples that summoned rain from its mouth, drenching the cultivators. The drizzle quelled their fury. Suddenly, the Azure Dragon Master recognized the vase. Memories flooded back: his near-fatal battle against the golden ox spirit, the child who had seized the artifact and driven the monster away, saving his life. Humbled, he dismissed his disciples and bowed deeply to Wangyou, thanking her for his survival. Wangyou, in turn, thanked him for defusing the conflict.

Seizing this truce, the two leaders abolished the mountain stream boundary and buried their feud. The Azure Dragon Rudder pledged to teach the Hundred Herbs Sect cultivation techniques, while the sect shared its botanical wisdom in return. Wangyou, now formally apprenticed to the Azure Dragon Master, began training under his guidance—a bridge between two worlds.

    遂於百草門與青龍舵之界可見奇景，是一眾修士不做功課，專至兩派邊界，隨一女娃徘徊良久。而祁忘憂不以為意，更是越界而同青龍舵修士辯經。忘憂曰，萬物生長自然也，何故設界阻其生長。又責眾修士功法不精，以致損草木生長。後於忘憂指導之下，眾修士竟覺長久所修之功法融會貫通，更感木靈氣息。眾修士甚奇，問忘憂從何得知青龍舵法門，忘憂只答，並無他法，通曉百草爾。
    後眾修士報於青龍舵舵主。舵主至，慍忘憂越界多時，壞祖宗之規，便差人訴之於百草門門主。門主亦至，怒一眾修士竟為難其女。雙方於山澗兩岸對質，似又有一戰在弦，頃刻即發。而忘憂見此景，亦慍，責雙方有背自然，竟有再興兵戈之意。情急之下垂淚，淚落五行凈瓶之中而掀起波瀾。有雨自瓶口而出，灑四方修士。修士受雨，怒氣漸消。此時青龍舵舵主見寶瓶，憶起那日與金牛精死戰，身受重傷，好在此女娃機緣下奪了寶瓶，退了那精怪，這才逃過一劫。忙喝退弟子，上前拜謝祁忘憂救命之恩。忘憂亦回謝其解圍之誼。
    以此為契。百草門門主與青龍舵舵主相約長談，二人約定消去此前邊界，摒棄前仇。青龍舵助百草門研習心法，而百草門助青龍舵了然草木。祁忘憂則拜入青龍舵門下，由舵主親傳功法。

北洲上古蛮荒之时，各部族与妖兽偶有争端，却也相安无事。过数甲子，魔气南侵，魔物肆虐，战乱不止，流民人众。后有北风军遣移山营沿山脉设关，关卡连绵万里不绝，每逢魔物越关卡来袭，北风军皆联合三洲各仙门共击之，北洲始安。
    近数年，魔气南侵日益，军心散乱，流民又起。今有流民夫妇二人，怀抱初生婴孩南迁，途遇窃贼，盘缠干粮皆被盗去。时逢九冬，天寒地冻，饥寒交迫，见怀中婴孩日渐虚弱，父母恐其夭于南迁途中。过三日，夫妇二人行至玄铁山近郊，见铁骨门镖队押货至，二人求镖头收下婴孩，以换得物资南迁。镖头不允。是夜，夫妻二人尾随镖队，见其队尾所运杂物看管松懈，遂悄潜至货篓边，以婴孩换取粗布一匹，后向南遁去。
    镖队至锻玄宗。清点货物之时，众人听得杂物中传来阵阵啼哭声。仔细一瞧，竟是那夫妇所抱婴孩，镖头报知普照洞贞正洞主，洞主见后摆手，差弟子先收婴孩于库房，命镖队翌日押其回芦雪城，另寻收养。
    翌日辰时，众人至仓库查看婴孩，大惊。只见婴孩身披破布，肚皮滚圆，于仓库正中仰面朝天，呃声连连，再看四周，丹药灵草已被其吃了七八。那婴孩此时灵气灌顶，笑盈盈看向众人，小嘴吮指不放。贞正洞主大呼着道，又不舍丹药灵草白白浪费，无奈收下婴孩，却不知其父母姓氏，因其身披粗布，只以小布唤之。

North continent in the ancient barbaric time, the tribes and demonic beasts are occasionally disputes, and yet remain peaceful. After a few years, the demonic Qi invaded the south, the demonic creatures ravaged the continent, and there were wars and chaos, resulting in a large number of displaced people. After that, the North Wind Army dispatched the Mountain Moving Camp to set up walls along the mountain ranges, and the walls stretched for thousands of miles, and whenever the devils attacked over the walls, the North Wind Army would unite with the Immortal Sects of the three continents to fight against them, and the North Continent was then at peace.

In recent years, the devil has been invading the south increasingly, and the army has been scattered, and the displaced people have risen again. One day, a couple of displaced persons, carrying their newborn baby, moved south, and encountered thieves on the way, and all their food and belongings were stolen. It was the coldest winter in the year, and the parents were afraid that the baby in their arms was getting weaker and weaker, and that the baby would die on the way to the south. After three days, the couple traveled to the outskirts of Xuan Tie Mountain, see the Iron Bone Sect dart team escorted the goods arrived, the two begged the head of the dart to accept the baby, in exchange for supplies to move south. The head of the dart team did not agree. That night, the husband and wife followed the dart team, see the end of the team carried miscellaneous goods with loose guard, so they quietly sneaked to the side of the goods basket, exchange the baby for a piece of coarse cloth, and then disappeared to the south.

The dart team arrived at the Duan Xuan Sect. When counting the goods, the people heard a burst of cries coming from the miscellaneous goods. At a closer look, it was the baby held by the couple. The head of the dart team reported to the master Zhenzheng of Puzhao Cave, who waved his hand and sent disciples to collect the baby in the treasury first and ordered the dart team to return to Lu Xue City the next day to find another family to adopt the baby.

小布因偷食丹药灵草开了灵智，为贞正洞主收入门下。历来锻玄宗收徒，弟子需徒手在其师尊洞府之中，开山碎石，砸一洞穴，方为入门，日后皆于洞穴内修行。小布年幼，灵智初开，岂能撼动玄铁山磐石。贞正洞主只得将其安置在宗门库房。平日洞主只带小布查阅账目，于门中行走探望弟子起居，却不教小布修行之法，遂小布渐成门中无洞府无修为之异类。
