    后锻玄宗弟子间有传，入门弟子有三大难者，其一为以体魄开石筑居，其二为以魂魄参玄苦修，其三为以凡胎常忍饥寒。其一难二难自是锻玄宗修炼之根基，而其三难却是人祸。原是小布当权之后，于弟子吃穿用度所算甚精，每予弟子物资不多不少，将将够用。然锻玄宗弟子锻炼体魄者众，初入门者消耗更甚，常饥肠辘辘，难耐玄铁山严寒。凡有弟子至库房讨要吃食者，皆被小布以物资耗尽为由尽数赶走。后有弟子见小布于库房内偷食仙品，疑其中饱私囊。弟子告于贞正洞主，洞主只言小布天资聪慧，物资分配公允，却也不管，遂此事作罢。
    小布入门虽晚，修为尚浅，却能以年幼之躯分担贞正洞主之职。积年，小布变其本而加厉，各洞除尘，弟子修行切磋，皆管之，专横跋扈，要求甚高。弟子初时见被一小娃管教，是哭不得也笑不得，皆有不服。然过数年，多数弟子竟觉修为有所精进，始对小布另眼相看。

Xiao Bu stole the elixir and grass to enlighten her spirit, and was adopted by the Zhenzheng master. Historically, when a disciple is accepted by Duan Xuan Sect, the disciple needs to smash a cave with their bare hands in the middle of their master's cave, and only then will they be accepted as a disciple, and they will be practicing in their own cave in the future. The Xiao Bu is young and her Qi is just developing, so she can't smash the rock of Xuan Tie Mountain. Master Zhengzheng could only place Xiao Bu in the sect's treasury. Usually master Zhenzheng only take Xiao Bu to check the financial records, walking around the sect to look after the disciples, but do not teach Xiao Bu cultivation method, so Xiao Bu gradually become an abnormal cultivator in the sect with no cave and no cultivation.

In a few years, master Zhenzheng thought Xiao Bu is older and she has enough knowledge to assume the responsibility, so he handed over all the rights of the treasury to Xiao Bu. Master Zhenzheng himself in the cave all day long to cultivate, no longer ask more about the affairs of the sect.

Later, the Duan Xuan Sect disciples have rumors that there are three major difficulties for entry-level disciples, one of which is to break open the stone and build a residence with one's bare hands, two of which is to cultivate with one's soul to learn about Xuan, and three of which is to endure the hunger and cold with one's mortal flesh. The first and second difficulties are the foundation of Duan Xuan Sect's cultivation, while the third difficulty is a man-made disaster. It turns out that since Xiao Bu was in power, was very precise in calculating the food and clothing for the disciples, each disciple was given supplies not more or less, but enough to go around. However, the Duan Xuan Sect has a large number of disciples who exercise their physical fitness, and those who are new to the sect consume even more, so they are often hungry and find it difficult to endure the cold of Xuan Tie Mountain. Whenever a disciple goes to the treasury to ask for food, he will be driven away by Xiao Bu on the grounds that all supplies are exhausted. Later, a disciple saw Xiao Bu eating the immortal food in the treasury and suspected that she stole the food for her own use. The disciple reported to master Zhengzheng, but the master only said that Xiao Bu was talented and intelligent, and that the distribution of goods was fair, and he did not care about it, so the dispute was closed.

Although Xiao Bu started late and her cultivation was still shallow, she was able to share the responsibility of master Zhaozheng with her young age. Over the years, Xiao Bu become more aggressive, bossy and demanding, the health of the caves, disciple practice, she is in charge of them all. When the disciples first saw being disciplined by a small child, they neither cried nor laughed, and all of them were unconvinced. However, after a few years, most of the disciples realized that their cultivation had been improved, and they began to look at Xiao Bu in a different perspective.

远观北洲玄铁山，山峰高耸，直指苍穹，岩壁玄黑，坚硬无比，又有茫茫白雪相伴，清浊相混，灵气充盈。自南北向山而行，只见玄铁山向东西分为双峰，峰间陡峭成峡，似上仙神掌相劈而成。山下多矿脉，产灵石众多。锻玄宗立宗于双峰内，灵石可谓取之不尽用之不竭。然灵石虽多，山中却少生植被，锻玄宗门人又皆尊掌门之命，常年闭门不出一心苦修，吃穿用度需由凡人走镖由芦雪城运来。凡人走镖，运力有限，加之北洲近年纷乱，宗门所得物资锐减，与其他仙门相比，竟显得穷困潦倒。

    旁人卻不知，小布常使這自在烏兔爐，修行起來事半而功倍。幾年間，小布於性命修行皆有所得，出手起來靈煙相伴可化拳腳，令人防不勝防，遠超尋常弟子。有此法器傍身，小布於鍛玄宗可只手遮天矣。

北洲从军人众，百姓多尚武。北风军于芦雪城内设散云营，收百姓中愿从军者。散云营下擂台，胜者按其勇，下可任伍长，上可任曲长。屠馗自幼好斗，身形比之同龄者长二尺有余，同龄者皆不敢近其身，遂屠馗常寻长辈切磋。至屠馗弱冠之年，身高八尺，拳大如砵，力敌千钧，擂台上已无敌手。北风军欲招屠馗为曲长，屠馗不从。见城中无敌手，屠馗又常出城北行寻猛兽精怪相搏，竟不落下风。铁骨门掌柜得知屠馗之勇，欲邀为镖头，屠馗不从，只偶助其运镖而换些吃食。
    一日屠馗随镖进玄铁山，至中心道场，见锻玄宗门人身强体壮者之多，属平生罕见。屠馗招手唤来一修士便要切磋，那锻玄宗弟子见屠馗好生无礼，踏出罡步闪至屠馗身后，提起其衣襟，随手一甩，便将屠馗甩出中心道场，沿山道滚下数丈方止。屠馗先是又惊又怒，转而又喜，惊在一招便被那修士所制实乃平生第一回，怒在这滚了一路浑身吃痛，而转喜，却因经此一摔，自己长久来所寻之道，于今日算是寻着。遂屠馗跛蹇而返，大呼愿择至勇之洞主奉为仙师。锻玄宗弟子们一听，纷纷咂舌攒眉，责其狂妄。然亨通洞主闻讯而至，观其为良才，于其行更是赞赏有加，欣然收为弟子。
    遂屠馗入锻玄宗，举开洞府之典。寻常弟子开洞府，以肉体凡胎能开六尺见方之洞为荣。屠馗开洞府，拳声十日不断，所砸之洞，十倍于寻常弟子，实乃宗门新开洞府之最。三十六洞各洞主见屠馗双拳殷红，皮开肉绽却面有大喜之色，皆赞曰，屠馗之勇极矣。

Tu Kui like to fight since childhood, his body shape is more than two feet longer than his peers, his peers do not dare to get close to him, so Tu Kui often look for elders to fight. Tu Kui was first shocked and angry, and then happy, he was shocked at it's the first time in his life that he was restrained by other with only one move, and he was angry at the pain of rolling all the way down the mountain, but he was happy because after this fall, after a long time of searching for his own way, he is considered to have found the way today. The masters of the 36 holes saw Tu Kui's fists, skin and flesh covered by blood, but his face looks joyful, so they said, Tu Kui's courage is not comparable.

    周身輕靈，氣蕩神斂，拳身圓滿，腰馬合一，意專神聚，攻敵立斷，虛實變幻，一炁貫串。
    一拳牙關挫，二拳天靈爛，三拳太山盡，四拳滄海分，五拳門關破，六拳幽冥散，七拳虛空碎，八拳萬象攏，九拳玉清開，十拳陽神降......

宗门中有传，阳神者，盖一炁从虚中结就也，此神聚则成形，散则成炁。达者可弃壳而游，不出洞府而游遍三洲。然阳神洞乃至宗门上下，无可达者，修为至高如亨通洞主者亦仅散炁傍身，更难谈弃壳而游三洲。
    修此道者，主心无旁骛，冥心悟玄。好斗者如屠馗，弟子皆评其戾气深重，难以冥心，恐不日走火入魔。寻常修者听此恶言，吐纳间便可化解，而屠馗听之，却是怒从肝起，周身泛红，誓要与饶舌者一决生死。常此，弟子见其多绕道而行，生怕多言一句，便遭其拳脚相加。
    后小布有传，屠馗不胜酒力，凡人杯中之物还则罢了，仙家之酒一闻便醉，凡喝上一口，须臾便倒。原是那仙家之酒，寻常修者饮罢可活血顺炁，而屠馗一饮，血炁乱窜，直冲天灵，任是再强体魄亦无可奈何。故后来弟子见屠馗闹事，常以仙酒泼之，泼中即倒，屠馗叫苦不迭。
    受仙酒所制，屠馗只得收敛戾气，平日又无他喜好，便一心习武。遂阳神未成，却悟玄道，论冥心之甚，已近亨通洞主。后经数年，屠馗历战无数，拳法通达，可散炁于四周，色殷红，如热血所化。出拳时，脚踏八方，擤炁而发，其声若惊雷，其势如烈火，有殷红之炁傍身，常俞战俞劲，势无穷尽也。是故通达大道之法千万，能者择适己者而修。

In the sect, there are stories saying that the Yang Shen, is a Qi condensed from the void, this Yang Shen can be shaped when it is gathered, and become Qi when it is dispersed. Those who achieve it can abandon their shells and travel all over the three continents without leaving the cave. However, there is no one who can achieve the level of Yang Shen, nether the cultivators of Yangshen Cave nor cultivators from other caves. Even as high level as the masters Hengtong can only spread his Qi around himself, so it is even more difficult for them to talk about abandoning their shells and traveling to the three continents.

Those who practise in this way should be free from distractions and should meditate to realize the mysteries of the universe. Aggressive people such as Tu Kui, the disciples all commented that he was so hostile that it was difficult to meditate on his mind, and they were afraid that he would go to the devil in the future. Ordinary cultivators listen to this bad words, can be resolved between exhalations, but when Tu Kui listen to it, his anger rose from the liver, and his body flushed red, and he vowed to fight with the person who spoke nonsense to the death. In this case, the disciples usually avoid Tu Kui because they are afraid that if they say one more word, they will be punched and kicked by him.

Later, Xiao Bu spread the words, Tu Kui is not good at drinking, if he just drink the wine of the mortals is still a simple matter, but if he smells the wine of the Immortals, he will be drunk immediately, and if he drinks a mouthful of it, he will fall down in a second. It turns out that the wine of the immortal can help ordinary cultivators with their blood and Qi circulation, but when Tu Kui drinks, his blood and Qi are in chaos, and they will rushes to the head of Tu kui immediately, even if he has a strong body, he will not be able to do anything about it. Therefore, later if disciples see Tu Kui making trouble, they will splash him with immortal wine, and Tu Kui will fall down when he is splashed, so he often complains about his suffering.

Restrained by the immortal wine, Tu Kui only had to restrain his hostility, and he had no other preferences in his spare time, so he concentrated on practicing martial arts. As a result, he was not empowered by the Yang Shen, but realized the way of Xuan, and was close to the master Hengtong in terms of the depth of his meditative mind. After a few years, through countless battles, Tu Kui's fist technique reached a master level. When he was fighting, he could disperse his Qi in the surrounding area, and the color was crimson, as if it was transformed from hot blood. When Tu Kui punches, his feet step on the eight directions, and breathe Qi quickly to move, its sound like thunder, its momentum like fire, there is red Qi beside his body, the longer he fights the stronger he becomes, the momentum is infinite. Therefore, there are millions of ways to reach the Great Dao, and those who are able to do so should choose the one who is suitable for them and practice.

Ye Mingming escaped to Duan Xuan Sect with her natural strength and was accepted as a disciple by the master of ChanGuang Cave, Lihe.

After the death of Master Lihe, Ye Mingming's temperament changed drastically, and she went into madness, and was shunned by her fellow disciples. Ye inherited a set of practice method of restraining the toadlight from the Master Lihe, and her Agility is one of the best in the Sect.

锻玄宗内有传，每月圆之时，常闻蟾光洞有夜歌者，其声幽婉，其意悲切，能摄人心魂，常听者易癫狂。
    歌曰：
    芦雪城郊梦泽乡，叶家冥冥女娇郎。
    春风吹晚初长成，却随父亲锄地荒。
    寻常红袖劳女工，冥冥渔樵耕读忙。
    待女长至碧玉年，孔武有力败儿郎。
    城中员外垂涎久，黄金玉石予红娘。
    爷娘本是苦命人，此去城中富贵昂。
    冥冥只求自在身，怎奈寒苦枉断肠。
    屠鸡宰鹅压箱底，他日深院难出巷。
    淅淅沥沥落秋雨，泼泼洒洒泪满裳。
    金锣喧天唢呐鸣，恶婿行前马上狂。
    道边惊雷腥风举，魑魅魍魉无所藏。
    冲入喧闹迎亲曲，啖骨食髓小命丧。
    冥冥见亲双殒命，金银掷鬼掌毙狼。
    残躯夜行遇玄山，哭叩山门无人响。
    悲怒饥寒心弦断，覆身白雪染红妆。
    造化至此缘分起，门开雪停沐蟾光。

It is rumored within the Duan Xuan Sect that at the time of the monthly round, it is often heard that there is a night song in the Changuang Cave, and its sound is elegant and its intention is sad, which can take in people's hearts and souls, and the people who listen to it are prone to insanity.

The song said:
In the outskirts of Lu Xue City, in the dreamy village of Mèng Zé,
Lived Yè Míngmíng, the lone daughter of the Yè family.
Blossoming with the spring breeze, she grew into a maiden fair,
Yet toiled alongside her father, tilling the barren land with care.

Her red sleeves, once ordinary, now labored day and night,
Fishing, chopping wood, and tending crops, her hands never idle.
As she matured into a jade-like woman, strength and skill her might,
Defeating suitors in martial prowess, her spirit fierce and vital.

Within the city, the wealthy outsider had long coveted her grace,
Offering gold and precious gems to claim her as his bride.
But her parents, fated to hardship, sought a different place,
To the opulence of the city, they embarked, side by side.

Yè Míngmíng yearned for freedom, not riches or grandeur,
Yet fate twisted cruelly, breaking her heart in vain.
Hidden away like slaughtered birds, locked in a dark drawer,
Her future confined to the courtyard, a life of silent pain.

Autumn rain fell incessantly, a melancholy serenade,
The clanging gongs and blaring horns announced her ill-fated groom.
Amidst thunder and tempest, shadows of demons played,
The wedding procession turned tragic, sealing her doom.

Her parents lay slain, victims of that treacherous night,
Their silver and gold tossed into the grasp of malevolent hands.
Alone, she fled through moonlit forests, seeking refuge in flight,
Until the gates of the mysterious Duàn Xuán opened, where destiny stands.

No answer echoed from the mountain gate, no guardian in sight,
Her grief and hunger gnawed at her, her spirit nearly undone.
Covered in snow, her once crimson robes now ghostly white,
Yet the moonlight paused, bathing her in the glow of the moon and sun.

Thus, her fate intertwined with the moon's gentle beam,
As the gates swung open, revealing the Chán Guāng Cave's light.
Within its depths, she found solace, a refuge from life's extreme,
And the snow ceased to fall, touched by the moon's benevolent might.

    春風吹晚初長成，卻隨父親鋤地荒。
    尋常紅袖勞女工，冥冥漁樵耕讀忙。

    屠雞宰鵝壓箱底，他日深院難出巷。
    淅淅瀝瀝落秋雨，潑潑灑灑淚滿裳。

    道邊驚雷腥風舉，魑魅魍魎無所藏。
    沖入喧鬧迎親曲，啖骨食髓小命喪。
    冥冥見親雙殞命，金銀擲鬼掌斃狼。
    殘軀夜行遇玄山，哭叩山門無人響。

却说那叶冥冥机缘之下误闯锻玄宗，为蟾光洞利和洞主收留。初至宗门，冥冥闭关不出一月有余，有传其手足尽断，神志受损，遂日哭夜嚎，常泪尽而泣血。利和洞主怜之，重塑其身躯，并暂封其三尸，以炁护肺，遂冥冥过鬼门而性命无碍。
    出关后，弟子间传叶冥冥已入疯魔，初无人敢近。过数月，冥冥始与众人交谈，众人见其容月眉云髻，花颊娇面，其声悠扬婉转，娓娓动听，又常笑意盈盈，谈吐温雅，遂众人渐觉心安。而冥冥潜心修行，有先天神力作基石，修为大进，渐超凡人多矣。
    然月盈则亏，人满则损。冥冥修行数年后，蟾光洞利和洞主修为进无所进。感自身年事已高，阳寿将尽，利和洞主唤来冥冥，将毕生所悟口传耳受于冥冥，而后撒手人寰。
    师尊已逝，冥冥感茫茫三洲，竟无一人可依，又起哀思。加之师尊仙逝，三尸封印破除，一时百般情绪如夜之幽冥，笼罩冥冥全身，避无可避。遂冥冥再入疯魔，暴起之时宗门上下现天翻地覆之景，后经各洞长老奋力相阻，方得安宁。
    而后冥冥闭关数月，出时披头散发，眸边泣血，再与人交谈，稍有不合意者，利爪便至，身法之快，门内弟子看来亦匪夷所思。如此相处多时，有好事者传，其性情随月而变，月盈则高昂，月缺则低沉，若有事相求，切记避开月盈之时。至于白日，冥冥常闭关，更是难得一见。

Ye Mingming was taken in by the master of Changuang Cave, Li He, who had mistakenly entered the Duan Xuan Sect by chance. When she first entered the sect, Mingming shut herself up for more than a month, and it was rumored that her arms and legs were broken and her mind was damaged, so she cried day and night, often weeping blood with her tears. The Master Lihe took pity on her, remodeled her body and temporarily sealed her sān shī, protecting her lungs with qi, so that Mingming passed through the door of death without any obstacles to her life.

After the shutdown, it was rumored among the disciples that Ye Mingming had gone crazy, and no one dared to get close to her at the beginning. After a few months, Mingming began to talk to the others, and they saw her moon eyebrow and cloud bun, flower cheeks and delicate face, listened to her melodious and melodious voice, and she often smiled and talked in a gentle manner, so the people gradually felt at ease. Mingming practiced with dedication, and with her innate divine power as the cornerstone, her cultivation improved greatly, gradually surpassing the ordinary people.

However, when the moon is waxes, it wanes, and when a man is fulfilled, he will be lost. After a few years of meditation, the master of Changuang Cave, Lihe, could not make any progress in her cultivation. Sensing that she was getting old and her life was about to be over, the Master Lihe summoned Mingming and passed her life's knowledge from mouth to ear, and then passed away.

The master has passed away, Mingming feels that there is no one to rely on in the three continents, and she is in mourning again. In addition, because of the death of her master, Mingming's sān shī seal was broken, and all kinds of emotions, like the night of the darkness, enveloped Mingming's whole body, which could not be avoided. So Mingming went insane again, and when she rose up, the sect was turned upside down, but after the masters of the caves made great efforts to stop her, the sect finally found peace.

Later on, Mingming was in seclusion for a few months, but when she came out of the cave, her hair was spread out, and there was blood sobbing at the edge of her eyes. When Mingming talked to people again, those who did not agree with her would get a taste of her sharp claws. She is so fast that even the disciples in the sect can't believe it. So get along for a lot of time, there are people rumors, Mingming's temperament changes with the moon, when the moon is waxing, her temperament is high, when the moon is waning, her temperament is low, if you have something to ask for Mingming, remember to avoid when the moon is waxing. As for the daytime, Mingming is often in seclusion, and it is even more rare to see her.

    姬方離自潛心修性以來，少出宗門，學姬方生面壁坐禪，修至深時，於先天一炁中感魔氣肆虐，修為不得再進。後方離欲破魔氣之局，東遊滄海岸，西登太山巔，南渡百川盡，北至萬魔地。數年內查遍三洲魔氣，知其源於三洲之外，曉其性去先天一炁甚遠——不分清濁，卻內蘊威能，常藏於三洲萬物之中。方離引魔氣入丹田試之，感心性大受震蕩，懼其於修行有損，只得作罷。
    後姬方離返宗門，將所悟報於元始洞主。曰，三洲先天炁日損，魔氣日益，而三洲修者奪先天炁之勢不減，多年後恐無炁可修。彼時魔氣充盈三洲，生靈皆殆矣。欲破此局，須開源節流。開源者，封魔氣之源，則魔氣減而靈氣增。節流者，滅能感炁之生靈，則修者少而靈氣又增。如此可保三洲太平。
    元始洞主聽罷大怒，責其心性為魔氣所染，竟起殺欲。方離欲退宗門自行其是，洞主不允，方離暴起而傷之。方生上前相阻，兄弟二人纏鬥許久難分高下，後方離引魔氣入體，修為陡增，拳掌之勢威極。而方生念兄弟之情，同門之義，出手猶豫不決，終鬥其不過，百年修為為方離所破，體毀將殞。
    後方離遠遁西洲。元始洞主觀方生，體雖毀而魂魄未滅，損己之體救之，遂方生回生。姬方生此生未盡，卻似已至來生，前世記憶皆碎，此時如嬰孩降世。而鍛玄宗遭此一役，封閉山門，環山而布禁製，斷絕與外界來往。

He joined the Iron Bone Sect and travelled with the Duan Xuan Sect as a delivery agent. He was recruited by the master of the Zhenzheng Cave because of his diligence.
    Li Man spar with the cultivators in the sect with his mortal body, so he often injured, often injured and often practiced, thus he became a great martial arts master, and his body became strong and healthy. 李㵘，東洲章郡人士。家道中落後遊歷三洲，因其不能感炁，求入仙門而不得。後入鐵骨門，因押鏢得與鍛玄宗往來。傳貞正洞主因見其勤而招入門下。
    平日李㵘以凡人之軀同門中修士切磋，常有傷，常傷常練而武學大成，體魄強健。又有赤金盤龍棍相助，可以凡人之軀力戰仙者。

所谓天下熙熙，皆为利来，天下攘攘，皆为利往，三洲古今皆如是，其中甚者数东洲。东洲大衍国中部彧州，有四面山岳百川拒魔气，鱼米丰裕，百姓安居而多商贾。
    彼时彧州十一郡，以章郡之丰裕为首。章郡下设铜县，以产赤铜而闻东洲。铜县李氏，原为县中大户，坐拥县中矿产，又有良田百亩，良驹仙品不可计数，财积三代而富抵半城。李㵘年少时颇任侠，常同门客乘肥仗剑游历于彧州各郡，每路见不平或散财或拔剑相助，渐于彧州中颇具名望。
    时良州有仙门相助，集市渐兴，聚四方百姓，一时竟有地少人众之势。李氏族长闻讯，典当族产，掷千金跨州而购良州地契千亩有余，图溢价而贩以得利。后有良州权贵妒之，差命理师数人散谣言于集市，言李氏之契不吉，遂过数月而购契者少。李氏数月入不敷出而家道中落，族人分余产而散。彼时良驹宝剑，众少年齐游好不畅快；今余陋室浊酒，独与月对饮愁肠难述。遂李㵘辞家而游历江湖。
    一日，李㵘行至百草门近郊，久未食而目生昏花。见四下灵草无人看管，时有野雉啄食，遂窃灵草捉野雉，遁至山中破庙，忆着彼时所尝珍馐滋味，烹了一道灵草雉汤。少顷，有乞丐寻味而至，李㵘与其分食。初尝之下，李㵘因无美酒相伴而觉其滋味大不如前，又思起彼时锦衣玉食门客欢聚之景，一时悲极而泣。乞丐惊，还道雉汤有毒，乱人心智，细细查之又无事，遂大笑，寻了庙中清净处打起坐来。
    是夜丑时，有魔物来袭，李㵘以命相搏，不敌，足为其所伤。李㵘伏地，万念俱灰只求死尔，却见墙角乞丐飞身而至，身法逍遥出尘。只见乞丐悠哉出手，掌中木杖轻点魔物面门，魔物刹那毙命。而后乞丐谓李㵘曰一饭之恩已还，此后两不相欠，说罢大笑出庙而去。
    李㵘经此一役，顿觉仙凡之别甚远，望如那乞丐般逍遥于天地间。遂李㵘拾乞丐所留木杖，跛足而造访三洲各仙门。而仙途遥遥，其终尚未可知。

It is said that the world is hassling, all for nothing but benefit, the world is bustling, all for nothing but interest. The three continents in ancient and modern times are the same, among them, the extreme case is the East Continent. Yuzhou in the centre of the east continent of the Danyan Kingdom, there are four sides of the mountains and rivers to resist the devil, fish and rice abundance, the people live peacefully and more merchants.

At that time, there were eleven counties in Yuzhou, with the abundance of Zhang County at the head. Under the Zhang County there is Tong County, with the production of red copper and heard of the East Continent. Copper County Li's family, was originally a large family in the county, sitting in the county minerals, but also has a hundred acres of good land, good ponies immortal products can not be counted, the wealth accumulated three generations and rich against half the city. Li Man was quite chivalrous when he was a young man, often travelling around the counties of Yuzhou with his guests on swords, and every time he saw an injustice on the road, he either dispersed his money or drew his sword to help out, and he gradually gained a good reputation in Yuzhou.

At that time, Liangzhou has immortal sects to help, it is gradually emerging market, gathering people from all directions, and there is a situation where there is less land and more people. Li's clan leader heard about it, pawned the clan's property, threw thousands of gold across the state and purchased more than a thousand acres of land deeds in Liangzhou, trying to premium prices and trading to gain profit. Later, there are Liangzhou's powerful nobility jealous of it, so they sent a number of fortune tellers to spread rumours in the market, saying that Li's deed is unlucky, and then after a few months and fewer people to buy the deed. Li's family fell into ruin in a few months, and the clansmen divided the remaining property and dispersed. Once a good horse and sword, all the young people travelled well and happy; now the remaining poor wine, drinking alone with the moon sadness is difficult to describe. Li Man then quits his family and travels the world.

One day, Li Man travelled to the outskirts of the Hundred Herb Sect, and had not eaten for a long time. See the surrounding spiritual grass unattended, and sometimes there are pheasants pecking, so Li Man steal the spiritual grass and catch pheasants, then flee to the broken temple in the mountains, remembering the taste of delicacies he tasted, cooking a spiritual grass and pheasant soup. A short while later, a beggar came in search of flavour, Li Man shared the food with him. The first taste, Li Man feel that the taste is not as good as before because there is no wine with it, but also think of the time when the scene of the gathering of the guests, a moment of sadness catchs him so he began to cry. The beggar surprised, thought the pheasant soup is poisonous, can confuse people's minds. After a careful investigation, the beggar found nothing, so he laughed and searched for a clean place in the temple and sat down.

It was the night of the Chou hour, there is a devil to attack, Li Man fight with his life but can not win, and his foot was wounded by the devil. Li Man crouched on the ground, thinking of nothing but death. Suddenly he saw the beggar flying from the corner, and his body style is free from the world. Just see the beggar leisurely strike, the wooden staff in his palm lightly pointing at the face of the devil, the devil was killed in a flash. And then the beggar said to Li Man that a meal of grace has been returned, and thereafter the two do not owe each other. Then the beggar laughed loudly and left the temple and gone.

Li Man, after this battle, felt that the difference between the immortals and the mortals is very far, and hoped to be as free as the beggar among the world. So Li Man picks up the wooden staff left by the beggar and limps to visit the immortal sects in the three continents. The journey to immortality is far away and its end is not yet known.

At the beginning, Li Man felt the difference between immortals and mortals, and thought that the brave ones should take the path of immortality, so he travelled to three continents to visit the immortal sects, but the sects refused to accept him because he could not sense the Qi. After a few months, Li Man recovered from his foot injury and changed his wooden staff to a weapon. He started to travel to different states and learnt all the martial arts from mortals and made a living as a deliver agent in his daily life. Afterwards, Li Man travelled to the North Continent and joined the Iron Bone Sect, often helping Duan Xuan Sect to deliver goods, so he was able to view the interior of the Immortal Sect.

Whenever Li Man received a order from the Duan Xuan Sect, he used to deliver it overnight, and whenever he saw a cave master, he would bow to him, begging him to take him under their guidance. Although all the cave masters felt that Li Man was sincere and determined, they all rejected him because he could not sense the Qi. However, the master Zhenzheng of Puzhao Cave did not think so, and gladly accepted him as his disciple. Others said that Master Zhenzheng was lazy and needing a disciple to take care of his miscellaneous affairs, and he accepted Li Man because Li Man could not feel the Qi, and he only needed to teach Li Man some basic knowledge, which could already cost Li Man's whole life, thus saving master Zhenzheng a lot of effort and energy. However, Li Man was full of joy when he was admitted to the Immortal Sect, and he did not care about the gossip.

When Li Man first entered the Forging Xuan, his fists could not shake the rock of the Xuan Tie Mountain, and he often cracked his flesh while the stone wall was only cut down by a fraction of a millimetre, and his hands needed to be treated with herbs regularly to prevent his muscles and bones from being damaged. After several months, Li Man opening the cave during the day and sleeping on the ground at night, he finally got a square-inch hole, which can accommodate one person sitting on the floor. Although the cave was small, it was the beginning of Li Man's cultivation.

However, Li Man usually only assists Xiao Bu in dealing with the miscellaneous affairs of the sect, so it is difficult for him to meet his master, and he is politely refused to study in other caves. Li Man could only go to the centre arena in his spare time every day to watch the disciples perform martial arts and memorise the moves of each cave. Afterwards, Li Man tries to spar with his brothers and sisters, and every time he fights, his body is bruised and he needs to take a medicinal bath to save himself. As a result, Xiao Bu complained and blamed Li Man for consuming a lot of spiritual herbs, so she occasionally taught Li Man some self-defence moves to reduce his injuries.

After three years, Li Man has been forging his body through hard punches and kicks during sparring sessions, and cultivating his mind through meditation, although he is not able to use the Qi, his body is getting stronger and stronger. Li Man already knew all the moves in the sect, plus the mortal martial arts he learnt before joining the sect, so he could be considered to be well versed in the martial arts. Now when Li Man is sparring, he often watches his opponent's moves and knows where they are going, and when his opponent makes a move, he moves in advance, seeing the moves and countering them, and with the protection of his wooden stick, his injuries are getting less and less serious.

Li Man's heart of a martial artist is gradually formed, combining all kinds of kung fu in one body, when he makes a move, others see no move at all, and his punches, kicks and sticks contain the meaning of "peace". Although Li Man still doesn't have Qi, he is no less than an ordinary cultivator.

初，李㵘感仙凡之別，深覺強者當踏仙途，遂遊三洲造訪仙門，而各仙門均以其不能感炁而拒。過數月，李㵘足傷愈，改木杖為哨棒，始出入各州武行，遍學凡人武術，平日則以走鏢為生。後李㵘至北洲，入鐵骨門，常助鍛玄宗運鏢，得以見仙門內景。
    李㵘每接鍛玄宗之鏢，常連夜送達，每見洞主便拜，求其收己入門下。各洞主雖覺李㵘性誠誌堅，卻皆因其不能感炁而拒。而普照洞貞正洞主卻不以為意，欣然收入門下。他人道貞正洞主怠惰因循，需弟子代其理雜務，收李㵘皆因其不感炁，僅授其皮毛便可耗其一生，實為省心省力之舉。而李㵘得入仙門，自然滿心歡喜，於流言蜚語更是毫不在意。
    初入鍛玄，李㵘雙拳難撼玄鐵山磐石，常皮開肉綻而石壁僅削分毫，雙手需常敷草藥而不至於筋骨損毀。經數月，李㵘白日開洞府，夜間席地而眠，終得方寸之洞，可容一人盤坐。洞府雖小，卻為李㵘修行之始。
    然平日，李㵘只相助小布處理宗門雜務，師尊難見，求學於它洞亦被婉拒。遂李㵘只得每日閑暇之時至中心道場，觀眾弟子演武，各洞招式牢記於心。而後，李㵘試與師兄弟切磋，每戰必遍體鱗傷，需以藥浴相救。常此，小布有怨，責李㵘所耗靈草甚多，遂偶爾亦教其些防身招式以減其傷。
    經三年，李㵘切磋時硬承拳腳而鍛體，藥浴時思演招式而修心，雖不得炁卻體魄漸強。於門中各招式，李㵘已了然於胸，加之入門前所習凡人武術，武道可謂融會貫通矣。今李㵘切磋之時，常觀對手出招而知招至何處，對手未動而己先行，見招而拆招，又有哨棒相護，受傷漸輕。
    至此李㵘武者之心漸成，合百家功夫於一身卻出招皆無招，拳腳棍法中蘊止戈之意。雖不得炁卻差尋常修士無多矣。

天下莫柔弱于水，而攻坚强者莫之能胜，以其无以易之。有传李㵘出生时命中缺水，族人以大水名之。后观李㵘之行，常以弱搏强，无不似水也。
    一日，屠馗指导李㵘之时，出数拳皆为其哨棒所挡，奇之，疑其为仙家法器，借来试其坚，运全力击哨棒九九八十一次方折其为两节。屠馗赞其材远胜寻常法器，欲带至鼎炉洞修之。而李㵘则言哨棒乃身外之物，折了也罢。屠馗不允，提李㵘至鼎炉洞。洞中炼器士以无良矿可配哨棒之神机而拒。屠馗不悦，正要发作时李㵘取腰间铜佩相示，观之，乃东洲仙品赤铜。遂炼器士熔李㵘家传赤铜佩为链，以链链哨棒所断之处，又以余矿附其周身，入鼎炼七七四十九天神兵方成。所成神兵似断非断，似折非折，有头有尾，曰赤金盘龙棍。
    李㵘既得神兵，屠馗欣然邀其再战。战良久而屠馗拳脚皆被赤金盘龙棍所挡，屠馗不悦，运气急攻，李㵘渐觉虎口吃痛，就要招架不住。是时屠馗猛然一拳袭来，击得李㵘盘龙棍脱手，俄顷又是一拳直奔李㵘膻中而去，李㵘避无可避只得双臂护身抵挡。眼见李㵘双手将为屠馗所折，盘龙棍凌空自解，双棍成赤金生水之势而化作双龙，盘于李㵘双臂。此时屠馗重拳方至，然此一击却似石沉大海，一身蛮力已被卸了大半。李㵘抗下此拳，只觉双臂吃痛，却是毫发未损。屠馗甚奇之，再试数拳皆觉软绵无力，劲不可透。咂舌称奇，悻悻然曰择日再比，转身而去。
    后此神兵平日攀于李㵘双臂而不扰其拳脚，持棍攻守亦不阻其身法。遂李㵘得赤金盘龙棍如鱼得水，有此神兵相助可以凡人之躯力战仙者矣。
    后李㵘于锻玄宗修行，还常理杂务，常为拳脚所伤。然其志却愈显高远，寻常得失不染其心。贞正洞主观之大喜，言㵘已得道，心性修为远胜同辈弟子。以无炁胜有炁，可谓弱之胜强，柔之胜刚。
    今宗门大开，李㵘至仙府修行，于秘境中得炁。而凡人强者得炁，其势如百川之水奔涌入海，修者亦不可阻也。

There is nothing in the world more soft and weak than water,and yet for attacking things that are firm and strong there is nothing that can take precedence of it;for there is nothing (so effectual) for which it can be changed. It was rumoured that Li Man was born with a lack of water in Five Element, and his clan named him after Great Water. Afterwards, Li Man's behaviour, often fighting with his weak against other's strength, was similar to water.

One day, when Tu Kui was instructing Li Man, he threw a few punches, all of which were blocked by Li Man's stick, so he suspected that it was a magic weapon of the Immortals and borrowed it to test its firmness, and then he struck the stick with all his strength for eighty-one times before breaking it into two parts. Tu Kui praised it for its material, which was far better than ordinary magic weapons, and wanted to bring it to the Ding Lu Cave for repair. Li Man, however, said that the stick was just an object outside the body, so it would be fine if it was broken. Tu Kui refused and took Li Man to the Ding Lu Cave. The smith in the cave refused due to the fact that there is no good mine that can match with the divine mechanism of the stick. Tu Kui was not happy, and was about to have a temper tantrum when Li Man took the copper pendant from his waist and showed it to him, and he saw that it was the red copper of the East Continent. So the smith melted Li Man's family heirloom of red copper for the chain, to chain the broken stick parts, and the rest of the mine attached to its body, then put it into the Ding for 79 days to refine the Divine Weapon. The divine weapon seems to break and not break, seems to fold and not fold, have a head and tail, and named the Red Gold Dragon Stick.

Li Man had got the divine weapon, and Tu Kui gladly invited him to fight again. They fought for a long time and Tu Kui's punches and kicks were all blocked by the Red Gold Dragon Stick, Tu Kui was not happy, and he ran his Qi to attack, Li Man gradually felt the pain in his hand, and was about to be unable to defend himself. At that time, Tu Kui sudden stroke to attack, knocked Li Man's Dragon Stick out of his hand, and then another punch straight to Li Man's heart, Li Man could not avoid only have to shield his arms to resist. Seeing Li Man's hands will be broken by Tu Kui, the Dragon Stick is dissolved in the air, and the two sticks are transformed into two dragons by the way of red gold generating water, which are coiled on Li Man's arms. At this time, Tu Kui's heavy fist is coming, but this strike is like a stone sinking into the sea, a body of brute force has been unloaded for the most part. Li Man resisted this punch, only felt the pain in both arms, but not a single hair was damaged. Tu Kui is very strange, and then try a few punches all feel soft and weak, the strength can not be penetrated. Tu kui twisted his lips and wondered, and said resentfully that they would choose a another day to compete, then turned around and went away.

Later, Li Man usually climbed the divine weapon on both arms without disturbing his fists, holding the stick to attack and defend without blocking his stance. Li Man got the Red Gold Dragon Stick is like a fish in water, with the help of this divine weapon can allow a mortal body be able to fight against the immortal.

Since then, Li Man has been cultivating in Duan Xuan Sect, still taking care of miscellaneous affairs, and often injured by punches and kicks. However, his ambition became more and more lofty, and his heart was not affected by ordinary gains and losses. The master Zhenzheng was very happy to see him and said that he had achieved the Way, and his mental cultivation was far better than that of his disciples. With no qi to win the qi, it can be said that the weak is stronger than the strong, and the soft is stronger than the hard.

关于姬方生：大师兄曾劝我，在不属于自己的道路上挣扎是浪费时间。但要我说，无需在意道路尽头有何事物，专注前行中的感悟于我来说足矣。

关于屠馗：不要因屠师兄拳法犀利而感到恐惧。我坚信每个人的真正敌人是自己。做好准备，把每次战斗当作需要认真对待的论道。

关于叶冥冥：叶师姐似乎心里装了许多杂念，而且越装越满，以至于每次倾倒时如洪水般造成巨大冲击……我很清楚这种感受，几年前的我也像她一般……

About Ji Fangsheng: Eldest Brother once advised me that it is a waste of time to struggle on a path that does not belong to me. But if you ask me, I say that it is not necessary to care about what is at the end of the road, it is enough for us to focus on the insights that come from travelling forward.

About Tu Kui: Don't be intimidated by the sharpness of Brother Tu's punches. I am a firm believer that everyone's true enemy is themselves. Be prepared and treat each fight as an argument that needs to be taken seriously.

About Ye Meimei: Senior Sister Ye seems to have a lot of distractions in her heart, and it gets fuller and fuller, so much that every time she pours it out like a flood it causes a huge impact...... I know this feeling very well, and a few years ago I was just like her......

About Xiao Bu: Senior Sister Xiao Bu has assigned me some more miscellaneous affairs today. Actually, if you look at all these things as part of the cultivation, it's not that painful to do them. For the most part, it's through dealing with miscellaneous affairs that I'm better able to exercise my Dao heart.

關於葉冥冥：葉師姐似乎心裏裝了許多雜念，而且越裝越滿，以至於每次傾倒時如洪水般造成巨大沖擊……我很清楚這種感受，幾年前的我也像她一般……

Interesting. In that case, let's go with Heptastar Pavilion.
有趣，如此的話，就選七星閣好了。

一日後，玄鐵山東峰之巔。吾行之見屠馗在崖邊打坐，走上前去在其身旁坐下。
呸，人都走了，念个屁的经，给谁听啊！
Bah, master already left, what's the point of reciting a bullshit scripture? For whom to listen to?
呸，人都走了，念個屁的經，給誰聽啊！
吾行之本知屠馗不胜酒力，只道能激怒其打上一架，兴许能振奋其精神。然屠馗一把抢过葫芦灌上了一大口。

哎呀，我就知道！你们锻玄宗的一个个都这么喜欢糟蹋东西是吧！

哎呀，我就知道！你們鍛玄宗的一個個都這麼喜歡糟蹋東西是吧！

哎…等你清醒后，我想在贵宗门再待几日，帮你们完善一下禁制。如今不但得防魔物，还得防人心。

(Sighs)...When you are awake, I would like to stay in your sect for a few more days to help you perfect the restrictions. Nowadays, not only do you have to guard against devils, you also have to guard against people's desires.
哎…等你清醒後，我想在貴宗門再待幾日，幫你們完善一下禁製。如今不但得防魔物，還得防人心。
You said it! That's a deal! (Vomit) ......

姜襲明你可別待宗門裏關禁閉啊！北洲的物資押送還要七星閣幫忙呢！

Thousands of miles away, in the Mountain Moving Camp.
阁中来信了，情况不太妙。万幸他们三人都没事，只是芦雪城外的那些弟子……

就事论事罢了，此前一战你表现得很好。

花沁蕊喚起玄冥池水，向南宮生砸去。須臾火苗即滅，南宮生連同兩筐粽子均浸滿池水，似落湯的雉雞一般。
呐，是你这臭桃核先动手的！
See, you stinking peach kernel started it!
吶，是你這臭桃核先動手的！
南宫生周身升起烈火，身上池水蒸腾，起了一片白雾。
Fiery fire rose around Nangong Sheng's body, and the pool water on his body steamed and a white mist rose.
南宮生周身升起烈火，身上池水蒸騰，起了一片白霧。
二人化作水火缠斗一番，玄冥池内修士受他二人如此一搅和，纷纷退至数丈外，池面佩兰也被搅作一团，失了此前淡雅姿态。

Two people turned into water and fire entangled in a fight, and cultivators in the Xuanming pool were so disturbed by the two of them, have retreated to a few feet away, the orchids on the surface of the pool was also stirred up into a mess, lost its previous elegant .
二人化作水火纏鬥一番，玄冥池內修士受他二人如此一攪和，紛紛退至數丈外，池面佩蘭也被攪作一團，失了此前淡雅姿態。
眼见二人有越战越烈之势，刹那间有两团气自杜伶鸳之伞窜出，在空中化为双鸳，围绕二人逆转起来，将二人水火势头消去大半。

Seeing that the two have more and more fierce trend, in a flash, there are two groups of Qi from Du Lingyuan's umbrella surface fled out, the Qi groups turned into a pair of mandarin ducks in the air, and the mandarin ducks reversed around the two, removed most of the power of the two's water and fire.
眼見二人有越戰越烈之勢，剎那間有兩團氣自杜伶鴛之傘竄出，在空中化為雙鴛，圍繞二人逆轉起來，將二人水火勢頭消去大半。
斗嘴不过瘾竟斗起法来。可惜，精心布置的池面就被你们搅乱了，师姐我要生气咯。
The bickering is not enjoyable, so you want to start to hurt each other now? It is a pity that the carefully arranged pool surface is disturbed by you, now it's time for me to get angry.
鬥嘴不過癮竟鬥起法來。可惜，精心布置的池面就被你們攪亂了，師姐我要生氣咯。
哎呀，糟糕，对不起啊师姐，一时兴起没注意。都…都怪这米拉德！
Oops, crap, sorry senior sister, I didn't pay attention on the spur of the moment. It's...it's all this Milad's fault!
哎呀，糟糕，對不起啊師姐，一時興起沒註意。都…都怪這米拉德！
什么啊，还没结束呢，我们继续！
What? It's not over. Let's continue!
什麼啊，還沒結束呢，我們繼續！
Hmph, why didn't Tiger help me?
你虎哥的话不听，师姐的话也不听，看来是想关禁闭了。（呼喊）南宫舵主，南宫舵主在吗？你家小生啊……

You don't listen to your brother Tiger, and you don't listen to your senior sister, so it looks like you want to be grounded. (Shouting) Master Nangong, is Master Nangong here? Your little boy is ......
你虎哥的話不聽，師姐的話也不聽，看來是想關禁閉了。（呼喊）南宮舵主，南宮舵主在嗎？你家小生啊……
诶，别别别！不打了不打了。
Eh, no, no, no! No more fighting no more fighting.
誒，別別別！不打了不打了。
（笑道）正好时辰也到了，看你二人气息充沛意犹未尽的……以竞舟代斗法可好？
(Laughs) Just the time has come, seeing you two seems don't want to finish yet ...... How about to race the boat instead of fighting?
（笑道）正好時辰也到了，看你二人氣息充沛意猶未盡的……以競舟代鬥法可好？
师姐主意好，敢不敢比啊米拉德，你要是输了，就把这筐甜粽全吃了。
Good idea, senior sister. Do you dare to compete, Milad? If you lose, you'll eat all the sweet Zongzi in this basket.
師姐主意好，敢不敢比啊米拉德，你要是輸了，就把這筐甜粽全吃了。
谁怕谁啊，那你输了就把这筐咸的吃了！不行，我也想吃，嗯……你就都不许吃！
Yeah,why not, and if you lose, you will eat this whole salty basket of Zongzi! oh, wait a minute. I want to eat them, too. Well...... you're not allowed to eat any of them if you lose!
誰怕誰啊，那你輸了就把這筐鹹的吃了！不行，我也想吃，嗯……你就都不許吃！
说罢两人一南一北向岸边龙舟走去。
Saying this the two of them walked north and south towards the shore to the dragon boats.
說罷兩人一南一北向岸邊龍舟走去。
真好，希望师弟师妹们可以一直如此活泼开朗，健康顺遂。
It's so nice, I hope that all my junior sisters and brothers can always be so lively and cheerful, and healthy and lucky like this.
真好，希望師弟師妹們可以一直如此活潑開朗，健康順遂。
重五好，驱邪，正气。对身体好。
Dragon Boat Festival is great, expels evil spirits, and straightens Qi. Good for the body.
重五好，驅邪，正氣。對身體好。
对了，虎子喜欢什么口味的粽子？
Right, by the way, what flavor of Zongzi does Tiger like?
對了，虎子喜歡什麼口味的粽子？
喂，这可是我姑姑包的，全溟州最好吃的甜粽！
Hey! What are you doing? This is my aunt's homemade Zongzi! The best in Mingzhou!
餵，這可是我姑姑包的，全溟州最好吃的甜粽！
你很有品味嘛……诶，等等，怎么又换？！
You have a great taste.... eh, wait, change again so soon?!
你很有品味嘛……誒，等等，怎麼又換？！
道友，你是一台天机谷在逃甜咸永动机！
Fellow Daoist, you're a sweet and salty perpetual motion machine at large from Tian Ji Valley!
道友，你是一臺天機谷在逃甜鹹永動機！
还要一起赢得比赛呢，你可别提前逃跑啊！
We still have to win the race together. Don't you run away early!
還要一起贏得比賽呢，你可別提前逃跑啊！
现在势头正旺呢，别放弃啊，加把火，赢了就有好吃的了！
It's a tight race right now. Don't give up. Put some heat on it. We'll have a good meal if we win!
現在勢頭正旺呢，別放棄啊，加把火，贏了就有好吃的了！
怎么换来换去的，耍赖皮，我要生气了！
Why are you switching around? You're cheating. I'm going to be annoyed!
怎麼換來換去的，耍賴皮，我要生氣了！

第一节  破军榜

Part 5 - 1, Pojun Board

第一節  破軍榜

簡介：七星閣近期發動雷劫，修行受阻，弟子們紛紛接取任務出閣歷練。此時曜靈找上了譚舒雁。
目標：經歷劇情。
九天应元，雷声普化。昔日里七星群阁灵气充盈之景，此时大为变样。草木焚毁，阁楼尽损。四下有雷霆乍响，震撼心神。

There were lightning flashes around the Heptastar Pavilion. In the past, the Heptastar Pavilion was full of spiritual qi, but at this time, it was greatly changed. Grass and trees burned down, the pavilion is damaged. There are thunder in all directions, shocking people's souls.
九天應元，雷聲普化。昔日裏七星群閣靈氣充盈之景，此時大為變樣。草木焚毀，閣樓盡損。四下有雷霆乍響，震撼心神。
七星阁众弟子在群阁间穿梭，多数在修护群阁损毁之处。一部分来到破军榜，接取宗门新派下的任务。

The Heptastar Pavilion's crowd of disciples travelling between the Heptastar Pavilions, most of them repairing the damage to the Heptastar Pavilions. A few of them came to the Pojun Board to take up the newly assigned tasks from the sect.
七星閣眾弟子在群閣間穿梭，多數在修護群閣損毀之處。一部分來到破軍榜，接取宗門新派下的任務。
众弟子中，显出两个熟悉身影。
Among the disciples, two familiar figures were revealed.
眾弟子中，顯出兩個熟悉身影。
呜……这七星阁曜灵是一刻也待不下去了。只发动一次雷劫，曜灵的积蓄就没了三分之一。
Woo ...... This Heptastar Pavilion Yao Ling cannot stay for a second. After launching only one Thunder Tribulation, Yao Ling's savings were gone by a third.
嗚……這七星閣曜靈是一刻也待不下去了。只發動一次雷劫，曜靈的積蓄就沒了三分之一。
要是魔头再找上门来，曜灵要成破落户了！
If the Devil comes after us again, Yao Ling is going to be bankrupt!
要是魔頭再找上門來，曜靈要成破落戶了！
不至于，以小曜灵的能耐，不出数载，赚上十倍灵石也不在话下。
Really? With Little Yao Ling's ability, I don't think it would be a problem for you to earn ten times the amount of spirit stones in less than a few years.
不至於，以小曜靈的能耐，不出數載，賺上十倍靈石也不在話下。
不行啦，曜灵现在看到风师姐就害怕！生怕她又来取我灵石去布雷劫！
No way, Yao Ling now gets scared when I see Sister Feng! I'm afraid she'll come back to take my spirit stones and start a Thunder Tribulation again!
不行啦，曜靈現在看到風師姐就害怕！生怕她又來取我靈石去布雷劫！
我看那魔头为雷劫所伤，一时半会是回不来的。
I think that devil was injured by the Thunder Tribulation and won't be able to return for a while.
我看那魔頭為雷劫所傷，一時半會是回不來的。
对对对，定要趁这段时间把灵石宝贝全挣回来！
Yes, yes, yes, Yao Ling must take advantage of this time to earn back all the spirit stone treasures!
對對對，定要趁這段時間把靈石寶貝全掙回來！
所以曜灵刚揭了破军榜，是阁主亲自派下的美差哦。
So Yao Ling has just revealed the Pojun Board's task, a beautiful job sent down by the Pavilion Master himself.
所以曜靈剛揭了破軍榜，是閣主親自派下的美差哦。
那不是正好，这便可以下阁去了。
Isn't that just right? Then you can leave the pavilion at once.
那不是正好，這便可以下閣去了。
虽然曜灵很想去，但是师姐你看这榜上写着，地点在谭国旧部……

咳，我意思是谭国…已成废墟，还去那作甚。
Ahem, I mean Tan...it's in ruins, what's the point of going there.
咳，我意思是譚國…已成廢墟，還去那作甚。
不知道呢…师姐自己去看看罢！给！
I don't know...Sister will see for yourself! Here!
不知道呢…師姐自己去看看罷！給！
Little Yao Ling is going to let me have it?
对呀，灵石可以再赚，师姐能有这个机会回老家去看看更重要！
Right, spirit stones can be earned again, it's more important for senior sister to have this opportunity to go back to her hometown to have a look!
對呀，靈石可以再賺，師姐能有這個機會回老家去看看更重要！
不行…阁主说了要斩断俗尘……
No way...the master of the pavilion said I should cut off the mundane ......
不行…閣主說了要斬斷俗塵……
哎呀，什么时候都能斩嘛，况且这次是阁主发的榜，又没规定说谭师姐独不能揭！
Aiya, we can cut off the mundane at any time, besides, this is the pavilion master himself posted the task, and there is no rule saying that Ms. Tan alone can not reveal the task!
哎呀，什麼時候都能斬嘛，況且這次是閣主發的榜，又沒規定說譚師姐獨不能揭！
确是如此…那我去一趟吧。小曜灵一起吗？
Indeed...I'll go there then. Is Yao Ling coming with me?
確是如此…那我去一趟吧。小曜靈一起嗎？
曜灵得去一趟洛商会了。想办法让伙伴们帮帮忙，尽快把灵石库内的折损给补上。
Yao Ling would have to make a trip to the Luo Chamber of Commerce. Find a way to get my partners to help out and make up for the losses within the Spirit Stone Vault as soon as possible.
曜靈得去一趟洛商會了。想辦法讓夥伴們幫幫忙，盡快把靈石庫內的折損給補上。
师姐要是发现了好东西记得分曜灵一份就行！
If you find something good, just remember to share with Yao Ling!
師姐要是發現了好東西記得分曜靈一份就行！
这是自然。兴许真能从废墟中寻回些好东西……
I promise. Maybe there really is something good to be recovered from the ruins ......
這是自然。興許真能從廢墟中尋回些好東西……

The next day, the border of Tan.
哟，这不是五行道盟的小屁孩嘛。偷偷溜出来的吧！

說什麼呢，臭紅毛！（四下張望）你小點聲！

玩什麼，一看你就沒安好心，才不去呢。你們算卦的，一向很狡猾。
那…我只好先去趟朱雀舵，和南宫舵主叙叙旧了。
Then...I'll just have to make a trip to the Vermilion Bird Rudder first and have a little chat with Rudder Master Nangong.
那…我只好先去趟朱雀舵，和南宮舵主敘敘舊了。
嘿，想去可以啊，你跨着火去吧。
Hey, you can go if you want to. by crossing the fire.
嘿，想去可以啊，你跨著火去吧。

Yan Chen turned to go, and Nangong Sheng hand snapped his fingers, a ball of fire sprang to Yan Chen's body, instantly erected a ten feet high wall of fire, blocking Yan Chen's way.
炎塵轉身將走，南宮生手打響指，一團火苗竄到了炎塵身前，剎那豎起一道丈高火墻，攔住了炎塵去路。

The two fought each other for several rounds, and it was difficult to distinguish between the winners and the losers.
兩人相鬥數回合，一時難分高下。
炎尘无意再战，催动无极卦盘，拨动南宫生火焰所处之离位，火焰顿时弱了几分。

炎塵無意再戰，催動無極卦盤，撥動南宮生火焰所處之離位，火焰頓時弱了幾分。
南宫生将要再运火灵法术，调动了全身灵气，想以烈焰烧炎尘，却见炎尘突然比了个停止的手势。

Stop, stop, stop. I'm not going to tell Rudder Master Nangong, okay? It's getting late, I don't have time to waste anymore.
停停停，我不告狀行了吧。今個時辰也不早了，我可沒空跟你耗。
直说了罢。这片废墟之中有魔修者，你助我将其拿住。这袋小玩意都归你。
Let's get this straight. There are devil cultivators in these ruins, you help me take them down. This bag of tricks is yours.
直說了罷。這片廢墟之中有魔修者，你助我將其拿住。這袋小玩意都歸你。
What is it? Let me see.
炎尘将一乾坤袋往地上一掷，南宫生解了系带一瞧，袖箭、金钱、铁橄榄；飞蝗、飞镖、如意珠；尽是些暗器。
Yan Chen threw a Qiankun bag to the ground, Nangong Sheng unraveled the belt to see, cuff arrows, money darts, iron olive; flying locusts, darts, Ruyi beads; all are some concealed weapons.
炎塵將一乾坤袋往地上一擲，南宮生解了系帶一瞧，袖箭、金錢、鐵橄欖；飛蝗、飛鏢、如意珠；盡是些暗器。
噫，堂堂七星阁弟子怎么带的都是些阴损玩意。
Welp, how come the disciples of the Heptastar Pavilion are carrying all those underhanded things.
噫，堂堂七星閣弟子怎麼帶的都是些陰損玩意。
我哪里需要用这些！此前在路上遇了几位晓月的刺客，敢打小爷主意，全被我打发了。

我哪裏需要用這些！此前在路上遇了幾位曉月的刺客，敢打小爺主意，全被我打發了。
顺手夺了他们兵器，本打算货了换些灵石，你不要？不要就算了。
I took their weapons by chance, and I was going to exchange them for some spirit stones, and yet you don't want them? If you don't want it, just forget it.
順手奪了他們兵器，本打算貨了換些靈石，你不要？不要就算了。
哟，没想到算卦的身手还不错。
Yo, I didn't expect you, a trigram teller, to be a good fighter.
喲，沒想到算卦的身手還不錯。
嗯…这些破烂…我拿来融成铁人玩也不是不行。那好，看在那位有朱雀羽的姐姐的份上，帮你们七星阁一次！

Hmm...these rags...it's not impossible for me to use them to melt into iron figures for fun. Well then, for the sake of that sister with the Vermilion Bird Feather, I'll help the Heptastar Pavilion once!
嗯…這些破爛…我拿來融成鐵人玩也不是不行。那好，看在那位有朱雀羽的姐姐的份上，幫你們七星閣一次！

只是在仙府見過一面。能有朱雀之物的人，不可能是壞人，也不會加入壞宗門！
哼，那便说好了。你随我来罢。

百草門不是修仙門派，這個時候肯定都在準備過年吧？好不容易來一趟，靈草都采不到嗎？

承雲妹妹，你想采些什麽呢？

Well, ah, I want to pick some spiritual vanillas to make incense for Sister Tan! I saw Sister Tan moping around a lot, so I hope you'll be in a better mood and be happy every day ......
這個嘛，嘿嘿，我想采些靈香草，做成熏香給譚姐姐用！我看譚姐姐經常悶悶不樂的，所以希望你能心情好一些，每天快快樂樂的......

Black Tortoise Rudder of Five Elements Alliance, central pool of Tengshe Island.
五行道盟玄武舵，中央螣蛇島水池。

這水池，是叫玄冥池吧？我記得小時候曾經來過一次。

The mountains on the west side of our Country Tan are the birthplace of the Spirit River, so I've always been curious since I was a kid about where the Spirit River would flow to. 我們譚國西側的山上，是靈河的發源地，所以我從小就好奇，靈河到底會流向哪裏。那次，父王耐不住我的再三請求，便施展風術順著靈河，帶我來逛了一遍。想來，那也是我們唯一一次旅行吧。
谭姐姐，你的父亲好好哦，飞这么远一定很累吧！

譚姐姐，你的父親好好哦，飛這麽遠一定很累吧！

嗯，他是一個稱職的父親，直到殉國前仍在擔心我的安危。我至今仍在不時思念他......

真的吗，太好了！御剑和划船我都在行，我可是出了名的快！
Really? That's great! I'm good at both sword-riding and boating. I'm notoriously fast!
真的嗎，太好了！禦劍和劃船我都在行，我可是出了名的快！

你不知道的事还多着呢！不过我也是刚刚听说有这么个地方，才带谭姐姐来逛逛。
There's a lot you don't know! But I've only just heard of such a place and brought Sister Tan here for a stroll.
你不知道的事還多著呢！不過我也是剛剛聽說有這麽個地方，才帶譚姐姐來逛逛。
听大师兄说，这里前不久被一个魔头占据，不过已经被打跑了！大师兄好像还带了两个三洲以外的人来帮忙喔，好犀利！

I heard from Eldest Brother that this place was occupied by a demon not long ago, but it's been fought off! Eldest Brother seems to have brought two people from outside the three continents to help, so powerful!

三洲以外的人？你是說，不屬於我們這片土地？
是啊，好像叫......？咦，怎么回事，我刚刚还记得！
Right, I think they are called ......? Hey, what's going on? I just remembered it!
是啊，好像叫......？咦，怎麽回事，我剛剛還記得！

Li Chengyun racked her brain, but could not remember who exactly it was that Eldest Brother was recounting.
黎承雲搜腸刮肚，卻怎麽也想不起來大師兄講述的到底是誰。
原来三洲竟有如此风光？

原來三洲竟有如此風光？
嘿嘿，这才哪到哪，好玩的地方还多着呢，我们继续！
Haha, this is just the tip of the iceberg. There are more places for fun, go on!
嘿嘿，這才哪到哪，好玩的地方還多著呢，我們繼續！
收到了新年红包，好开心！而且摸起来里面竟然有灵石？？
I have received New Year's red envelopes! I'm so happy! And there are spirit stones inside?
收到了新年紅包，好開心！而且摸起來裏面竟然有靈石？？
咦，你们那里的红包不放灵石吗？

咦，你們那裏的紅包不放靈石嗎？

那快拆开看看，这里面有多少灵石吧，好像还有别的东西？

那快拆開看看，這裏面有多少靈石吧，好像還有別的東西？

我懂啦，火山卦，是讓我們去西洲火焰山吧？
这一圈又收了好多红包，好耶！

這一圈又收了好多紅包，好耶！

誒，譚姐姐也給我準備了紅包啊！

Since I joined the sect, I've forgotten that there are such customs in the mortal world. On this excursion, you've brought back a lot of memories, thank you!
自從入了宗門，都快忘了凡間還有這種習俗。這次遊歷，你讓我回憶起了很多事情，謝謝你！
嘿嘿，应该的，应该的嘛！好了，继续出发吧！
Hi-hi, It's my pleasure! Okay, let's keep going!
嘿嘿，應該的，應該的嘛！好了，繼續出發吧！
好了，我们应该已经把整个三洲都走遍了吧。

好了，我們應該已經把整個三洲都走遍了吧。

我所知道的地點都去啦，還有些我不熟悉的，以後再來探索吧！

說來奇怪，閣主一心要我斬斷俗塵，可這一趟下來，我覺得這俗塵還是蠻有趣的嘛，感覺身心都舒暢了。

I told you, it's boring to practice all the time, so you definitely need to come out and relax!
早就說了嘛，一直修煉怪悶的，肯定也要出來放松的啦！
承云妹妹，真的很感谢你带我出来玩。这一年来发生了太多事，让我一直闷闷不乐的，现在的我已经准备好迎接新的一年了。
Sister Chengyun, thank you so much for taking me out. Too many things have happened in the past year that have made me mopey, and now I'm ready for a new year.
承雲妹妹，真的很感謝你帶我出來玩。這一年來發生了太多事，讓我一直悶悶不樂的，現在的我已經準備好迎接新的一年了。
不用这么客气嘛，我还要谢谢谭姐姐呢。和你在一起很开心，下次也要一起玩！

不用這麽客氣嘛，我還要謝謝譚姐姐呢。和你在一起很開心，下次也要一起玩！
嗯，这次也该回去了。虽然北伐之后，三洲相对安宁，可听风营还不能闲下来呢。
Well, it's time to go back now. Although the Three Continents are relatively peaceful after the Northern Expedition, the Wind Listening Camp can't afford to be idle.
嗯，這次也該回去了。雖然北伐之後，三洲相對安寧，可聽風營還不能閑下來呢。
好啊，如果回去之前还想去哪，就和我提哦！
All right, if you want to go anywhere else before you go back, just tell me!
好啊，如果回去之前還想去哪，就和我提哦！

诶，不行。这地上躺着的畜生里还有只是昏迷的，留在镇里又得祸害我们。要不两位道爷受累，就地惩恶扬善……

Wait a minute, I can't do that. The beasts lying on the ground there are still just unconscious, if we let them stay in the town, they will harm us again. Maybe the two Masters Daoist can put these beasts to death for the righteousness of our people......

At the same time, your <color=#DB0202>[Physique]</color> can be used to make breakthroughs instead of cultivation, so as long as you keep increasing your Physique in every battle, you will be able to raise your phase faster than others and experience the feeling of being far ahead!
